We evaluate two datasets: DAIC-WOZ, where participant-only recordings require re-synthesizing both sides for controlled two-party evaluation, and PDCH-HAMD, comprising voice-converted real Chinese interviews for cross-lingual validation. Cascaded systems combine speaker diarization with role-assignment heuristics, so errors can propagate across stages. We propose an end-to-end model, which we named DiaWhisper, that fine-tunes Whisper-large-v3 with LoRA and an auxiliary frame-level role head for transcription and attribution, together with DiaWhisper-DPO, a failure-mined refinement that uses genuine decoding failures as DPO rejected completions without human preference annotation. On 29 DAIC-WOZ test sessions, DiaWhisper-DPO achieves 0.973 role accuracy and 0.119 DER, 72% below the strongest cascaded baseline, and reduces seed variation from σ = .205 to .002. Retrained on PDCH-HAMD, it achieves 0.757 role accuracy and improves all 78 session-seed pairs.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端模型DiaWhisper（LoRA微调Whisper-large-v3并附加帧级角色头）及其DPO精炼版本，实现访谈转写与说话人角色归属一体化。
AI.motivation: 自动化抑郁筛查需将临床访谈中每句话归属到医生或患者。级联方案（说话人分离+角色指派启发式）存在跨阶段误差传播；DAIC-WOZ仅含参与者单侧录音，需重合成双方以进行受控双人评测，且跨语言验证数据有限。
AI.method: 在DAIC-WOZ（重合成双人）与PDCH-HAMD（语音转换的真实中文访谈）两数据集上评测。DiaWhisper基于Whisper-large-v3加LoRA微调，并加辅助帧级角色预测头，联合完成转写与角色归属；DiaWhisper-DPO为失败挖掘式精炼，用真实解码失败作为DPO的拒绝样本，无需人工偏好标注。
AI.result: 在29个DAIC-WOZ测试会话上，DiaWhisper-DPO角色准确率0.973、DER 0.119，较最强级联基线降低72%；种子波动由σ=.205降至.002。在PDCH-HAMD上重训后角色准确率0.757，78个会话-种子配对全部提升。
AI.conclusion: 端到端联合建模可避免级联误差传播，显著提升角色归属精度并降低随机性；失败挖掘DPO无需偏好标注即可有效精炼，且具备跨语言可迁移性。

title: SAVTrack: Selective Vote Aggregation for Reliability-Aware Point Cloud Tracking
summary: 3D single object tracking (SOT) in LiDAR point clouds is essential for autonomous systems, but remains challenging under sparse and incomplete observations. In such cases, different target points provide highly uneven constraints on the object center, causing some point-to-center votes to be substantially less reliable than others. Existing point-based trackers typically aggregate these hypotheses without explicitly modeling their reliability, allowing inaccurate votes to contaminate proposal clustering and degrade localization accuracy. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SAVTrack}, a motion-aware tracking framework with \textbf{Selective Vote Aggregation (SAV)}. SAVTrack estimates the reliability of each candidate vote from both local seed features and inter-frame motion context, and removes low-confidence hypotheses before proposal clustering. This pre-aggregation gating prevents unreliable hypotheses from affecting cluster formation while introducing only modest computational overhead. SAVTrack achieves competitive performance on KITTI and nuScenes, reaching 68.4/87.4 and 58.44/69.82 Success/Precision, respectively, while running at 82 FPS. It retains fewer than one-sixth of the candidate votes used by dense aggregation and remains particularly effective under sparse target observations.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAVTrack，一种基于选择性投票聚合（SAV）的运动感知 3D 单目标跟踪框架，在聚类前剔除低置信度投票以提升 LiDAR 点云下的定位精度与效率。
AI.motivation: LiDAR 点云稀疏且不完整时，不同目标点对物体中心的约束严重不均，部分 point-to-center 投票可靠性显著偏低。现有基于点的跟踪器在聚合这些假设时未显式建模可靠性，导致不准确投票污染提议聚类并降低定位精度。
AI.method: SAVTrack 在聚合前引入 Selective Vote Aggregation（SAV）门控机制：同时利用局部种子特征与帧间运动上下文估计每个候选投票的可靠性，并在提议聚类前去除低置信度假设。该预聚合门控避免不可靠假设影响聚类形成，同时仅带来适度计算开销。
AI.result: 在 KITTI 与 nuScenes 上分别达到 68.4/87.4 与 58.44/69.82 的 Success/Precision，运行速度 82 FPS；仅保留密集聚合所需候选投票的不到六分之一，在目标观测稀疏场景下尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并筛选投票可靠性可在几乎不增加计算负担的前提下显著提升 3D SOT 的鲁棒性与效率，尤其适用于稀疏点云观测场景。

title: Bridging the Perceptual Gap: Residual-Enhanced Downscaling and Manifold-Aware Perception Alignment Adaptation for NR-IQA
summary: Leveraging Large Vision-Language Models like CLIP has recently set new benchmarks for No-Reference Image Quality Assessment (NR-IQA). However, the contrastive pretraining of CLIP inherently prioritizes semantic invariance, which often suppresses subtle perceptual signals, a phenomenon we term perceptual submergence. Furthermore, standard preprocessing techniques (e.g., cropping and interpolation) further exacerbate the loss of critical high-frequency quality cues. In this paper, we propose the Cross-modal Perception Alignment Adapter (CMPA), a manifold-aware framework designed to disentangle perceptual distortions from dominant semantics. CMPA introduces a Perception-Sensitive Feature Extractor (PFE) that projects CLIP features into a compact, low-dimensional subspace, explicitly magnifying distortion-induced off-manifold deviations. Subsequently, a Cross-Modal Perception Alignment Injector (PAI) aligns these features with quality-aware text anchors and re-injects them into the backbone. To ensure input fidelity, we also devise a Residual-enhanced Perceptual Downscaling strategy that adaptively compensates for resolution-induced information loss using Just Noticeable Difference (JND) guided frequency re-injection. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, effectively recovering the perceptual signals submerged in semantic-dense representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨模态感知对齐适配器（CMPA），通过流形感知框架从CLIP的语义主导表征中分离感知失真信号，在多个NR-IQA基准上显著超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: CLIP等大型视觉语言模型虽在无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）中刷新了基准，但其对比预训练本质上强调语义不变性，会抑制细微的感知信号（作者称之为"感知淹没"）；同时常规预处理（裁剪、插值）进一步加剧了关键高频质量线索的丢失。
AI.method: 提出CMPA框架，包含三个组件：(1) 感知敏感特征提取器（PFE），将CLIP特征投影到紧凑低维子空间，显式放大失真引起的离流形偏差；(2) 跨模态感知对齐注入器（PAI），将特征与质量感知文本锚点对齐并重注入主干网络；(3) 残差增强感知降采样策略，基于恰可察觉差异（JND）引导的频率重注入，自适应补偿分辨率导致的信息损失。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量评估表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法，有效恢复了淹没在语义密集表征中的感知信号。
AI.conclusion: CMPA通过流形感知的跨模态对齐与频率补偿降采样，成功解决了CLIP语义不变性导致的感知淹没问题，为NR-IQA提供了有效的感知信号恢复方案。

title: Lesion-centered 3D mapping of colonoscopy procedures: validation of a hierarchical ensemble pipeline on public benchmark videos
summary: Background and Objective: Colonoscopy recording practice preserves text reports and still photographs, while the spatial information already present in the recorded video - where the scope traveled, where a lesion was observed, and whether the same lesion was seen again - is discarded when the procedure ends. This study determines whether a lesion-centered spatial record can be assembled and validated without full-colon 3D reconstruction. Methods: A four-layer hierarchical pipeline was assembled - (1) a global topological map, (2) lesion-level spatio-temporal tracks, (3) on-demand local 3D reconstruction, and (4) persistent lesion identity across repeated observations - and ran end to end on four public videos (two C3VDv2 sequences with ground-truth depth and two full REAL-Colon procedures; 40,245 frames). All components are published, individually validated methods; the contribution is their lesion-centered assembly, linking rules, and evaluation. Results: Revisits, impossible under forward-only mapping by construction, were detected by entry-map Bayesian localization: 5,614 and 4,043 revisit events (56 and 68 distinct nodes) in the two full procedures. Lesion-identity merging at the adopted threshold 0.5 maintained ground-truth purity 1.0 while auto-merging 20 of 231 candidate pairs. The endoscopy-specific geometry engine outperformed a general-purpose foundation model on all metrics (overall absolute relative error (AbsRel) 0.2276 vs. 0.3523). Conclusions: The results are partial but establish a concrete near-term path: revisit detection, lesion identity, and local 3D each returned quantitative, reproducible output without waiting for complete geometric reconstruction; validating the record on clinical data is the next step.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建并验证了一套以病灶为中心的四层空间记录流程，证明在不进行全结肠3D重建的前提下，可实现回访检测、病灶身份合并与局部3D重建。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜记录目前仅保留文本报告与静态照片，而视频中已有的空间信息（镜身路径、病灶位置及是否再次观察到同一病灶）在检查结束后被丢弃。全文3D重建难度大，故探索无需完整几何重建即可构建病灶中心空间记录的可行性。
AI.method: 采用四层分层流程：(1) 全局拓扑地图；(2) 病灶级时空轨迹；(3) 按需局部3D重建；(4) 重复观察下的持久病灶身份。在四个公开视频（两个带真值深度的C3VDv2序列、两个完整REAL-Colon检查，共40,245帧）上端到端运行。各组件均为已发表且单独验证的方法，贡献在于以病灶为中心的组装、关联规则与评估。
AI.result: 基于入口图的贝叶斯定位检测到前向映射无法实现的回访事件，两例完整检查分别检出5,614与4,043次回访（56与68个不同节点）。在阈值0.5下，病灶身份合并保持真值纯度1.0，并自动合并231个候选对中的20对。内镜专用几何引擎在所有指标上优于通用基础模型（总体AbsRel 0.2276 vs. 0.3523）。
AI.conclusion: 结果虽为部分性，但确立了近期可行路径：回访检测、病灶身份与局部3D均能在不等待完整几何重建的情况下输出定量、可复现的结果；下一步是在临床数据上验证该记录。

title: MEgoVista: Multi-view Ego-aware Motion Estimation for Metric 4D Hands and Head in the Wild
summary: Learning manipulation from human video requires high-fidelity hand-motion reconstruction in metric units. Today's metric hand labels come from studio rigs and instrumented headsets, and both are confined in the same two ways: neither leaves a prepared setting, and neither is checked against an independent reference. Unconstrained head-worn recording promises the opposite trade-off, scaling with the number of people wearing a device. We therefore introduce MEgoVista, an offline pipeline that turns a single unprepared MEgo View recording into metric two-hand and head motion in one gravity-aligned world frame. Three properties set it apart from existing egocentric reconstruction systems: first, it reconstructs in settings studio volumes and tabletop rigs cannot reach, settling hand ownership at detection so bystander hands stay out of the wearer's trajectory; second, it takes its metric gauge from calibrated stereo rather than a monocular prior, installing scale at initialisation so policies receive physical units, not arbitrary coordinates; third, both outputs are scored inside a motion-capture volume against independent Chingmu optical capture, under a protocol that audits its own reference and charges what a method declines to predict. MEgoVista is offered as a measured route from egocentric video to metric hand supervision, one that widens where such labels can be gathered.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MEgoVista，一个离线流程，可将单段无准备的MEgo View（头戴式自视角）录像重建为同一重力对齐世界坐标系下的双手与头部的公制（米制）运动，并首次在动捕体积内用独立光学动捕对其进行自审计式评测。
AI.motivation: 从人类视频中学习操作技能需要以公制单位表示的高保真手部运动。现有公制手部标注依赖影棚设备与带仪器的头显，二者共享两大局限：都无法离开预置场景，也都未与独立参考进行校验。而无约束的头戴式录制可随佩戴设备人数扩展，正好提供相反的权衡。论文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: MEgoVista为离线流水线，输入单段未准备场景的MEgo View录像，输出统一重力对齐世界坐标系下的公制双手与头部运动。其三个关键设计为：(1) 在检测阶段即判定手部归属，使旁观者手部不进入佩戴者轨迹；(2) 以标定双目立体视觉而非单目先验确定公制尺度，在初始化时即植入比例，使下游策略获得物理单位而非任意坐标；(3) 两类输出均在动捕体积内、以独立Chingmu光学动捕为参考进行评分，评测协议对自身参考进行审计，并对方法"拒绝预测"的部分计入代价。
AI.result: （摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅给出结果性质：）MEgoVista可在影棚体积与桌面装置无法触达的场景中完成重建；其公制尺度来自标定双目而非单目先验；双手与头部输出均在动捕体积内、对照独立Chingmu光学动捕被评测，且评测协议包含参考审计与"拒答计费"机制。
AI.conclusion: MEgoVista被定位为一条经实测验证的、从自视角视频到公制手部监督信号的路径，拓展了此类标注可采集的场景范围；即将公开，作为从自视角视频获取公制手部监督的可度量方案。

title: Differentiable Mesh State Estimation via Factor Graph Inference for Deformable Object Reconstruction
summary: Estimating deformable object states remains a fundamental challenge in robotics and simulation. We propose a novel factor graph-based framework for probabilistic mesh state estimation of deformable objects. The method directly updates a tetrahedral mesh, a rich and physically-grounded representation of an environment, by combining physics priors, noisy sensor measurements, and temporal smoothness constraints within a unified probabilistic formulation. The estimation problem is posed as a nonlinear least-squares optimization and solved using Levenberg-Marquardt. Ex vivo central-airway obstruction experiments and simulations on deforming cube models demonstrate reliable and accurate reconstruction under both rigid motion and deformation, highlighting the potential of this probabilistic approach for principled, measurement-driven mesh state estimation in deformable object reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于因子图的概率框架，以四面体网格为状态表示，融合物理先验、噪声传感器测量与时间平滑约束，用非线性最小二乘与Levenberg-Marquardt优化实现可变形物体的网格状态估计。
AI.motivation: 可变形物体状态估计是机器人与仿真中的基础性难题；需要一种物理合理且能融合多源信息的表示与估计方法。
AI.method: 构建因子图框架，直接更新环境的四面体网格表示；在统一概率公式中融合物理先验、带噪传感器测量与时间平滑约束；将估计问题表述为非线性最小二乘，并用Levenberg-Marquardt求解。
AI.result: 离体中央气道阻塞实验与变形立方体模型的仿真表明，在刚体运动与形变两种情况下均能实现可靠且准确的重建。
AI.conclusion: 该概率方法在可变形物体重建中具有实现有原则的、测量驱动的网格状态估计的潜力。

title: Efficient Quantization-Aware Distillation with Cross-Modal Alignment for Edge Vision-Language Models
summary: Large-scale vision-language models (VLM) such as CLIP enable strong open-vocabulary reasoning, yet deploying these capabilities on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging. EdgeVL addresses this problem by distilling CLIP representations into lightweight multi-modal encoders and applying quantization-aware training (QAT) for efficient Open-Vocabulary Classification (OVC) on edge hardware. However, its two-stage optimization applies different objectives for distillation and QAT, and contrastive learning is performed within the quantized student space, which can result in inconsistent optimization and reduced training efficiency. Moreover, identical supervision across RGB and non-RGB modalities may lead to modality imbalance. We propose a unified framework for quantized semantic distillation tailored to edge deployment. By jointly optimizing distillation and quantization within a unified teacher-anchored framework, our method ensures consistent training under quantization, suppressing hard negatives and enlarging decision margins. Additionally, we design a lightweight cross-attention adapter that enhances non-RGB representations through RGB-guided semantic transfer, narrowing the modality gap. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements on non-RGB modalities while maintaining deployment efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出统一量化语义蒸馏框架，联合优化蒸馏与量化并引入RGB引导的轻量跨注意力适配器，提升边缘设备非RGB模态的开放词汇分类性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP等大规模视觉语言模型具备强开放词汇推理能力，但在资源受限边缘设备上部署困难。现有EdgeVL通过蒸馏CLIP表征并采用量化感知训练（QAT）实现边缘端开放词汇分类（OVC），但存在两个问题：其一，两阶段优化对蒸馏与QAT使用不同目标，且在量化后的学生空间内进行对比学习，导致优化不一致、训练效率降低；其二，RGB与非RGB模态使用相同监督信号，易造成模态不平衡。
AI.method: 提出面向边缘部署的统一量化语义蒸馏框架：在统一的"教师锚定"框架内联合优化蒸馏与量化，保证量化条件下训练的一致性，从而抑制难负样本并扩大决策间隔；同时设计轻量级跨注意力适配器，通过RGB引导的语义迁移增强非RGB模态表征，缩小模态间差距。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在非RGB模态上取得一致性提升，同时保持了部署效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过在统一教师锚定框架中联合蒸馏与量化、并以RGB引导适配器弥合模态差距，可有效改善量化条件下边缘端多模态开放词汇分类的性能与训练效率。

title: Efficient 3D Whole-Body PET Image Denoising via Conditional Rectified Flow With Optimized Sampling Strategy
summary: Reducing radiation exposure in Positron Emission Tomography (PET) is important for patient safety; however, ultra-low-dose imaging suffers from severe noise, which may affect diagnostic interpretation without appropriate image enhancement. While current 3D deep generative models, particularly diffusion models, have shown strong reconstruction fidelity, their practical use can be limited by long inference times. In contrast, faster 2D-based alternatives may have difficulty maintaining volumetric consistency, an important consideration for whole-body PET imaging analysis. To bridge this gap, we propose a one-pass conditional 3D rectified flow (3D Flow) framework for whole-body PET image denoising that incorporates a novel optimized non-uniform sampling strategy. The model is trained with a one-pass linear-interpolant velocity-matching objective. This approach reconstructs a full 3D volume in approximately 30 seconds in our implementation, compared with multi-hour inference for the evaluated 3D DDPM baseline. Evaluations including zero-shot transfer to an independent clinical dataset show that our model achieves favorable global image quality and lesion conspicuity compared with the evaluated 3D DDPM and DDIM baselines, including on challenging short-acquisition data. Furthermore, the proposed method shows promising zero-shot transfer performance across the evaluated datasets and unseen dose levels (down to 1/100 of the standard dose), with artifact-focused visual comparisons supporting the need for further lesion-level validation. By balancing reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency, this work presents a candidate approach for ultra-low-dose whole-body PET image denoising.

AI.tldr: 提出一次性条件3D整流流（3D Flow）框架，结合优化的非均匀采样策略，实现全身PET超低剂量图像去噪，约30秒重建完整3D体数据，在全局图像质量与病灶可见度上优于3D DDPM/DDIM基线，并展现跨数据集与极低剂量（低至标准剂量1/100）的零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 降低PET辐射暴露对患者安全至关重要，但超低剂量成像噪声严重。现有3D深度生成模型（尤其扩散模型）重建保真度高，却推理耗时极长；更快的2D方法又难以保持体数据一致性，而全身PET分析对体积一致性要求高。因此需要兼顾重建保真度与计算效率的方法。
AI.method: 提出一次性（one-pass）条件3D整流流框架用于全身PET去噪，采用新颖的优化非均匀采样策略；模型以一次性线性插值速度匹配目标进行训练。
AI.result: 实现中约30秒重建完整3D体数据，而所评估的3D DDPM基线需数小时推理。包含对独立临床数据集零样本迁移的评估显示，在全局图像质量和病灶可见度上优于所评估的3D DDPM与DDIM基线，在具有挑战性的短采集数据上亦然。方法在所评估数据集与未见剂量水平（低至标准剂量的1/100）上展现出有前景的零样本迁移性能，聚焦伪影的视觉对比支持进一步开展病灶级验证的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在重建保真度与计算效率之间取得平衡，本工作为超低剂量全身PET图像去噪提供了一种候选方法。

title: MAETrack: Unleashing the Potential of Pretrained Geometric Priors for 3D Single Object Tracking
summary: Large-scale pre-training has transformed representation learning in 2D vision, yet its transferability to 3D single object tracking (SOT) remains insufficiently understood. Directly fine-tuning self-supervised 3D encoders, such as masked autoencoders (MAE), often leads to sub-optimal adaptation because the reconstruction objective is not fully aligned with the spatial-temporal matching requirements of tracking. In this paper, we observe that this difficulty can be interpreted as a layer-wise transfer mismatch: shallow layers tend to preserve transferable geometric cues, while deeper layers become increasingly specialized to the reconstruction pretext task and are less suitable for downstream tracking. Based on this observation, we propose MAETrack, a lightweight adaptation framework for transferring pre-training MAE representations to 3D SOT. MAETrack includes Layer-Selective Initialization (LSI), which initializes only the shallow stages of the tracking backbone from pre-trained weights while re-initializing deeper stages, and Geometric Residual Gating (GRG), which reinforces structurally salient regions in the search BEV features before template-search fusion through residual spatial modulation. Extensive experiments on standard 3D SOT benchmarks show that MAETrack consistently improves upon vanilla fine-tuning baselines with limited computational overhead. More broadly, our results suggest that effective transfer from 3D reconstruction pre-training to 3D tracking is not merely a matter of partial fine-tuning, but depends on a tracking-oriented transfer principle that preserves shallow geometry while adapting deeper representations to the downstream objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAETrack：一个轻量适配框架，将3D MAE预训练表示迁移至3D单目标跟踪，通过浅层选择性初始化与几何残差门控，缓解重建预训练与跟踪任务间的层级迁移失配。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练在2D视觉表征学习中成效显著，但其向3D单目标跟踪（SOT）的迁移性尚不明确。直接微调自监督3D编码器（如MAE）往往适配次优，因为重建目标与跟踪所需的时空匹配需求并不对齐。
AI.method: 作者将该困难归结为层级迁移失配：浅层保留可迁移的几何线索，深层则日益专精于重建预训练任务而不适合下游跟踪。据此提出MAETrack：包含层选择性初始化（LSI），仅用预训练权重初始化跟踪骨干的浅层阶段、对深层阶段重新初始化；以及几何残差门控（GRG），在模板-搜索融合前通过残差空间调制强化搜索BEV特征中的结构显著区域。
AI.result: 在标准3D SOT基准上的大量实验表明，MAETrack在有限计算开销下持续优于朴素微调基线。
AI.conclusion: 从3D重建预训练到3D跟踪的有效迁移不仅是部分微调的问题，而是取决于一种面向跟踪的迁移原则：保留浅层几何信息，同时使深层表示适配下游目标。

title: VideoMM: Adaptive Macro-Micro Inference for Efficient Video MLLMs
summary: Scaling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to long-form video understanding is bottlenecked by the explosion of visual tokens, which saturates context windows and incurs prohibitive costs. Current solutions predominantly rely on auxiliary models for token reduction but face a fundamental dilemma: lightweight encoder-driven approaches often overlook critical semantic information, whereas heavyweight MLLM-driven reduction negates the efficiency gains. {In this work, we identify a more fundamental inefficiency underlying this dilemma: while fine-grained visual details are essential for detailed understanding, they are largely redundant for the preliminary task of selecting semantically relevant regions. } Motivated by this, we introduce \textbf{VideoMM}, which marks a paradigm shift from model-centric downsizing to adaptive perceptual granularity. Specifically, our framework {decouples selection from reasoning} by executing semantic filtering on a cost-effective \textit{Macro Proxy} (derived from downscaled frames), and projecting the selected regions onto high-fidelity \textit{Micro Tokens} for detailed understanding only when necessary. Extensive evaluations show that VideoMM significantly outperforms existing solutions. It achieves a 6.13$\times$ speedup and a 7.4\% accuracy gain over full-context baselines on LongVideoBench, and further accelerates inference by 2.73$\times$ over current leading methods, establishing a highly scalable paradigm for long-video understanding. Our code is available at: https://github.com/adfh917k/VideoMM.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoMM框架，通过解耦选择与推理、采用自适应感知粒度（Macro Proxy筛选 + Micro Tokens精细理解）来突破长视频理解中视觉Token爆炸的瓶颈，实现显著加速与精度提升。
AI.motivation: 将多模态大语言模型扩展到长视频理解的核心瓶颈是视觉Token数量爆炸，会占满上下文窗口并带来高昂成本。现有基于辅助模型的Token缩减方案存在两难：轻量编码器驱动方法常忽略关键语义信息，而重量级MLLM驱动方法又抵消了效率收益。本文指出这一两难背后的更根本低效：细粒度视觉细节对细节理解必不可少，但对"选择语义相关区域"这一初步任务而言大多是冗余的。
AI.method: VideoMM实现了从"以模型为中心的下采样"到"自适应感知粒度"的范式转变。其核心是通过解耦选择与推理：先在低成本Macro Proxy（由降采样帧得到）上执行语义筛选，仅在必要时将选中区域投影到高保真Micro Tokens上进行细节理解。
AI.result: 大量评估显示VideoMM显著优于现有方案：在LongVideoBench上相比全上下文基线实现6.13倍加速和7.4%的精度提升，并比当前领先方法进一步加速推理2.73倍。
AI.conclusion: VideoMM确立了长视频理解的可扩展新范式，证明按需分配感知粒度能在保持细节理解能力的同时大幅提升效率与精度。代码已开源。

title: PriorPose: Reference-Guided Joint Deformation and Alignment for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level object pose estimation seeks to recover a similarity transform $(R,t,s)$ for unseen instances without instance-specific CAD models. Most competitive methods are correspondence-based: prior-free variants regress canonical (NOCS) coordinates directly from local observations and implicitly memorize the canonical frame in the weights, which ties the parameters to category-typical orientations and hurts generalization under distribution shift; prior-based variants introduce a category prior but typically follow a serial deform-then-align pipeline, where underconstrained canonical completion can corrupt correspondences and induce error cascades in pose. We propose PriorPose, a reference-guided correspondence framework that keeps the category prior explicit and solves canonicalization and alignment jointly in a shared feature space. A reference-guided seeded transformer embeds the partial observation and the category prior as token sets and fuses them via geometry-aware seeds, from which the network jointly predicts a per-point NOCS field for visible points and a canonical deformation of the prior that reconstructs a full canonical instance, while a deep pose head regresses $(R,t,s)$ from the induced correspondences. A two-part shape consistency objective, with canonical-space and camera-space consistency losses, couples correspondence, deformation, and pose, reducing reliance on memorized canonical orientations and avoiding deform-then-align error cascades. Experiments on standard and larger-category benchmarks demonstrate that PriorPose sets new state-of-the-art results on most evaluated metrics, especially under strict pose thresholds, while remaining competitive on relaxed pose and IoU metrics and showing improved robustness under shape variation and domain shift.

AI.tldr: PriorPose 提出一种参考引导的对应关系框架，将类别先验显式保留，并在共享特征空间中联合求解规范化与对齐，从而提升类别级物体位姿估计的泛化性与精度。
AI.motivation: 现有对应关系方法存在两类问题：无先验方法直接从局部观测回归 NOCS 坐标并在权重中隐式记忆规范坐标系，导致参数与类别典型朝向绑定，在分布偏移下泛化差；有先验方法采用串行的"先形变后对齐"流程，欠约束的规范补全易破坏对应关系并引发位姿误差级联。
AI.method: 提出 PriorPose：（1）参考引导的种子化 Transformer，将部分观测与类别先验编码为 token 集合并通过几何感知种子融合；（2）网络联合预测可见点的逐点 NOCS 场与先验的规范形变，重建完整规范实例；（3）深度位姿头由诱导对应关系回归 (R,t,s)；（4）两部分形状一致性目标（规范空间与相机空间一致性损失）耦合对应、形变与位姿。
AI.result: 在标准及更大类别基准上，PriorPose 在多数评价指标上取得新的最优结果，尤其在严格位姿阈值下表现突出；在宽松位姿与 IoU 指标上保持竞争力，并在形状变化与域偏移下展现更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式保留类别先验并联合求解规范化与对齐，结合形状一致性约束，PriorPose 有效降低了对记忆化规范朝向的依赖并避免了"先形变后对齐"的误差级联，实现了类别级位姿估计的精度与鲁棒性提升。

title: LSREP: A Longitudinal State-Replay Protocol for Evaluating Conversational Memory, with ICE v2 as an Audited Local-First Architecture
comment: 37 pages. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/Deepnar/ice. The exact system snapshot used for the reported results is preserved in the "v2-paper-eval" tagged release
summary: Conversational memory changes during use, so endpoint question answering alone cannot establish how a persistent state accumulates, ages, or incorporates revisions. We introduce LSREP, a Longitudinal State-Replay Evaluation Protocol combining ordered replay, explicit lifecycle schedules, repeated probes, evolving reference answers, and mechanism-fidelity checks. Its architectural case study is ICE v2, a local-first memory middleware with typed stores, retrieval fusion, and dynamic context budgets. The private, single-user instantiation contains 1,985 turns, 219 distinct probes, and 1,211 probe-checkpoint observations across 52 checkpoints. On three ordinary-density datasets, ICE v2 has a near-zero mean quality difference from vector-RAG while selecting 32% fewer fragments but using 6.6% more estimated prompt tokens. A fourth, dense dataset exposes catastrophic failures of the unbudgeted baseline. The fidelity audit limits attribution: procedural retrieval is defective, several mechanisms are unexercised, and graph utility is not established. In a complementary matched public diagnostic, ICE v2 loses decisively to pure vector-RAG on LongMemEval: 50.8% versus 72.8% in the evidence-only oracle and 43.0% versus 69.5% in full-S. Paired differences are -22.0 points (95% CI [-26.6, -17.4]) and -26.5 ([-31.3, -21.8]). Conservative abstention accompanies severe multi-session and temporal failures. ICE uses less context in this diagnostic, establishing a quality-cost trade-off rather than superior efficiency. Together, replay, fidelity auditing, and public endpoint testing expose distinct failure modes that neither architectural descriptions nor aggregate scores identify alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LSREP（纵向状态回放评估协议），融合有序回放、生命周期调度、重复探测、演化参考答案与机制保真审计，并以本地优先记忆中间件 ICE v2 为架构案例研究。结果显示：常规密度数据集上 ICE v2 与向量 RAG 质量差异近零且选取片段少 32%，但在密集数据集与公开 LongMemEval 诊断中显著落后。
AI.motivation: 会话记忆在使用过程中持续变化，仅依靠端点问答无法刻画持久状态如何累积、老化与修订。既有架构描述与聚合分数均无法单独揭示记忆系统的真实失效模式，因此需要一种能够追踪状态演化的纵向评估方法。
AI.method: 提出 LSREP 协议，包含五要素：有序回放、显式生命周期调度、重复探测、演化参考答案、机制保真检查。以 ICE v2（本地优先记忆中间件，具备类型化存储、检索融合、动态上下文预算）为案例，构建私有单用户实例：1,985 轮对话、219 个独立探测、52 个检查点上的 1,211 次探测-检查点观测；并补充匹配的公开诊断（LongMemEval）进行端点对比。
AI.result: 三个常规密度数据集上，ICE v2 相对向量 RAG 质量差异近零，选取片段少 32%，但估计提示 token 多 6.6%；第四个密集数据集暴露无预算基线的灾难性失效。保真审计显示：程序化检索存在缺陷、若干机制未被触发、图结构效用未获证实。LongMemEval 上 ICE v2 明显落后：证据仅 oracle 下 50.8% vs 72.8%，full-S 下 43.0% vs 69.5%；配对差异分别为 -22.0 点（95% CI [-26.6, -17.4]）与 -26.5（[-31.3, -21.8]），并伴随保守弃答及严重的多会话与时序失效。ICE 使用更少上下文，说明这是质量-成本权衡而非效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 回放、保真审计与公开端点测试三者结合，可暴露架构描述和聚合分数单独都无法识别的不同失效模式。LSREP 为会话记忆系统的纵向评估提供了可复用的方法论，并提示多机制记忆架构的实际收益需经机制级验证。

title: Visual Cue Guided Video Planning for Generalizable Robot Navigation
summary: Generative video models can serve as a promising backbone for robot navigation by predicting future observations as video plans. Recent approaches often condition video planning on short-horizon guidance and recover geometric waypoints through scene reconstruction, leaving longer-horizon planning and precise video-to-action translation less explored. We present CueNav, a video model-based navigation framework combining visual cue guided video planning with an embodiment-specific Inverse-Dynamics Model (IDM). As visual cues, we use a Bird's-Eye View (BEV) map to convey global task context and retain part of the robot body in the egocentric observation to expose embodiment context. These cues guide the video planner, while the IDM translates dense flow fields extracted from the video plan into robot actions. With the visual cue encoding global task context, CueNav achieves nearly 2x higher success in maze navigation than planning without the cue. The body-aware view with the IDM enables precise navigation with 70% success in a narrow passage where comparison methods largely fail to complete the task. We further demonstrate zero-shot semantic-conditioned navigation and deployment of the same video planner across different robot platforms. Our results show that visual cue-guided video planning with embodiment-specific action grounding paves the way toward a generalizable navigation framework for longer-horizon planning and embodiment-aware control. Additional results and code are available on our project website: https://cuenav.github.io.

AI.tldr: CueNav：以视觉线索引导视频规划，并用特定本体的逆动力学模型将视频计划转为机器人动作，实现长时程、本体感知的导航。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成式视频模型的导航方法多依赖短时程引导，并通过场景重建恢复几何路点，导致长时程规划与精确的视频到动作转换研究不足。
AI.method: 提出CueNav框架：以鸟瞰图（BEV）地图提供全局任务上下文、在自视角观测中保留部分机器人本体以暴露本体信息作为视觉线索；由这些线索引导视频规划器，再用本体特定的逆动力学模型（IDM）将从视频计划中提取的稠密光流场翻译为机器人动作。
AI.result: 在迷宫导航中成功率约为无线索规划的2倍；在狭窄通道中结合本体感知视角与IDM达到70%成功率，而对比方法基本无法完成；并展示了零样本语义条件导航及同一视频规划器跨不同机器人平台的部署。
AI.conclusion: 视觉线索引导的视频规划配合本体特定的动作接地，为可泛化的长时程规划与本体感知控制导航框架提供了可行路径。项目网站：https://cuenav.github.io。

title: Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation: A Conversational Benchmark for Safe Stroke Care in Japanese Using Large Language Models
summary: Background: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved physician-comparable performance on multiple-choice medical knowledge examinations, but their capabilities in clinical history taking, urgency assessment, and safety remain insufficiently evaluated. We proposed Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation, a multi-turn conversational benchmark for stroke care in Japanese, and evaluated LLM performance and safety under practice-oriented conditions. Methods: We created 10 stroke and related-condition cases and evaluated LLMs in multi-turn Japanese conversations. The LLM acted as physician, while a board-certified neurosurgeon acted as simulated patient and evaluator. Each case comprised history-taking and action phases scored using pre-specified criteria. Errors that could directly threaten life were defined as critical mistakes. The safety threshold was at least 80% overall with zero critical mistakes. Eighteen models were evaluated in October 2025 and June 2026. Results: Claude Fable 5 achieved the highest score (87.4%) with zero critical mistakes, followed by Claude Opus 4.7 (80.3%) and GLM-5.2 (75.6%). Two leaders met the safety threshold. Eleven models made 17 critical mistakes, including failure to confirm laboratory results or blood glucose before t-PA, surgery before airway stabilization, omission of cervical vascular evaluation, and t-PA outside its indication. History-taking question count correlated with history-taking score (r = 0.648, p = 0.007). Conclusions: Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation provides a benchmark for LLM performance under practice-oriented conditions, including a cap on history-taking questions. Cases and evaluations were created by neurosurgical specialists rather than using an LLM-as-judge approach. Performance improved across cloud-based and on-premise models in 2026, with some exceeding the safety threshold. Further evaluation using real-world cases is required.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出日本卒中LLM评测（Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation），一个基于多轮日语对话的卒中诊疗基准，用以评估LLM在病史采集、紧急度判断和安全性方面的表现，并设定总体≥80%且零致命错误的阈值。
AI.motivation: LLM在医学多选题考试中已达到接近医师水平，但其在临床病史采集、紧急度评估与安全性方面的能力评估不足，缺乏贴近实践（practice-oriented）的评测方式。
AI.method: 构建10个卒中及相关疾病病例，以多轮日语对话形式评测：LLM扮演医生，神经外科专科医师扮演模拟患者并担任评估者。每例含病史采集与处置两个阶段，按预设标准评分；将可直接威胁生命的错误定义为critical mistake，安全阈值为总体≥80%且零致命错误。共18个模型于2025年10月和2026年6月两次评测。
AI.result: Claude Fable 5得分最高（87.4%）且零致命错误，其次为Claude Opus 4.7（80.3%）与GLM-5.2（75.6%），仅两个模型达到安全阈值。11个模型共出现17次致命错误，包括t-PA前未确认化验或血糖、气道未稳定即手术、遗漏颈动脉血管评估、超适应证使用t-PA。病史采集提问数与病史采集得分相关（r=0.648，p=0.007）。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供了贴近实践条件（含提问数上限）下的LLM评测方法，病例与评估由神经外科专家完成而非采用LLM-as-judge。2026年云端与本地部署模型均有提升，部分超过安全阈值；仍需基于真实世界病例的进一步评估。

title: TIAO: Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization for Text Summarization
summary: Text summarization requires models to condense content while preserving key qualities such as consistency and coherence. Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on this task and can be further improved through reinforcement learning (RL). However, most existing methods apply reward signals directly to undifferentiated token sequences, overlooking the varying importance of individual tokens to word and sentence level quality in summarization. In this paper, we propose Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization (TIAO), a novel reinforcement learning strategy that explicitly leverages token-importance awareness. Specifically, TIAO identifies core tokens based on token dependency and reweights a trajectory's advantage according to its overall dependencies. Experiments on the real world dataset show that our TIAO achieves highly competitive results, and that a 7B foundation model enhanced by TIAO performs comparably to GPT-4 and GPT-5-nano. Code is available at https://github.com/TechCloud-x/TIAO

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIAO（Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization），一种显式利用token重要性感知的强化学习策略，用于文本摘要任务。TIAO基于token依赖关系识别核心token，并根据轨迹的整体依赖对优势进行重加权。实验表明7B基座模型经TIAO增强后可媲美GPT-4与GPT-5-nano。
AI.motivation: 文本摘要要求模型在压缩内容的同时保持一致性、连贯性等关键质量。大语言模型（LLM）在该任务上表现强劲，并可通过强化学习进一步提升。然而现有方法大多将奖励信号直接施加于未加区分的token序列上，忽视了单个token对摘要中词级与句级质量的差异化重要性。
AI.method: 提出Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization（TIAO），一种显式利用token重要性感知的强化学习策略。具体而言，TIAO基于token依赖关系识别核心token，并根据轨迹的整体依赖对其优势（advantage）进行重加权。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，TIAO取得了极具竞争力的结果，且经TIAO增强的7B基座模型性能可与GPT-4和GPT-5-nano相媲美。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入token重要性感知并对优势进行依赖加权重加权，TIAO有效改进了基于RL的摘要生成；以较小规模基座模型即可达到先进大模型的水平，验证了细粒度token重要性建模在摘要强化学习中的价值。

title: TAME: Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent misalignment
summary: Fine-tuning an aligned language model on narrow, flawed data can induce harmful behavior far outside the training domain, known as emergent misalignment (EM). Prior work has localized EM in model weights, activations, and training documents, but it remains unclear which training tokens carry the relevant fine-tuning signal. We introduce TAME (Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent Misalignment), a three-stage framework: token attribution scores how strongly the fine-tuning update raises each response token's likelihood, using forward passes through a released LoRA adapter; signal characterization finds patterns among high-attribution tokens; and causal validation tests them by attribution-guided loss masking. On released EM organisms and a 6,849-example medical-advice split, attribution is concentrated (the top 5% of tokens hold 32% of the mass) and, in Llama, depleted for medical vocabulary but enriched for a register of unwarranted certainty, even after controlling for token rarity. Masking high-attribution tokens during fresh fine-tuning cuts EM by 23x in Llama and 36x in Qwen, with the perplexity cost concentrated on the targeted register rather than on medical content; an equal random mask leaves EM unchanged. In Llama, the attribution pattern suggests that EM-relevant signal lies more in how confidently flawed content is expressed than in its domain vocabulary; the causal masking effect itself holds across both model families.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TAME 框架，通过 token 归因、信号刻画与因果验证三阶段，定位并抑制微调中引发涌现失准（EM）的关键 token，归因引导的掩码可将 EM 降低 23–36 倍。
AI.motivation: 在对齐语言模型上用狭窄且有缺陷的数据微调，会引发训练域之外的涌现失准（EM）。已有工作虽在权重、激活和训练文档层面定位了 EM，但尚不清楚哪些训练 token 承载了相关微调信号，因此需要 token 级别的归因与因果验证。
AI.method: 提出 TAME 三阶段框架：(1) token 归因，利用已发布的 LoRA 适配器的前向传播，为每个响应 token 打分，衡量微调更新对其似然的提升强度；(2) 信号刻画，在高归因 token 中寻找模式；(3) 因果验证，通过归因引导的损失掩码进行测试。实验在已发布的 EM organisms 与一个 6,849 样本的医疗建议划分上进行，并对比随机等量掩码。
AI.result: 归因高度集中：前 5% token 占 32% 的质量。在 Llama 中，医疗词汇归因较低，而无端确定性语域归因较高，且控制了 token 稀有度后仍成立。重新微调时掩码高归因 token，使 Llama 的 EM 降低 23 倍、Qwen 降低 36 倍，困惑度代价集中在目标语域而非医疗内容；等量随机掩码则对 EM 无影响。掩码的因果效应在两个模型家族中均成立。
AI.conclusion: 在 Llama 中，归因模式表明 EM 相关信号更多存在于缺陷内容被表达时的确定性方式，而非其领域词汇；因果掩码效应本身跨模型家族稳健。TAME 为 token 级 EM 机制定位与干预提供了可行方法。

title: Parser, Chunking, and Embedding Interactions in Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Indian Government Regulatory Documents
comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Retrieval-only factorial evaluation with supplementary ablations and reproducibility materials
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines are typically assembled from independently-chosen components -- a document parser, a chunking strategy, and an embedding model -- yet these choices are rarely evaluated jointly, and evaluations that do combine them are usually run on a single document or corpus. We present a controlled factorial study of 3 parsers, 3 chunking strategies, and 5 dense embedding models, together with a sparse BM25 baseline, evaluated against 800 question instances, each with one or more required evidence strings, with evidence strings automatically validated against source text and a 10% random sample manually reviewed, across four structurally distinct Indian central-government regulatory documents. We fit linear mixed-effects models with document-query-level random intercepts to the resulting 72,000-row result set, run Holm-corrected paired comparisons between matched dense and sparse configurations, and report clustered bootstrap confidence intervals for all 54 unique retriever configurations. We find that no single retriever family dominates across documents; parser and chunker choice interact significantly; MPNet-base is a consistent underperformer with a severe failure mode on table-derived questions; and the corpus exhibits a near-saturated evidence-preservation ceiling above 98%, indicating that retrieval differences are driven primarily by ranking quality rather than information loss during ingestion. We additionally report embedding-dimension and chunk-size/overlap ablations and an efficiency/quality Pareto analysis. We release our full evaluation harness, corpus manifest, and 800-question benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文对RAG流水线中的3种解析器、3种分块策略与5种稠密嵌入模型（另加BM25稀疏基线）进行了受控析因实验，在4份结构各异的印度中央政府监管文档、800个带证据串的问题实例上评估，产出72,000行结果，并用线性混合效应模型与Holm校正配对比较进行分析。
AI.motivation: RAG流水线通常由独立挑选的组件（文档解析器、分块策略、嵌入模型）拼装而成，但这些选择很少被联合评估；即便有联合评估，也往往只在单一文档或语料上运行，结论的外部效度不足。本文旨在通过受控析因设计，系统刻画组件选择及其交互在多文档场景下对检索质量的影响。
AI.method: 采用受控析因设计：3解析器 × 3分块策略 × 5稠密嵌入模型，并加入稀疏BM25基线；构建800个问题实例，每个问题含一个或多个必需证据串，证据串先经源文本自动校验，再对10%随机样本进行人工复核；语料为4份结构显著不同的印度中央政府监管文档。对生成的72,000行结果集拟合带文档-查询级随机截距的线性混合效应模型，对匹配的稠密-稀疏配置做Holm校正配对比较，并为全部54种唯一检索器配置报告聚类自助法置信区间。另附嵌入维度、块大小/重叠的消融实验以及效率-质量帕累托分析。
AI.result: 没有任何单一检索器族在所有文档上占优；解析器与分块器选择存在显著交互作用；MPNet-base稳定表现不佳，在表格类问题上存在严重失效模式；语料证据保留率接近饱和上限（高于98%），说明检索差异主要源于排序质量而非摄取阶段的信息丢失。
AI.conclusion: RAG组件应被联合而非孤立地评估，且需跨多文档验证；由于证据保留已近饱和，优化重点应放在排序质量与组件交互上。作者公开完整评估框架、语料清单与800题基准，以支持可复现的联合评估研究。

title: De-GAN - Dynamic Parameter Tuned GAN for 3D Medical Image Segmentation: A Step Towards Generalisation
summary: Brain tumor segmentation remains difficult because enhancing tumor (ET) has low contrast and overlaps surrounding tissue, while scanner and site variation causes domain shift. We propose DE-GAN, a contrast-enhancing conditional GAN that combines input-adaptive dynamic convolutions, style-aware feature mixing, and coordinate encoding to synthesize slice-adaptive FLAIR images. A label-guided, class-conditional target separates tumor-core (TC) and ET intensities while preserving anatomy. The generated FLAIR is concatenated with the original MR modalities and used to train a 3D U-Net. Across BraTS 2015, 2018, and 2019, DE-GAN improves segmentation over the baseline and static EnhGAN replacement on most reported TC/ET metrics, with the largest gains from retaining both original and enhanced FLAIR. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/zkhansuri-ui/DE-GAN.

AI.tldr: 提出DE-GAN，一种对比度增强的条件GAN，通过输入自适应动态卷积、风格感知特征混合和坐标编码合成切片自适应的FLAIR图像，与原始MR模态拼接后训练3D U-Net，在BraTS 2015/2018/2019上提升TC/ET分割性能。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤分割困难：增强肿瘤（ET）对比度低且与周围组织重叠；同时扫描仪和站点差异导致域偏移，影响分割模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出DE-GAN，一种对比度增强的条件GAN，融合输入自适应动态卷积、风格感知特征混合和坐标编码以合成切片自适应FLAIR图像；采用标签引导的类条件目标分离肿瘤核心（TC）与ET强度，同时保留解剖结构；生成的FLAIR与原始MR模态拼接，用于训练3D U-Net。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2015、2018和2019上，DE-GAN在多数TC/ET指标上优于基线和静态EnhGAN替换方案，其中同时保留原始FLAIR与增强FLAIR带来的增益最大。
AI.conclusion: DE-GAN通过合成对比度增强的FLAIR图像缓解ET低对比度与域偏移问题，验证了保留原始与增强FLAIR双重输入的策略有效性，代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Multi-View Optical Satellite Imagery via Reliability-Aware Height-Evidence Fusion in Gaussian Splatting
summary: Robust 3D reconstruction from multi-view optical satellite imagery requires fusing complementary but sometimes conflicting geometric evidence. Digital surface models (DSMs) are the primary elevation representations for satellite-based 3D reconstruction, making reliable height estimation essential. However, in a Gaussian scene representation jointly optimized from multiple views, Gaussian responses at different elevations can support competing height hypotheses at the same rendered location, while conventional alpha-weighted elevation aggregation may produce intermediate elevations that do not correspond to physical surfaces. To address this challenge, we formulate DSM reconstruction as a reliability-aware height-hypothesis fusion problem and propose HLC-GS, a reliability-aware Height-Layer Consistency Gaussian Splatting framework for multi-view satellite 3D reconstruction. HLC-GS organizes projected Gaussian responses into candidate height hypotheses and evaluates their relative support using layer competition and Gaussian footprint support. A continuous height-layer risk map guides dominant-layer reliability correction and secondary-layer suppression during optimization. The proposed training strategy regulates conflicting Gaussian responses within the shared representation to improve the reliability of reconstructed surface elevations. Experiments on seven scenes from the DFC2019 and IARPA2016 datasets demonstrate improved DSM reconstruction accuracy. Compared with EOGS, HLC-GS reduces the average DSM MAE from 1.46~m to 1.18~m and RMSE from 2.78~m to 2.58~m, while increasing PAG$_{2.5}$ from 86.09\% to 88.61\%, with comparable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 HLC-GS，一种可靠性感知的高度层一致性高斯泼溅框架，将 DSM 重建建模为高度假设融合问题，在 DFC2019 和 IARPA2016 数据集上提升多视卫星 DSM 重建精度。
AI.motivation: 多视光学卫星影像的三维重建需融合互补但有时冲突的几何证据。DSM 是卫星三维重建的主要高程表示，可靠的高度估计至关重要。然而在多视联合优化的高斯场景表示中，同一渲染位置处不同高程的高斯响应可能支持相互竞争的高度假设，而传统的 alpha 加权高程聚合会产生不代表真实物理表面的中间高程。
AI.method: 将 DSM 重建形式化为可靠性感知的高度假设融合问题，提出 HLC-GS 框架。该方法将投影的高斯响应组织为候选高度假设，通过层竞争与高斯足迹支持度评估其相对支撑强度；利用连续的高度层风险图引导主导层可靠性校正与次层抑制，从而在共享表示内调控冲突的高斯响应，提升重建表面高程的可靠性。
AI.result: 在 DFC2019 与 IARPA2016 数据集的七个场景上验证，DSM 重建精度提升。相比 EOGS，平均 DSM MAE 从 1.46 m 降至 1.18 m，RMSE 从 2.78 m 降至 2.58 m，PAG_2.5 从 86.09% 提升至 88.61%，计算开销相当。
AI.conclusion: HLC-GS 通过可靠性感知的高度层一致性建模与冲突响应调控，有效缓解中间高程与竞争假设问题，在几乎不增加计算成本的前提下提升多视卫星 DSM 重建精度。

title: FSANet: Frequency-Spatial Aware Network for Image Segmentation
summary: Image segmentation remains challenging due to occlusions, poor lighting, and irregular structures. Although transformer-based methods achieve high accuracy, they rely heavily on long-range spatial features, leading to high computational costs and neglecting prior knowledge or noise patterns, resulting in missing details and unclear boundaries. To address these issues, we propose Frequency Spatial Aware Network (FSANet), which integrates prior knowledge with a dual-domain solver to sequentially adapt to diverse segmentation tasks. Specifically, we design three key modules: (1) Structure Prior Module, which recovers overlooked details; (2) Dual-Domain Awareness Module, which captures salient features while disentangling noise; and (3) Edge Estimation Module, which enhances edge awareness for more precise segmentation. In addition, the limited availability of comprehensive segmentation datasets covering various real-world scenarios hinders the performance of existing methods. To address this, we introduce SceneX, a novel open-source dataset featuring 10 challenging non-ideal scenarios, establishing a new benchmark for evaluating and improving the robustness and real-world applicability of the segmentation models. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of FSANet.

AI.tldr: 提出 FSANet（频域-空域感知网络），融合先验知识与双域求解器提升分割鲁棒性，并发布覆盖 10 类非理想场景的新数据集 SceneX。
AI.motivation: 图像分割受遮挡、弱光和结构不规则影响；Transformer 方法依赖长程空间特征，计算开销大，且忽视先验知识与噪声模式，导致细节缺失、边界模糊。同时，覆盖多种真实场景的综合性分割数据集稀缺，限制了现有方法性能。
AI.method: FSANet 结合先验知识与双域求解器以顺序适应不同分割任务，包含三个模块：(1) Structure Prior Module 恢复被忽略的细节；(2) Dual-Domain Awareness Module 在捕捉显著特征的同时解耦噪声；(3) Edge Estimation Module 增强边缘感知以获得更精确分割。此外构建开源数据集 SceneX，包含 10 类具有挑战性的非理想场景，作为评估与提升模型鲁棒性和真实适用性的新基准。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了 FSANet 的高效性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: FSANet 通过先验与双域感知结合缓解细节丢失和边界模糊问题，并以 SceneX 数据集推动真实复杂场景下分割模型的鲁棒性评估。

title: ForensicZoom: Adaptive Visual Inspection with Multimodal LLMs for Industrial-Grade Face Forgery Detection
summary: Reliable face forgery detection is critical to the security of online identity verification systems, where missed attacks compromise security and excessive false positives disrupt legitimate users. Specialized forensic detectors achieve strong detection performance but provide limited interpretability, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and interpretable reasoning yet remain substantially weaker for face forgery detection. We argue that a key limitation lies in how visual evidence is acquired: subtle forensic artifacts may be poorly represented at standard resolution, while uniformly processing all cases at higher resolution is computationally inefficient. We therefore introduce ForensicZoom, an industrial-grade MLLM framework for adaptive visual inspection. ForensicZoom first equips a general-purpose MLLM with forensic-aware visual representations and aligns the language model with these features. Its central mechanism, NEED_ZOOM, enables the model to autonomously request magnified views of suspicious regions when the initial evidence is insufficient, turning fixed-pass classification into adaptive multi-round forensic reasoning. The zoom behavior is learned through reward shaping that balances detection accuracy with unnecessary visual inspection, concentrating additional computation on difficult cases. A final attribution optimization stage improves natural-language forensic reports while preserving detection performance. On large-scale industrial identity verification data, ForensicZoom achieves over 97% TPR at 0.1% FPR, substantially outperforming both specialized detectors and existing MLLM-based methods while producing actionable forensic attributions. These results demonstrate that ForensicZoom can provide an effective path toward accurate, interpretable, and scalable MLLM-based face forgery detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ForensicZoom，一个面向工业级人脸伪造检测的 MLLM 框架，通过 NEED_ZOOM 机制让模型自适应请求放大可疑区域的视图，将固定单次分类转变为多轮取证推理，在 0.1% FPR 下实现超过 97% 的 TPR，并生成可操作的取证归因报告。
AI.motivation: 在线身份验证要求可靠的人脸伪造检测：漏检危害安全，误报干扰合法用户。专用取证检测器性能强但可解释性弱；多模态大语言模型语义理解与推理可解释性强，但人脸伪造检测能力明显不足。作者认为关键瓶颈在于视觉证据的获取方式——细微取证伪影在标准分辨率下表征不足，而统一高分辨率处理计算效率低下。
AI.method: ForensicZoom 分三步：(1) 为通用 MLLM 配备取证感知的视觉表征，并将语言模型与这些特征对齐；(2) 核心机制 NEED_ZOOM，使模型在初始证据不足时自主请求放大可疑区域，把固定单次分类变为自适应多轮取证推理，缩放行为通过奖励塑形学习，平衡检测精度与不必要的视觉检查，将额外计算集中于困难样本；(3) 最终归因优化阶段提升自然语言取证报告质量，同时保持检测性能。
AI.result: 在大规模工业身份验证数据上，ForensicZoom 在 0.1% FPR 下 TPR 超过 97%，显著优于专用检测器和现有基于 MLLM 的方法，同时产生可操作的取证归因。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 ForensicZoom 为准确、可解释、可扩展的基于 MLLM 的人脸伪造检测提供了一条有效路径。

title: IMVS: Interactive Medical Volume Segmentation with Test-Time Adaptation - A New Method for Annotating Radiology Datasets
summary: Annotating large radiology datasets is bottlenecked by the manual effort of delineating structures slice-by-slice in 3D volumes. Interactive methods reduce this effort but stay interaction-inefficient: slice-wise methods (including many foundation models) ignore inter-slice continuity, while 3D and video-based methods propagate a prompt with a \emph{fixed} propagator that never adapts to the target volume, so it drifts on low-contrast or pathological structures and must be re-prompted. We present IMVS, a human-in-the-loop annotation framework that composes three components into a closed loop rather than a new segmentation primitive: a lightweight 2D Slice Mask Adapter (SMA) fine-tuned online from user scribbles, a frozen Volume Mask Tracker (VMT) that propagates corrected masks across adjacent slices, and a soft teacher--student alignment that limits forgetting. The SMA is backbone-agnostic (UNet++, DeepLabV3, TransUNet). Across 8 public CT/MRI datasets, IMVS matches strong interactive baselines in quality while sharply cutting annotation effort: $14.4\times$ faster than a proficient copy-based manual workflow ($22.3\times$ over naive manual), $4.6\times$ over slice-wise and $1.9\times$ over 3D interactive methods. MedSAM2 and ScribblePrompt stay competitive or stronger on well-delineated organs; IMVS's advantage is largest on challenging targets and on interaction efficiency. Source code and Demo Video: https://github.com/AbhilakshSinghReen/imvs.

AI.tldr: IMVS是一个人机协同的医学影像标注框架，通过在线微调的2D切片掩码适配器、冻结的3D体掩码追踪器和软师生对齐机制构成闭环，在8个公开CT/MRI数据集上大幅降低标注工作量。
AI.motivation: 大型放射学数据集标注受限于逐切片手工勾画三维结构的高昂成本。现有交互式方法交互效率低：切片级方法（含多数学科基础模型）忽视层间连续性；3D与视频类方法使用固定传播器，无法适应目标体积，在低对比度或病变结构上发生漂移，需反复重新提示。
AI.method: 提出IMVS，将三个组件组合为闭环而非新分割基元：(1)轻量2D切片掩码适配器（SMA），基于用户涂鸦在线微调；(2)冻结的体掩码追踪器（VMT），将修正后的掩码传播至相邻切片；(3)软师生对齐，限制遗忘。SMA与骨干网络无关，兼容UNet++、DeepLabV3、TransUNet。
AI.result: 在8个公开CT/MRI数据集上，IMVS在质量上匹配强交互基线，同时显著降低标注工作量：相比熟练的复制式人工流程快14.4倍（相比朴素人工快22.3倍），分别比切片级与3D交互方法快4.6倍和1.9倍。MedSAM2与ScribblePrompt在边界清晰的器官上表现相当或更强；IMVS的优势在困难目标和交互效率上最为显著。
AI.conclusion: IMVS通过在线适配与层间传播的闭环设计，在不牺牲分割质量的前提下显著提升标注效率，尤其在低对比度或病变等挑战性目标上优势明显，且骨干无关，具有良好通用性。

title: Unifying Semantic Priors and High-Frequency Traces: Enhancing V-JEPA with Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Synthetic Image Forensics
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection @ ECCV. Code available at https://github.com/ALCOR-Lab-DIAG/MoE-JEPA
summary: The unchecked proliferation of manipulated images on social media platforms has increased the spread of misinformation, posing a severe threat to public trust and information integrity. Modern deepfake detectors typically rely on Vision Transformers (ViTs) to capture the low-level inconsistencies that characterize fully synthetic or locally tampered images. However, the global understanding of such foundation models is not enough to discriminate alone between real and fake multimedia content, especially in challenging scenarios where images are compressed or transmitted through social media. In this paper we pioneer the application of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models to deepfake detection, taking advantage of the generalized representation of visual reality that such World Models have exhibited. We hypothesize, and empirically demonstrate, that the intrinsic world understanding of JEPA models can be used as a strong prior for a deepfake detector. To fully exploit JEPA capabilities, we propose MoE-JEPA, a dual-stream architecture for deepfake detection. By enhancing a V-JEPA 2 backbone with a Residual Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism, along with a noise stream branch, our model dynamically internalizes forensic knowledge. Furthermore, a Gated Attention Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) module is employed to ensure precise spatial semantic understanding. Evaluated on the SID-Set benchmark, comprising 300K AI-generated, tampered and authentic images, MoE-JEPA establishes a new state-of-the-art with an accuracy of 95.54%, successfully outperforming vastly larger models.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次将JEPA世界模型引入深度伪造检测，提出双流架构MoE-JEPA，在SID-Set基准上以95.54%准确率刷新SOTA，超越更大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上被篡改图像的无节制传播加剧了虚假信息扩散，威胁公众信任与信息完整性。现有检测器多依赖ViT捕捉低层次不一致性，但这类基础模型的全局理解不足以单独区分真假内容，尤其在图像被压缩或经社交媒体传输的困难场景下表现受限。
AI.method: 作者首次将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）应用于深度伪造检测，利用此类世界模型所展现的视觉现实泛化表征作为检测器的强先验。为充分释放JEPA能力，提出MoE-JEPA双流架构：在V-JEPA 2骨干上增强残差混合专家（MoE）机制，并加入噪声流分支，使模型动态内化取证知识；同时采用门控注意力多实例学习（MIL）模块，保证精确的空间语义理解。
AI.result: 在包含30万张AI生成、篡改及真实图像的SID-Set基准上评测，MoE-JEPA取得95.54%的准确率，刷新当前最优水平，并显著超越参数量远大于自身的模型。
AI.conclusion: JEPA模型内在的世界理解可有效作为深度伪造检测的强先验；结合残差MoE、噪声流与门控注意力MIL的双流设计，能在压缩与社交传播等挑战场景下实现高效且高精度的检测，验证了世界模型范式在取证任务中的潜力。

title: Benchmarking Factual Robustness of LLMs via Multi-conversation Persuasion
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as primary knowledge retrieval interfaces, their robustness against \textit{persuasion attacks}---attempts to inject misinformation or enforce counterfactuals---has become a critical safety concern. Existing red-teaming frameworks typically evaluate models in multi-turn dialogues where the target model retains full conversation history. We identify a critical flaw in this setting termed \textbf{``Refusal Inertia''}: a model's initial refusal often propagates through subsequent turns largely to maintain contextual consistency, thereby masking its true vulnerability to sophisticated, isolated persuasion attempts. To rigorously evaluate the ``cold-start'' defense capabilities of SOTA models, we introduce the \textbf{SAST-IR} (Stateful Attacker, Stateless Target - Iterative Refinement) framework. By enforcing a memory wipe on the target while retaining the attacker's history, we simulate a worst-case adversarial setting using \textbf{multi-turn} (stateless) iterations. Leveraging \textbf{CP-Agent} (Cognitive Persuasion Agent), an enhanced diagnosis-guided agent, our experiments on the custom \textsc{CounterFact-Strict} dataset ($N=50$) yield alarming results: simple, diverse attack strategies achieved a staggering \textbf{96\%} success rate, exposing severe brittleness in memory-less defense. Furthermore, we reveal a \textbf{``Complexity Paradox''}: while complex, iteratively refined attacks are effective, they often trigger defensive compliance, whereas simple strategies achieve a higher rate of genuine persuasion (\textbf{84.7\%}). Our code and dataset are available at GitHub, https://github.com/cza1006/llm-persuasion-defense.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了多轮对话评测中LLM说服攻击防御的"拒绝惯性"缺陷，提出SAST-IR框架（攻击者有状态、目标无状态）模拟冷启动最坏情况，并结合CP-Agent在CounterFact-Strict数据集上评测，发现简单攻击策略成功率高达96%，且存在"复杂度悖论"。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为主要知识检索接口，其抵御说服攻击（注入错误信息或强化反事实）的鲁棒性成为关键安全问题。现有红队评测多在保留完整对话历史的多轮设定下进行，模型初始拒绝会因维持上下文一致性而传播，掩盖了其真实脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出SAST-IR（有状态攻击者、无状态目标—迭代精炼）框架：在保留攻击者历史的同时对目标模型执行记忆清除，以多轮无状态迭代模拟最坏对抗场景；并引入CP-Agent（认知说服智能体）作为诊断引导的增强智能体，在自建CounterFact-Strict数据集（N=50）上进行实验。
AI.result: 简单多样的攻击策略取得了高达96%的攻击成功率，暴露了无记忆防御的严重脆弱性；同时发现"复杂度悖论"：复杂迭代精炼攻击虽有效，但常触发防御性顺从，而简单策略获得更高的真实说服率（84.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 现有保留对话历史的评测会因"拒绝惯性"高估LLM的防御能力；在冷启动、无记忆的严格设定下，SOTA模型的防御极为脆弱。评测应剥离上下文一致性对拒绝行为的支撑，且攻击复杂度与真实说服效果并非正相关。代码与数据集已开源。

title: PSMP-CLIP: Patch-Prompt SAM and Multi-Semantic Prompting for CLIP-Based Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to localize anomalies without target-domain samples. Existing CLIP-based methods suffer from coarse anomaly maps and limited semantic prompts. We propose PSMP-CLIP, integrating patch-prompt SAM2 segmentation (PPSS) and multi-semantic guided prompt regularization (MSGPR). PPSS samples prompts directly from intermediate patch features, avoiding threshold drift and guiding SAM2 to produce precise masks. MSGPR uses multiple learnable prompts constrained by semantic anchors to preserve generalization. Experiments on 14 datasets show highly competitive performance, achieving the best pixel-level AUROC on MVTec AD, BTAD, DTD-Synthetic, CVC-ClinicDB, TN3K, Endo, and Kvasir.

AI.tldr: 提出PSMP-CLIP，结合补丁提示SAM2分割与多语义引导提示正则化，实现零样本异常检测的精确掩码定位，在14个数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的零样本异常检测方法存在异常图粗糙、语义提示有限的问题。
AI.method: 集成两大模块：补丁提示SAM2分割（PPSS）直接从中间补丁特征中采样提示，避免阈值漂移并引导SAM2生成精确掩码；多语义引导提示正则化（MSGPR）利用语义锚约束的多个可学习提示以保持泛化能力。
AI.result: 在14个数据集上进行实验，在MVTec AD、BTAD、DTD-Synthetic、CVC-ClinicDB、TN3K、Endo和Kvasir上取得最佳像素级AUROC，性能极具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PSMP-CLIP通过补丁级提示采样与多语义提示正则化，有效提升零样本异常检测的定位精度与泛化性。

title: Noise2Noise Revisited: Training Pair Distributions Dominate Loss Choice in Self-Supervised Denoising
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to The 8th International Conference on Video, Signal and Image Processing (VSIP 2026). Code and data: https://github.com/dyshang/noise2noise-revisited
summary: Noise2Noise (N2N) trains denoisers on pairs of independently corrupted observations, eliminating clean references. We stress-test two natural conjectures about why the L1 loss outperforms L2 here. First, the hypothesis that the L1 loss confers robustness via parameter sparsity confuses the loss with Lasso regularization: an explicit Lasso penalty produces the predicted sparsity yet fails to reproduce L1's cross-noise behavior, while L1- and L2-trained weight distributions are indistinguishable. Second, the population optima of the two losses coincide exactly for symmetric signal posteriors and nearly so for concentrated ones. Measured differences are therefore dominated by optimization dynamics (bounded-influence gradients), which we probe with gradient statistics and contaminated-target training. On Kodak24 with five synthetic noise families, the L1 loss holds a statistically significant edge over L2, below 1 dB PSNR, holding across three seeds on 13 of the 14 noise columns. On real camera noise the loss is not the decisive variable in distribution: on official SIDD validation blocks, synthetic-Gaussian-trained N2N models gain only 0.8 to 3.7 dB over the noisy input regardless of loss, while retraining on SIDD's own noisy pairs, never reading ground truth, gains 9.4 to 11.0 dB, far ahead of BM3D. All metrics are on raw network outputs, and the study makes no leaderboard claim. The training pair distribution, not the loss, carries the inductive bias. That design rule applies wherever clean references are unobtainable, from microscopy to industrial inspection sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了Noise2Noise中L1损失优于L2的两种猜想：参数稀疏性与总体最优差异，发现二者均不成立，性能差异主要源于优化动力学（有界影响梯度）；实验进一步表明，真正承载归纳偏置的是训练对分布，而非损失函数。
AI.motivation: Noise2Noise无需干净参考即可训练去噪器，但为何L1损失优于L2尚无定论。作者旨在严格检验两种看似自然的解释（L1通过参数稀疏性带来鲁棒性、两种损失的总体最优不同），并厘清损失函数与训练数据分布在无干净参考去噪中的作用。
AI.method: 1）对比L1训练与显式Lasso正则，检验稀疏性假设，并比较L1/L2训练的权重分布；2）分析对称及集中信号后验下两种损失的总体最优；3）用梯度统计与污染目标训练探测优化动力学；4）在Kodak24上测试五种合成噪声族、三个随机种子；5）在SIDD官方验证块上比较合成高斯训练的N2N与直接用SIDD自身噪声对训练（不读取真值）的效果，并与BM3D对比；所有指标基于原始网络输出。
AI.result: Lasso惩罚虽产生预期稀疏性，却无法复现L1的跨噪声行为；L1与L2训练的权重分布不可区分；两种损失在对称后验下总体最优完全一致、在集中后验下几乎一致，故差异由优化动力学主导。Kodak24上L1相对L2的PSNR优势低于1 dB但统计显著，14个噪声列中有13个在三个种子上成立。在SIDD上，合成高斯训练的N2N模型无论何种损失仅比噪声输入提升0.8–3.7 dB；而用SIDD自身噪声对（从不读取真值）训练可提升9.4–11.0 dB，远超BM3D。
AI.conclusion: L1优于L2并非源于稀疏性或总体最优差异，而是优化动力学（有界影响梯度）所致。在真实相机噪声上，损失函数并非决定性变量，训练对分布才是归纳偏置的载体。该设计原则适用于无法获取干净参考的场景，如显微成像与工业检测传感器。

title: TEDi: Temporal Memory-Enhanced and Denoising Transformer for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
summary: Query-based segmentation methods have shown promising potential for surgical instrument segmentation and recognition, which is essential for scene understanding and downstream tasks in computer assisted surgery. However, most existing approaches predominantly rely on per-frame predictions and overlook cross-frame temporal priors as well as temporal-consistency constraints. This limitation often leads to unstable query representations and suboptimal category recognition. In this paper, we propose TEDi, a Temporal memory-Enhanced and Denoising transformer for surgical instrument segmentation that addresses these is sues through Memory Search Enhancement and Temporal Consistency Denoising. The former introduces a query-level memory bank and a memory search enhancement encoder to retrieve discriminative representations from historical frames, enriching current-frame features. The latter constructs a temporally consistent reference as a cross-frame semantic anchor to suppress temporally unstable predictions and promote semantic coherence across frames. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets, EndoVis 2017 and EndoVis 2018, demonstrate that TEDi consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its potential to further advance computer-assisted surgery. Our code is available at github.com/argon-xixi/TEDi.

AI.tldr: 提出TEDi，一种时序记忆增强与去噪Transformer，用于手术器械分割，通过内存搜索增强和时序一致性去噪解决跨帧时序先验与一致性约束缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于查询的分割方法多依赖逐帧预测，忽略跨帧时序先验与时序一致性约束，导致查询表示不稳定、类别识别次优。
AI.method: TEDi包含两个模块：内存搜索增强（Memory Search Enhancement），引入查询级内存库与内存搜索增强编码器，从历史帧检索判别性表示以丰富当前帧特征；时序一致性去噪（Temporal Consistency Denoising），构建时序一致的参考作为跨帧语义锚点，抑制时序不稳定预测并提升跨帧语义连贯性。
AI.result: 在EndoVis 2017与EndoVis 2018两个基准数据集上，TEDi持续优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: TEDi通过时序记忆增强与去噪提升了手术器械分割的稳定性与语义一致性，具有推进计算机辅助手术的潜力，代码已开源。

title: LEAP: Learning Emergent Active Perception for Quadruped Navigation
summary: Active perception allows autonomous agents to select their viewpoints rather than passively process the viewpoints given to them, enabling them to target where to reduce uncertainty about their environment. Learned systems typically encourage this behavior with hand-designed proxy objectives, such as coverage or curiosity bonuses, that may conflict with the task. In this work, we propose a method to learn emergent active perception (LEAP) without augmentation of the task objective. We formulate the problem of goal-oriented navigation over hazardous terrains with goals that must be discovered visually. We then propose an architecture for navigation policies with active perception, and train them on a terrain curriculum where task pressure alone leads to the emergence of gaze control. Key to this emergence, LEAP works on a gaze-invariant representation that integrates depth images into egocentric belief maps. We validate its performance in held-out evaluation scenarios, where it achieves a 92.7% success rate, compared to 74.2% for scripted or 34.5% for passive perception, and comes within 4.6 points of a privileged oracle. We validate that LEAP navigation policies, unchanged, can be directly applied to steering quadrupedal locomotion policies in physics simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAP方法，在不修改任务目标的前提下，通过地形课程训练让主动感知（注视控制）自发涌现，用于危险地形上的目标导向导航。
AI.motivation: 主动感知可让智能体自主选择视点以降低环境不确定性，但现有学习系统通常依赖人工设计的代理目标（如覆盖率、好奇心奖励），这些目标可能与任务本身冲突。
AI.method: 将问题建模为危险地形上的目标导向导航，目标须通过视觉发现；提出具备主动感知能力的导航策略架构，并在地形课程上训练，仅靠任务压力促成注视控制涌现；核心是构建注视不变表示，将深度图像整合进以自我为中心的信念地图。
AI.result: 在留出评估场景中达到92.7%成功率，高于脚本化感知的74.2%和被动感知的34.5%，与特权预言机（oracle）仅差4.6个百分点；且LEAP策略无需修改即可直接用于物理仿真中四足机器人运动策略的转向控制。
AI.conclusion: 表明无需额外代理奖励，仅凭任务压力配合注视不变表示与课程训练，即可实现涌现式主动感知，并具备跨任务迁移能力。

title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement
comment: 25 pages, 13 figures. Accepted to the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. Code: https://github.com/tingwei161803/drpg
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse domains, but continual adaptation to evolving tasks and environments remains a key challenge. Existing memory-augmented approaches retrieve individual past examples as direct references, but do not explicitly synthesize actionable strategies from them, causing the same types of errors to recur. We propose Dynamic Retrieval-based Policy Generation (DRPG), a framework that integrates memory-based retrieval with a dynamic policy generator, leveraging historical data and environment feedback to produce task-specific policies for continual LLM improvement. We evaluate DRPG across six benchmarks spanning text-to-SQL, question answering, medical diagnosis, and Python programming, using seven LLMs from both proprietary and open-weight families. DRPG outperforms strong baselines across most datasets and models. Further analysis demonstrates that DRPG's policy generation is robust to retrieval strategy, operates effectively without prior policy continuity, and can leverage smaller or cross-family models as cost-efficient policy generators. We also find that the benefit of policy-level guidance depends on task characteristics, offering practical insights into when and under what conditions this mechanism is most effective.

AI.tldr: 提出 DRPG：将记忆检索与动态策略生成器结合，从历史经验和环境反馈中合成任务级策略，实现 LLM 持续改进。
AI.motivation: LLM 在持续适应新任务与环境方面仍有挑战；已有记忆增强方法只检索个别历史样例作为直接参考，未显式从中提炼可执行策略，导致同类错误反复出现。
AI.method: DRPG（Dynamic Retrieval-based Policy Generation）框架：整合基于记忆的检索与动态策略生成器，利用历史数据与环境反馈生成任务特定策略；在文本到 SQL、问答、医学诊断、Python 编程四类共六个基准上评测，覆盖专有与开源七种 LLM。
AI.result: DRPG 在多数数据集与模型上优于强基线；策略生成对检索策略稳健，不依赖先验策略连续性，可使用更小或跨家族模型作为低成本策略生成器；策略级指导的收益取决于任务特性。
AI.conclusion: 从"检索样例"提升到"生成策略"的记忆增强范式可行且具成本弹性，其有效性受任务特征调节，为何时及何种条件下使用该机制提供了实践指导。

title: Hyper-RED: Scalable Event Pre-training via Semantic Hypergraph Distillation
summary: Event cameras have shown great potential for robust visual perception, yet scaling event representation learning remains challenging due to the scarcity of large-scale annotated event data. Pretrained image models provide scalable semantic supervision, but existing image-to-event methods rely on rigid pixel-wise or token-wise alignment that overlooks modality discrepancies in texture, density, and appearance, potentially causing semantic collapse and limiting transferability. To address this issue, we propose Hyper-RED, a simple, painless, and scalable image-to-event pretraining framework that transfers high-order semantic structures from images to events. Hyper-RED uses hypergraphs to model and align high-order semantic associations among multiple image and event tokens, enabling cross-modal knowledge transfer while accommodating modality-specific differences rather than enforcing rigid one-to-one correspondence. Specifically, given a paired event--image sample, Hyper-RED leverages DINOv3 to extract spatial token representations and constructs image, event, and cross-modal semantic hypergraphs, where each hyperedge connects multiple semantically correlated tokens. We further introduce a hypergraph relational distillation loss that imposes complementary intra- and cross-modal constraints, enabling the event encoder to inherit image-derived semantic organization while preserving local relational consistency and event-specific characteristics. Experiments on three tasks across five event datasets demonstrate consistent scaling from ViT-S to ViT-L and state-of-the-art performance (Fig.1). The code is available at: https://github.com/meisenwang/Hyper--RED.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper-RED，一种基于超图的图像到事件预训练框架，通过建模并对齐图像与事件token间的高阶语义关联，实现跨模态知识迁移，在五个事件数据集、三个任务上取得SOTA并展现良好可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 事件相机在鲁棒视觉感知中潜力巨大，但大规模标注事件数据稀缺，制约了事件表征学习的扩展。预训练图像模型可提供可扩展的语义监督，然而现有图像到事件方法依赖刚性的像素级或token级对齐，忽略了纹理、密度、外观等模态差异，可能导致语义坍塌并限制迁移性。
AI.method: 提出Hyper-RED框架，用超图建模并对齐多个图像与事件token间的高阶语义关联，实现跨模态知识迁移且容许模态差异，而非强制一对一对应。具体地，对配对的事件-图像样本，利用DINOv3提取空间token表示，构建图像、事件及跨模态语义超图，每条超边连接多个语义相关token；并引入超图关系蒸馏损失，施加互补的模态内与跨模态约束，使事件编码器继承图像语义组织，同时保持局部关系一致性与事件特有特性。
AI.result: 在五个事件数据集、三个任务上的实验表明，方法从ViT-S到ViT-L具有一致的扩展性，并达到最先进性能（Fig.1）。
AI.conclusion: Hyper-RED是一个简单、便捷且可扩展的图像到事件预训练框架，通过超图建模高阶语义结构有效缓解模态差异带来的语义坍塌问题，实现稳健的跨模态迁移；代码已开源。

title: ImpossibleRubrics: Stress-Testing Generated Rubrics as Reward Signals
summary: Language model-generated rubrics are increasingly used as reward signals for rubric-based reinforcement learning, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and automated grading. Such rubrics are reliable only if they reward honest answers over adversarial answers optimized to exploit them. Yet their robustness to such optimization remains poorly understood. We isolate the hardest regime: impossible tasks, where the prompt pressures the model toward an unsupported conclusion, so the only honest response is to acknowledge the impossibility. We introduce ImpossibleRubrics, a benchmark of 169 impossible tasks spanning six impossibility categories, each paired with a verifiable oracle certificate specifying what an honest answer may and may not claim, together with 48 answerable controls. Rather than providing fixed rubrics, ImpossibleRubrics provides task environments and certificates, allowing rubrics to be generated downstream and then adversarially tested for whether they reward certificate-violating answers. Eleven generators are exploited 8--26% of the time on the unbiased 150-of-169 environment cut; on a deliberately selected stress cut the strongest generator we measured is still exploited 36% while a certificate-faithful rubric is exploited 0%, so what we measure is a rubric-quality gap, not task impossibility. One result runs against intuition. A single generic rubric ("be decisive, penalize hedging") used unchanged for every task is exploited 64% of the time, and seven of the eleven generators are exploited more often than that while writing a rubric tailored to each one. The tailored criteria appear to tell an attacker which claim to fabricate. The problem is not that rubrics are vague; it is that they are specific about the wrong things.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ImpossibleRubrics 基准（169 个不可能任务 + 48 个可回答对照，每项配可验证的 oracle 证书），将评分标准的生成与其对抗鲁棒性测试解耦。11 个生成器在无偏子集上被利用率为 8–26%，压力子集上最强生成器仍达 36%，而证书忠实的评分标准为 0%；同时单一通用评分标准被利用 64%，且 11 个生成器中有 7 个在定制标准下被利用得更频繁。
AI.motivation: 语言模型生成的评分标准（rubric）已广泛用作基于评分标准的强化学习奖励信号、LLM-as-a-judge 评估与自动评分。此类评分标准只有在"奖励诚实回答、而非奖励针对其优化的对抗性回答"时才可靠，但其对抗鲁棒性尚缺乏系统理解。作者选择最严苛场景——不可能任务，来隔离并度量这一鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 构建 ImpossibleRubrics 基准：169 个不可能任务，覆盖六类不可能性，每个任务配可验证的 oracle 证书（规定诚实回答可主张与不可主张的内容），另有 48 个可回答对照。基准不提供固定评分标准，而是提供任务环境与证书，使评分标准可在下游生成，再以对抗方式测试其是否会奖励违反证书的回答。据此在无偏子集（169 中取 150）与刻意挑选的压力子集上评估 11 个生成器。
AI.result: 在无偏的 150/169 环境切分上，11 个生成器的评分标准被利用的比例为 8%–26%；在压力切分上，所测最强生成器仍被利用 36%，而证书忠实的评分标准被利用率为 0%，说明所测差距源于评分标准质量而非任务本身不可能。反直觉结果：一个对所有任务保持不变、通用的"要果断、惩罚含糊其辞"评分标准被利用 64%，而 11 个生成器中有 7 个在逐任务定制评分标准时被利用得更频繁。
AI.conclusion: 问题不在于评分标准含糊，而在于它们"具体在了错误的地方"——定制化的具体准则反而向攻击者泄露了应当伪造哪一主张。因此需要以证书为约束依据来设计评分标准：证书忠实的评分标准可将利用率降为 0，为构建对抗鲁棒的可验证评分信号提供了方向。

title: What Breaks Local Watermarks? A Robustness Benchmark for Local Invisible Image Watermarking
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 19th ACM Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISec 2026), co-located with ACM CCS 2026. The final version will be published in the ACM Digital Library
summary: Local image watermarking embeds an invisible signal into selected image regions rather than spreading it across the entire image, enabling payload recovery from specific objects or regions without perceptibly altering the image. Existing studies evaluate the robustness of payload recovery and localization under image transformations, but they often focus on their own proposed method, resulting in narrow evaluations with inconsistent choices of transformations, datasets, and metrics. These inconsistencies across studies limit direct comparisons across methods and muddle the overall picture of local watermark robustness. To address this gap, we present the first systematic robustness benchmark for local watermarks across 55 image transformations, including (i) signal distortions, (ii) changes in image coordinate alignment, (iii) indirect local edits, and (iv) direct watermark edits. The benchmark evaluates MaskWM, WAM, OmniGuard, TrustMark, and PixelSeal, all methods that either provide native localization or require minimal adaptation to support it. Our results show that all evaluated methods are vulnerable to some transformation, with MaskWM standing out as offering the strongest payload recovery and localization, although it has the lowest image quality in the clean setting. Synchronization further improves MaskWM's payload recovery under several geometric transformations, albeit at an additional cost to image quality. A key finding is that local watermark robustness depends strongly on the nature of the transformation: signal distortions are often tolerated by the strongest methods, while geometric misalignment and generative local edits, such as inpainting and outpainting, can completely impair payload recovery. We observe that payload recovery and localization are related but not interchangeable, and both strongly depend on the transformation's impact on the watermark region.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个针对局部图像水印的系统性鲁棒性基准，涵盖55种图像变换，评估5种方法，揭示其鲁棒性规律。
AI.motivation: 现有局部水印研究各自评估自身方法，变换选择、数据集与指标不一致，导致方法间难以直接比较，整体鲁棒性图景模糊。
AI.method: 构建覆盖55种图像变换的基准，分为信号失真、图像坐标对齐变化、间接局部编辑、直接水印编辑四类；评估MaskWM、WAM、OmniGuard、TrustMark、PixelSeal五种具备原生定位或最小适配支持定位的方法。
AI.result: 所有方法对某些变换均脆弱；MaskWM在载荷恢复与定位上最强但干净场景图像质量最低；同步化可提升MaskWM在多种几何变换下的载荷恢复，但损害图像质量；信号失真常被最强方法容忍，而几何错位和生成式局部编辑（如inpainting、outpainting）可完全破坏载荷恢复；载荷恢复与定位相关但不可互换，均强烈依赖变换对水印区域的影响。
AI.conclusion: 局部水印鲁棒性强依赖变换性质；基准为方法间公平比较提供依据，指出现有方法的薄弱环节与改进方向。

title: StackTok: Accelerating VLMs Inference with Budget-Adaptive Visual Token Selection
summary: Increasing image resolution produces ever-longer visual-token sequences in vision-language models (VLMs), substantially raising their inference cost. To reduce this overhead without retraining, existing methods select compact token subsets that prioritize query relevance, visual coverage, or a fixed trade-off between them. The appropriate balance, however, varies across queries and token budgets: localized questions favor relevance, whereas holistic questions demand broader visual coverage. We introduce StackTok, a training-free selector that treats query relevance as the objective and visual coverage as budget-calibrated support. StackTok builds a size-indexed coverage reference from a coverage-only greedy sequence and adjusts its support target using query--vision affinity entropy. A reference-gated interleaved selection policy then switches between relevance- and coverage-oriented additions according to the current subset's support deficit. For high-resolution inputs, StackTok allocates one shared token budget across crops according to the combined marginal gain of locally nominated tokens. Evaluated with five VLMs over ten distinct image-understanding benchmarks, StackTok ranks first among training-free selectors in every tested model--budget setting. On high-resolution LLaVA-NeXT-7B, it retains 95.26% of full-token performance with only 160 of 2{,}880 (5.6%) visual tokens.

AI.tldr: StackTok是一种免训练视觉token选择器，将查询相关性作为优化目标、视觉覆盖作为预算校准的支撑约束，在五个VLM和十个基准上于所有模型-预算设定中排名第一，在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上仅用5.6% token即保留95.26%性能。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率输入导致视觉token序列变长，VLM推理成本显著上升。现有免训练方法以固定权衡选择token子集（偏向查询相关性或视觉覆盖），但合适的平衡点随查询类型和预算变化：局部性问题偏好相关性，整体性问题需要更广覆盖。
AI.method: StackTok将相关性视为目标、覆盖视为预算校准的支撑。构建基于规模的覆盖参考（由纯覆盖贪心序列生成），用查询-视觉亲和熵调整支撑目标；采用参考门控的交错选择策略，依据当前子集的支撑缺口在相关性和覆盖导向的增补间切换；高分辨率下按局部提名token的边际增益在crops间分配共享token预算。
AI.result: 在5个VLM、10个图像理解基准上评估，StackTok在每个测试的模型-预算设定中均位列免训练选择器第一。高分辨率LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，仅用2880个视觉token中的160个（5.6%）即保留全token性能的95.26%。
AI.conclusion: StackTok通过动态校准相关性与视觉覆盖的平衡，实现了免训练、预算自适应的视觉token压缩，在多个模型和基准上取得领先效果，显著降低高分辨率VLM推理成本。

title: FAHCD-Net: Frequency-Adaptive Heatmap-Conditional Diffusion Networks for Robust Facial Landmark Detection
summary: Facial Landmark Detection(FLD) is a crucial task in various applications and has achieved significant advancements in recent years. However, current FLD methods still struggle under challenging conditions, where facial structural variations, information loss, and noise interference severely compromise the integrity and accuracy of learned facial features. To address these issues, we propose Frequency-Adaptive Heatmap-Conditional Diffusion Network (FAHCD-Net), which integrates a Frequency-Adaptive Heatmap-Conditional Diffusion (FAHCD) model with a Smoothness Regularization (SR) loss in a cascaded framework. Specifically, the FAHCD model incorporates a Hierarchical Frequency Adaptation (HFA) module designed to suppress redundant high-frequency noise through multi-layer frequency decomposition and adaptive reconstruction, thereby preserving essential facial structures. Additionally, the SR loss is proposed to further mitigate the interference of high-frequency noise and enhance the smoothness of the generated landmark heatmaps. By cascading the FAHCD model with the SR loss, FAHCD-Net effectively leverages both statistical and frequency-based distribution characteristics of the data to progressively generate more accurate landmark heatmaps from noisy inputs. Extensive experiments on popular benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, achieving state-of-the-art performance in FLD tasks under challenging scenarios. The source code is available at https://github.com/HJWKryptonite/FAHCD-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出FAHCD-Net，将频率自适应热力图条件扩散模型与平滑正则化损失级联，提升复杂场景下人脸关键点检测的鲁棒性与精度。
AI.motivation: 现有FL D方法在复杂条件下（面部结构变化、信息丢失、噪声干扰）易受高频噪声影响，导致学习到的人脸特征完整性和准确性下降，亟需在频域上抑制噪声并保持关键结构。
AI.method: 核心为FAHCD-Net：1）Frequency-Adaptive Heatmap-Conditional Diffusion（FAHCD）模型，含分层频率自适应（HFA）模块，通过多层频率分解与自适应重建抑制冗余高频噪声、保留面部结构；2）平滑正则化（SR）损失，进一步削弱高频噪声干扰并提升生成热力图平滑性；3）将FAHCD与SR以级联框架结合，利用数据的统计分布与频率分布特征，由含噪输入逐步生成更精确的关键点热力图。
AI.result: 在多个主流基准上进行了大量实验，验证了方法的有效性与鲁棒性，在复杂场景下的FL D任务中取得state-of-the-art性能；源码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过频率域去噪与热力图平滑约束的级联扩散框架，可显著改善复杂条件下人脸关键点检测的精度与鲁棒性，为频域建模与扩散模型结合提供了有效方案。

title: RegRet: Enhancing Region-Level Retrieval in Large Multimodal Models
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. 22 pages, including references and appendix
summary: Region-level retrieval aims to align user-specified image regions with relevant regions or textual descriptions, playing a crucial role in realworld applications such as e-commerce product search and RAG. Although recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have made significant strides in multimodal retrieval, they primarily focus on global-level tasks and struggle to capture effective region-level representations. To bridge this gap, we present RegRet, an LMM-based Region-level Retrieval framework that enhances the regional representations without compromising overall global retrieval performance. At its core, RegRet integrates a Region-Aware Encoder to capture detailed regional features while balancing them with the global background context. To further enhance the fine-grained understanding and discriminability of representations, we design a multi-stage training pipeline that includes detailed localized captioning and regional contrastive learning tasks. In addition, considering the absence of region-level contrastive training data and the limited diversity of evaluation tasks in current benchmarks, we introduce the REGMB benchmark. It comprises 225k contrastive pairs, covering four multimodal retrieval tasks. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach. RegRet outperforms strong baselines in the zero-shot setting. Further training with contrastive learning leads to an average improvement of more than 20\% on both REGMB and public benchmarks, while achieving comparable or better results on global-level retrieval tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RegRet，一种基于LMM的区域级检索框架，通过区域感知编码器和多阶段训练提升区域表示能力，并发布REGMB基准，在零样本和对比学习设置下均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 区域级检索在电商产品搜索、RAG等实际应用中至关重要，但现有大型多模态模型主要聚焦全局级任务，难以捕捉有效的区域级表示。
AI.method: RegRet集成区域感知编码器（Region-Aware Encoder）捕捉细节区域特征并与全局背景上下文平衡；设计多阶段训练流程，包含细粒度局部描述生成和区域对比学习任务；同时构建REGMB基准（含225k对比对，覆盖四类多模态检索任务）。
AI.result: 零样本设置下RegRet优于强基线；进一步对比学习训练后在REGMB和公开基准上平均提升超过20%，同时在全局级检索任务上取得相当或更优的结果。
AI.conclusion: RegRet在不损害全局检索性能的前提下有效增强了区域级表示，验证了区域感知编码与多阶段训练的有效性，REGMB基准弥补了区域级对比训练数据缺失和评测任务单一的问题。

title: A Data-free Universal Prior over Syntactic Structures
summary: The probabilities of syntactic structures in human languages are assumed to emerge fully from language-specific experience. Here, I show that a universal prior over syntactic structures emerges from a model of human language production, in which words are progressively integrated into syntactic structure. Without fitting any parameters to specific language data, the resulting prior assigns higher probabilities to attested than to random dependency trees in all 138 typologically diverse languages examined. These prior probabilities correlate positively with those estimated from corpora in 33 of 34 languages. The results indicate that part of the probability structure of syntax can arise independently of language-specific learning. This identifies human language production as a possible cognitive source of universal statistical structure in language, while providing a data-independent structural bias for probabilistic models, including large language models.

AI.tldr: 句法结构的概率并非完全来自语言特定经验，而是存在一个源自人类语言产出过程的"普遍先验"。
AI.motivation: 主流观点认为人类语言中句法结构的概率完全由语言特定经验塑造。本文旨在检验是否存在独立于具体语言学习的普遍先验。
AI.method: 构建一个模拟人类语言产出的模型，其中词汇被逐步整合进句法结构；不针对任何具体语言数据拟合参数，由此推导出对句法结构的先验概率分布。
AI.result: 在138种类型学各异的语言中，该先验对真实依存树的赋值均高于随机依存树；其先验概率与语料库估计概率在34种语言中的33种呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 句法概率结构的一部分可独立于语言特定学习而产生；语言产出是人类语言中普遍统计结构的可能认知来源，并为概率模型（含大语言模型）提供数据无关的结构偏置。

title: TecoPrompt: Temporal-Conservative Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/haji-mimi/TecoPrompt
summary: Prompt learning adapts vision-language models, such as CLIP, by adjusting a small set of context tokens.
