However, under few-shot supervision, even moderate label noise can disrupt prompt optimization. To address this issue, we propose TecoPrompt, a closed-loop robust prompt-learning framework that revisits optimal transport (OT) pseudo-labeling from a temporal perspective. TecoPrompt employs an entropic OT plan in the CLIP semantic space to obtain globally consistent label candidates. It verifies the reliability of these candidates by examining trajectory stability: a noisy label is only rewritten if the OT candidate remains unchanged within a K-epoch temporal stability window and passes a confidence gate based on Exponential Moving Average (EMA). This approach helps reduce confirmation bias. The rewritten labels are then integrated back into prompt training using a tri-group objective that includes three loss functions aligned with clean, mid, and noisy subsets. Experiments on seven datasets with synthetic symmetric and asymmetric noise, as well as Food101N, demonstrate significant performance improvements. For example, on the OxfordPets dataset, with 50% asymmetric noise, TecoPrompt achieves an accuracy of 0.843, up from 0.775.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TecoPrompt，一种闭环鲁棒提示学习框架，从时间维度重新审视最优传输伪标签，以缓解少样本标签噪声对CLIP提示优化的干扰。
AI.motivation: 提示学习通过调整少量上下文token来适配CLIP等视觉-语言模型，但在少样本监督下，即使是中等程度的标签噪声也会破坏提示优化过程。现有方法缺乏对伪标签时间一致性的利用，容易产生确认偏差。
AI.method: TecoPrompt在CLIP语义空间中采用熵正则化最优传输（OT）方案生成全局一致的候选标签；通过检验轨迹稳定性验证候选标签的可靠性，仅当OT候选在K轮时间稳定窗口内保持不变且通过基于指数移动平均（EMA）的置信度门控时，才改写噪声标签；改写后的标签通过包含干净、中间、噪声三个子集对齐损失的三组目标函数重新整合回提示训练，形成闭环。
AI.result: 在七个数据集上针对合成对称与非对称噪声，以及Food101N上的实验均取得显著性能提升。例如在OxfordPets上，50%非对称噪声下准确率从0.775提升至0.843。
AI.conclusion: TecoPrompt通过时间稳定性验证与EMA置信门控结合的三组损失闭环框架，有效缓解了少样本提示学习中的标签噪声与确认偏差问题，验证了时间维度伪标签提纯在鲁棒提示学习中的有效性。

title: Measuring Annotation Efficiency for Handwritten Devanagari Recognition: Sample-Complexity Curves for Four Pretraining Regimes
summary: To train handwritten text recognition systems we need word images and their corresponding transcriptions, and these transcriptions are produced manually. For a script that can be read by only a small number of specialists, this manual transcription is a limitation, because the trained models are supposed to save the time of those same specialists. A relevant question therefore arises: how many transcriptions are needed before a recogniser becomes useful, and how much of that cost can pretraining remove? In this study the answer is measured directly for handwritten Devanagari. We keep the recogniser, optimiser and evaluation protocol the same and change only the number of real transcribed words used for fine-tuning across nine budgets from 10 to 4,000 and four initialisation regimes, with six seeds at every point. The resulting curves are then converted into annotation-equivalent terms. A CER of 0.50 is reached by supervised synthetic pretraining using only 81 transcribed words, whereas random initialisation requires 355, which gives a label multiplier of 4.40 [3.56, 4.99]. There is a zero-shot reference point as well: with no real transcribed words at all, this pretraining is worth about 136 of them. This advantage gets smaller as the target accuracy improves, and at the most demanding target we measure, it cannot be distinguished from no saving at all. A fourth arm in which only the encoder is transferred separates the effect of the pretraining method from that of transfer scope, and masked image modelling is observed to transfer negatively over a bounded range of budgets. We emphasise that the scarcity in this study is constructed by subsampling a large corpus.

AI.tldr: 在Devanagari手写识别中，仅用81个真实转写词即可在合成预训练下达到CER 0.50，而随机初始化需355个，标签乘数为4.40；预训练优势随目标精度提高而缩小，最高目标下与无节省难以区分。
AI.motivation: 专家可读的小众文字缺乏人工转写，而识别系统训练又依赖转写，形成"训练模型是为节省专家时间，却先要消耗专家时间"的困境。因此需量化：多少真实转写才使识别器有用，预训练能省下多少标注成本。
AI.method: 固定识别器、优化器与评测协议，仅改变用于微调的真实转写词数（9个预算，10至4000）与4种初始化方式，每点6个随机种子；将性能曲线换算为等效标注量，并设置仅迁移编码器的第四组以区分预训练方法与迁移范围的作用。
AI.result: 监督式合成预训练仅需81个转写词即达CER 0.50，随机初始化需355个，标签乘数4.40 [3.56, 4.99]；零样本时预训练相当于约136个词。优势随目标精度提升而递减，最高目标下与无节省不可区分；掩码图像建模在有限预算区间内出现负迁移。
AI.conclusion: 预训练可显著降低低资源文字识别所需的真实转写量，但收益依赖目标精度与迁移范围，掩码图像建模并非总是正向迁移；研究中的稀缺性由对大语料下采样构造，结论的外推需谨慎。

title: Reduplicative constructions in Mandarin: Socio-emotional profiling through distributional semantics
summary: Mandarin Chinese has two productive reduplicative constructions that repeat either two-character base words or their constituents (e.g., `in good health', `discuss a bit'). Their varied meanings have been described as realizing plurality, valence coloring, sound symbolism and pragmatic functions. The aim of this study is twofold. A first goal is to clarify whether it is possible to come to a more precise understanding of the variegated semantics of Mandarin reduplication by using word embeddings from distributional semantics. A second goal is to explore how useful embeddings are for understanding the details of a semantically complex word-formation process. We show that the embedding space recovers the semantic and grammatical properties of reduplications previously identified in the literature, validating Tencent embeddings for morphological investigation. Semantic profiling revealed that reduplicative constructions are often strongly represented on multiple dimensions. The two patterns exhibit clear semantic and pragmatic differentiation in distributional space. Procrustes analysis clarified that the overall organization of the base-word space is largely preserved in the reduplication space, with local mismatches highlighting regions of discourse-pragmatic reorganization. Taken together, these results show that high-dimensional word embeddings can recover established linguistic generalizations, and capture the semantic versatility of Mandarin reduplication and constructional transparency.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用分布式语义词嵌入分析汉语（普通话）重叠构式，验证嵌入能否刻画其复杂语义与语法特征。
AI.motivation: 汉语重叠构式意义多样（复数、配价色彩、声音象征、语用功能），传统研究难以精确刻画其语义多功能性，作者希望借助词嵌入获得更精确的语义理解并评估嵌入在复杂构词过程中的适用性。
AI.method: 采用分布式语义的词嵌入（Tencent embeddings）对重叠构式与基式词进行语义刻画，包括语义画像（semantic profiling）与Procrustes分析比较基式空间与重叠空间的整体结构及局部错配。
AI.result: 嵌入空间能够复现文献中已识别的重叠式语义与语法属性；重叠构式常在多个维度上强表征；两类重叠模式在分布空间中呈现清晰的语义与语用分化；重叠空间基本保留基式空间组织结构，局部错配体现语篇-语用层面的重组。
AI.conclusion: 高维词嵌入能复现已有的语言学概括，并捕捉汉语重叠的语义多样性与构式透明性，验证了Tencent嵌入用于形态学研究的可行性。

title: TEMPO: Learning Temporal Context for Dynamic Robot Manipulation
comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026. Project page: https://tempo-robot.github.io/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance in quasi-static manipulation, but struggle in dynamic manipulation tasks because they operate on a single observation at inference time. We identify two representational failures that underlie this limitation. The first is motion ambiguity, where a single observation does not include scene dynamics and therefore cannot anticipate the future state of moving objects. The second is state aliasing, where visually similar observations from different points in a task require different actions. We argue that these failures persist regardless of model scale and inference latency, showing that the bottleneck is missing temporal context rather than model capacity. Based on this insight, we propose TEMPO, which augments a pretrained VLA with two temporal inputs: a motion summary extracted from a frozen video foundation model to resolve motion ambiguity and a compact proprioceptive history to resolve state aliasing. TEMPO requires no modification to the backbone and adds minimal compute overhead at training or deployment. Across four dynamic manipulation tasks, it improves Bottle Handover success from 44% to 74% and is the only method that solves state aliasing. Probing and ablation studies confirm that each temporal signal independently addresses its corresponding failure. We further release TEMPO-Bench, a benchmark of over 50k annotated frames for evaluating motion-aware robot perception in both regression and multiple-choice formats. Project Website: https://tempo-robot.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文指出VLA模型在动态操作中受限于单帧观测，存在运动歧义与状态混叠两种表征失败，提出TEMPO通过引入运动摘要与本体感觉历史两个时序输入解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在准静态操作中表现良好，但推理时仅依赖单帧观测，难以应对动态操作。作者认为瓶颈不是模型规模或推理延迟，而是缺失时序上下文，具体表现为运动歧义（单帧观测无法预测运动物体未来状态）和状态混叠（任务不同阶段的相似观测需要不同动作）。
AI.method: 提出TEMPO，在不修改主干网络的前提下，为预训练VLA增加两个时序输入：一是从冻结的视频基础模型提取的运动摘要，用于解决运动歧义；二是紧凑的本体感觉历史，用于解决状态混叠。训练与部署的额外计算开销极小。
AI.result: 在四个动态操作任务上，TEMPO将Bottle Handover成功率从44%提升至74%，并且是唯一能解决状态混叠的方法。探测与消融实验证实，两个时序信号各自独立地针对其对应的失败模式。此外发布了TEMPO-Bench，包含超过5万帧标注数据，用于以回归和多项选择形式评估运动感知的机器人感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 动态操作的关键瓶颈在于缺失时序上下文而非模型容量，通过为VLA补充运动摘要与本体感觉历史即可显著提升动态操作性能，且不改动主干、开销极低。

title: tcnerv:dual-domain temporal context modeling for implicit neural video compression
summary: Video compression aims to minimize reconstruction distor tion under a constrained bit rate. Existing video implicit neural representations (INRs) often decode frames independently, leaving intermediate features unconditioned on previous reconstructions and content embeddings without explicit temporal prediction. We propose TCNeRV, which exploits reconstructed context in both feature and embedding domains. Its multi-scale temporal-context fusion (MTCF) module injects gated historical features at multiple decoder scales, while temporal embedding-residual coding (TERC) predicts each content embedding and codes only its residual. With approximately 3M parameters, TCNeRV achieves an average PSNR of 36.08 dB on the UVG dataset, outperforming HNeRV-Boost by 2.20 dB. It reduces BD-rate by 22.06%, 66.73%, and 29.85% relative to HM, DCVC, and HiNeRV, respectively, demonstrating competitive rate-distortion performance with limited model capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出TCNeRV视频隐式神经表示方法，在特征域与嵌入域同时利用已重建上下文，以约3M参数实现具竞争力的率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频隐式神经表示（INR）多为逐帧独立解码：中间特征未以先前重建为条件，内容嵌入也缺乏显式的时间预测，导致重建质量受限。
AI.method: TCNeRV包含两个模块：(1) 多尺度时间上下文融合（MTCF）在解码器多个尺度上注入带门控的历史特征；(2) 时间嵌入残差编码（TERC）对每个内容嵌入进行时间预测，仅编码其残差。
AI.result: 模型约3M参数，在UVG数据集上平均PSNR达36.08 dB，比HNeRV-Boost高2.20 dB；相对HM、DCVC、HiNeRV分别降低BD-rate 22.06%、66.73%、29.85%。
AI.conclusion: 在有限模型容量下，TCNeRV通过在特征与嵌入两个域利用重建上下文，实现了具有竞争力的率失真性能。

title: SPEAR NeXT Causal Latent Forecasting Across Multiple Horizons for Spectral Temporal Earth Representation Learning
summary: Earth observation is inherently dynamic, yet temporal information in many foundation models is learned through reconstruction, invariance, or retrospective sequence summarization. SPEAR NeXT is introduced as a compact pixel-wise multimodal spectral temporal foundation model in which temporal self supervision is formulated as past only, multi horizon latent Earth state prediction. Instantaneous states are first encoded by the pretrained SPEAR model from optical, radar, and environmental observations into compact 32 dimensional embeddings. Their temporal evolution is then modeled by a causally masked Trans former that predicts multiple future latent states from pre ceding observations. Relative temporal order is represented using Rotary Position Embeddings, while month and year embeddings encode seasonal phase and interannual con text.

AI.tldr: 提出SPEAR NeXT：紧凑的像素级多模态光谱-时间基础模型，将时间自监督建模为"仅依赖过去"的多步潜在地球状态预测。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型的时间信息多通过重建、不变性或回顾式序列摘要学习，忽视了地球观测固有的动态特性，也未能真正模拟"由过去预测未来"的因果时序结构。
AI.method: 先用预训练SPEAR模型将光学、雷达和环境观测的瞬时状态编码为32维紧凑嵌入；再由因果掩码Transformer从先前观测预测多个未来潜在状态；用旋转位置编码（RoPE）表示相对时序顺序，并用月份与年份嵌入编码季节相位和年际背景。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，仅说明模型为紧凑的像素级多模态光谱-时间基础模型，具备多步未来潜在状态预测能力。
AI.conclusion: SPEAR NeXT以"仅过去、多时间步潜在状态预测"的时间自监督范式，为地球观测基础模型提供了一种显式建模动态时序演化的紧凑方案。

title: GRACE: Geometry- and Ray-Aware Camera-Efficient Multi-View Pedestrian Tracking
summary: Reducing the number of cameras reduces the deployment cost but removes views that correct BEV responses stretched away from true pedestrian positions by projection and short score drops that can split tracks} in Bird's-Eye View (BEV) tracking. We introduce GRACE, a camera-efficient multi-view tracker with three components. Volumetric-Guided Fusion combines homography-based BEV features with features lifted through 3D space. Ray Conditioning exposes each camera's viewing direction to the fusion network. Its tracking component, BEV Track Recovery (BTR), uses low-confidence detections only to continue existing tracks. The same detections cannot start new tracks. With two WildTrack cameras, GRACE improves MOTA from 83.54 for TrackTacular, our baseline, to 91.07.

AI.tldr: GRACE：一种相机高效的多视角BEV跟踪器，通过体引导融合、射线条件化与BEV轨迹恢复，在两相机WildTrack上MOTA由83.54提升至91.07。
AI.motivation: 减少相机数量可降低部署成本，但会移除用于纠正投影导致的BEV响应偏离真实行人位置、以及抑制可分裂轨迹的短时分数骤降的视角信息，因此需要一种在少相机条件下仍能保持BEV跟踪性能的方法。
AI.method: GRACE包含三部分：（1）Volumetric-Guided Fusion，将基于单应的BEV特征与通过3D空间提升的特征融合；（2）Ray Conditioning，将每个相机的视线方向暴露给融合网络；（3）BEV Track Recovery（BTR），仅利用低置信度检测维持已有轨迹，且这些检测不能新建轨迹。
AI.result: 在两台WildTrack相机的设置下，GRACE将基线TrackTacular的MOTA从83.54提升至91.07。
AI.conclusion: GRACE在减少相机数量以降低部署成本的同时，通过体引导融合、射线条件化与保守的轨迹恢复策略有效缓解了视图缺失带来的BEV跟踪性能退化。

title: NeuroTS-Net: Multi-Class Semantic Segmentation of Pediatric Brain Tumors in Multi-Modal MRI
comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI) - BraTS Cluster of Challenges: Pediatric Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS-PEDs)
summary: Pediatric brain tumors are a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in children, and their small, rare, and often low-contrast subregions make accurate manual delineation challenging. Reliable automated segmentation is therefore needed to support diagnosis, treatment planning, and response assessment. Accordingly, we introduce NeuroTS-Net, a three-dimensional encoder-decoder convolutional neural network architecture for multi-class semantic segmentation that incorporates a dual-scale raw-detail stream, adaptive low-resolution context selection, and detail-preserving multipath downsampling. These components preserve fine intensity and boundary information while efficiently modeling broader tumor context. NeuroTS-Net was trained on the BraTS 2026 pediatric dataset without external data or pretrained weights and evaluated against nnU-Net and MedNeXt under the same experimental protocol. NeuroTS-Net outperformed the baseline methods, achieving whole-tumor and tumor-core Dice scores of 0.938 and 0.937 on the internal validation set and 0.927 and 0.926 on the official challenge validation set. The code is open-sourced at: https://github.com/maenstru56/NeuroTS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeuroTS-Net，一种用于儿童脑肿瘤多类语义分割的三维编解码卷积网络，在BraTS 2026儿科数据集上优于nnU-Net和MedNeXt。
AI.motivation: 儿童脑肿瘤是儿童癌症相关死亡的主要原因，其亚区体积小、罕见且对比度低，导致人工勾画困难，因此需要可靠的自动分割方法以支持诊断、治疗规划和疗效评估。
AI.method: NeuroTS-Net采用三维编码器-解码器卷积架构，包含双尺度原始细节流、自适应低分辨率上下文选择和细节保持多路径下采样，在保留精细强度与边界信息的同时高效建模肿瘤整体上下文；模型在BraTS 2026儿科数据集上从头训练，无外部数据或预训练权重。
AI.result: 在与nnU-Net和MedNeXt相同实验协议下，NeuroTS-Net取得更优表现：内部验证集全肿瘤和肿瘤核心Dice分别为0.938和0.937，官方挑战验证集分别为0.927和0.926。
AI.conclusion: NeuroTS-Net通过细节保留与多尺度上下文建模有效提升儿童脑肿瘤分割精度，超越基线方法，代码已开源。

title: Accelerated Decoding of Centroid Positional Encoding for Instance Segmentation
comment: Presented at 2026 Joint International Conference on AI, Big Data and Blockchain. Granada, Spain
summary: Beyond model inference, the decoding stage, which converts raw network outputs into task-level representations, constitutes a significant portion of the execution cost. Despite its practical impact, prediction decoding has received comparatively little attention and is often implemented using generic CPU routines or inefficient GPU kernels, limiting the benefits of advances in model efficiency. In this work, we investigate the decoding overhead associated with a recent sinusoidal centroid encoding for Instance Segmentation, in which each pixel regresses a positional embedding of its instance centroid. This approach allows flexible segmentation without predefined proposals, but extracting instance masks from dense embeddings incurs a high computational cost. We present an optimized CUDA-based implementation of the decoding algorithm tailored to this encoding, explicitly addressing challenges related to parallelization, synchronization, and memory access on modern GPUs. Our solution significantly reduces decoding overhead and improves End-to-End inference latency, outperforming both CPU-based approaches and naive GPU implementations. The results demonstrate that efficient decoding is essential to fully exploit the advantages of advanced output representations and highlight the importance of jointly designing encoding schemes and their decoding algorithms for real-time computer vision systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对实例分割中正弦质心编码的解码开销问题，提出优化的CUDA解码实现，显著降低解码开销并提升端到端推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 模型推理之外的解码阶段（将原始网络输出转换为任务级表示）占执行成本的显著部分，但预测解码长期被忽视，常以通用CPU例程或低效GPU内核实现，限制了模型效率提升带来的收益。作者希望解决正弦质心编码实例分割中从稠密嵌入提取实例掩码的高计算成本问题。
AI.method: 作者研究正弦质心编码（每个像素回归其实例质心的位置嵌入）的解码开销，该编码无需预定义候选框即可灵活分割，但从稠密嵌入提取实例掩码代价高昂。为此提出针对该编码定制的CUDA解码算法实现，明确处理现代GPU上的并行化、同步和内存访问挑战。
AI.result: 该方案显著降低了解码开销，改善端到端推理延迟，性能优于基于CPU的方法和朴素GPU实现。
AI.conclusion: 高效解码对于充分发挥先进输出表示的优势至关重要，并凸显了为实时计算机视觉系统联合设计编码方案及其解码算法的重要性。

title: Multi-modal Knowledge Preserving Adapter for Embedding Backward Compatibility
summary: Upgrading embedding models typically requires expensive database re-indexing, as new query embeddings are incompatible with existing database embeddings. While Backward Compatible Training (BCT) mitigates this by enforcing compatibility during training, existing approaches often require updating the backbone model. This is impractical because of significant training cost, the risk of performance regression, and limited access to proprietary model weights. We introduce Multi-modal Knowledge Preserving Adapter (MKP-Adapter), the first adapter-only BCT approach for Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that requires no backbone updates. We identified that the primary challenge in adapter-only BCT is preserving the knowledge of the new embeddings while enforcing backward compatibility. Hence, we propose a multi-level preservation loss that maintains the geometric structure of the embedding spaces throughout BCT. Furthermore, a focal re-weighting strategy is integrated to prioritize learning from challenging samples. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves strong backward compatibility across diverse multi-modal benchmarks (image, text, visual document, and video retrieval tasks) and model types. Notably, MKP-Adapter is trained solely on pre-extracted embeddings and requires only negligible additional latency relative to the original backbone forward pass, highlighting its efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出MKP-Adapter，首个面向多模态大模型的仅适配器式后向兼容训练方法，无需更新骨干模型。
AI.motivation: 升级嵌入模型通常需昂贵的数据库重索引，因为新查询嵌入与旧库嵌入不兼容。后向兼容训练（BCT）可缓解此问题，但现有方法需更新骨干模型，因训练成本高、存在性能退化风险且难以获取专有模型权重，实际不可行。
AI.method: MKP-Adapter 采用仅适配器方式，冻结骨干。核心是多级保持损失，在BCT过程中维持嵌入空间的几何结构以保留新嵌入知识；并引入focal重加权策略，优先学习困难样本。方法仅基于预提取的嵌入进行训练。
AI.result: 在图像、文本、视觉文档、视频检索等多模态基准及多种模型类型上取得强后向兼容性；额外延迟相对原骨干前向传播可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 仅适配器的BCT方案可有效兼顾新嵌入知识与后向兼容，且高效、无需骨干更新，适合实际部署。

title: VOR-Bench: A Human Perception-Driven Benchmark for Video Object Removal
summary: Despite its crucial role in video object removal (VOR), existing evaluation paradigms face two critical limitations: questionable references and a misalignment between tradi- tional metrics and human preference. To address these challenges, we introduce VOR- Bench, which advances VOR evaluation through three integrated components. First, we present the VOR Dataset (VORD), the first benchmark dataset providing both paired edited videos and graffiti masks. Its unique strength lies in a diverse data spectrum, which encompasses model-generated, tool-rendered, and camera-captured data, ensuring robust assessment across real-world scenarios. Second, we develop rMPAF, a realistic Motion- capable Paired-video Acquisition Framework. By combining the strengths of image- based object removal and fine-tuned video generation models, rMPAF automatically generates realistic, motion-coherent paired videos. Finally, we propose three evaluation dimensions and introduce VOR-MDSM, the first perception-driven VLM-based scoring model specifically designed for mask-guided VOR. It bridges the gap between arithmetic metrics and human perception by covering the essential visual attributes and matching nuanced human judgment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VOR-Bench yields evaluation results that align closely with human perception, achieving a remarkable cor- relation (\r{ho} > 0.9) with subjective assessments. We will release VOR-Bench along with its documentation to ensure full reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出VOR-Bench评测基准，通过VORD数据集、rMPAF配对视频获取框架和VOR-MDSM感知评分模型，解决视频物体移除评测中参考不可靠和指标与人类偏好不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频物体移除（VOR）评测范式存在两大局限：参考数据可疑（questionable references），以及传统算术指标与人类偏好之间存在错位。
AI.method: VOR-Bench包含三部分：（1）VORD数据集，首个同时提供配对编辑视频与涂鸦掩码的基准数据集，数据涵盖模型生成、工具渲染和相机拍摄三类来源；（2）rMPAF（真实运动能力配对视频获取框架），结合图像物体移除与微调视频生成模型，自动生成真实且运动连贯的配对视频；（3）三个评测维度及VOR-MDSM，首个面向掩码引导VOR的感知驱动VLM评分模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，VOR-Bench的评测结果与人类感知高度一致，与主观评价的相关性达ρ>0.9。作者将公开VOR-Bench及文档以保证完全可复现。
AI.conclusion: VOR-Bench通过数据集、配对视频生成框架和感知驱动评分模型的整合，弥合了算术指标与人类感知之间的差距，为视频物体移除提供了可靠、贴近人类判断的评测方案。

title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.

AI.tldr: 提出CARPM-FIQA，通过在整个训练轨迹上累积相对点间隔测量来稳定FR集成的FIQA，缓解单epoch质量估计的时序不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: 现有FR集成的FIQA方法存在时序不稳定：随训练中特征空间演化，单epoch质量估计波动，形成"移动目标"，损害可靠的质量预测。
AI.method: CARPM-FIQA累积整个训练轨迹上的相对点间隔（intra-class compactness与inter-class separation之比），以累积平均替代单epoch估计；理论上可降低质量估计方差、改善MSE、增强排序稳定性并具备收敛保证。
AI.result: 在SynFIQA数据集上累积平均取得更优判别能力，消融验证不同训练配置下一致改进；在八个基准、四个FR模型、两个FMR阈值下与十二种方法对比，CARPM-FIQA(L)与CARPM-FIQA(S)在17种方法中按pAUC-EDC与AUC-EDC均值分别列第4和第6，逐基准归一化后各FR模型均接近最优方法几个百分点内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为解决训练不稳定提供原则性方案，同时保留FR集成的性能优势，并表明时序聚合策略可稳定深度学习系统中因特征表示演化而目标值波动的训练目标。

title: Temporally Consistent Graph Extraction and Matching for Longitudinal Angiographic Images
summary: Recent advances in angiographic imaging have enabled longitudinal visualization of the microvasculature. Image processing pipelines based on vessel graphs are able to resolve subtle temporal changes at the level of individual blood vessels. However, current strategies for graph extraction, refinement, and matching are highly sensitive, with even minuscule differences in the underlying segmentation map resulting in substantially different vessel graphs. These artifacts severely inhibit the ability to accurately match sequential vessel graphs of the same subject over time. To address this problem, we propose a strategy that matches graphs before jointly refining them. Specifically, we perform an early matching after basic graph extraction before removing spurious bulges and merging junctions in both graphs using joint information. In experiments with complex retinal vessel graphs, we demonstrate that this strategy results in a higher matched area without graph fragmentation compared to separate or no refinement, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出"先匹配后联合细化"的血管图处理策略，以缓解分割差异导致的时序血管图不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 血管图匹配对分割图差异极度敏感，微小分割偏差即导致血管图显著不同，严重影响同一受试者时序血管图的准确匹配。
AI.method: 在基础图提取后先进行早期匹配，再利用联合信息在两张图中去除虚假膨出（spurious bulges）并合并连接点（junctions），实现匹配与联合细化的一体化流程。
AI.result: 在复杂视网膜血管图实验中，相比分别细化或无细化，该策略在避免图碎化的同时获得更高的匹配面积。
AI.conclusion: 先匹配再联合细化可提升时序血管图匹配的鲁棒性，为纵向微血管变化的可靠分析提供支持。

title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or copyrighted knowledge while preserving general utility. Existing methods often leave residual knowledge in intermediate representations, which can still be recovered. To address this, we propose Cascade, a hierarchical recoverability control framework that minimizes the internal identifiability of target knowledge. Cascade combines three complementary controls: path-level routing to suppress privacy-associated activation routes, representation-level compression to reduce geometric separability, and decoding-level intervention to limit residual recovery. Experiments on TOFU, MUSE-News, and WMDP, including robustness tests with query reformulation and extraction-style prompts, show that Cascade effectively reduces recoverability while maintaining stable model utility.

AI.tldr: 提出级联式分层可恢复性控制框架 Cascade，通过路径、表示、解码三层控制降低目标知识内部可辨识性，在多个基准上有效减少可恢复性并保持模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 遗忘方法常在中间表示中残留知识，这些残留在推理时仍可能被恢复，从而威胁敏感或受版权知识的真正移除。
AI.method: Cascade 是一个分层可恢复性控制框架，融合三种互补机制：路径级路由，抑制与隐私相关的激活路径；表示级压缩，降低几何可分性；解码级干预，限制残差恢复。
AI.result: 在 TOFU、MUSE-News、WMDP 数据集上，包括查询改写与抽取式提示的鲁棒性测试中，Cascade 有效降低了目标知识的可恢复性，同时保持稳定的模型效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过从激活路径、表示几何到解码输出的多层协同控制，可更彻底地消除中间表示残留导致的恢复风险，为更可靠的 LLM 遗忘提供了新思路。

title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures; 17-page supplementary material included as an ancillary PDF. v2: updated author contribution and correspondence information; scientific content unchanged
summary: Platform abuse campaigns conceal redirection instructions with emojis, homophones, character decomposition, and redundant symbols, then route users through disguised links to services associated with pornography, fraud, gambling, or illicit transactions. Existing benchmarks evaluate obfuscated text and risky webpages separately, obscuring how target recovery affects downstream evidence acquisition. We introduce RiskChainBench, pairing 3,600 synthetic token-text restoration inputs from 600 source sessions with 600 corresponding human-labeled local web environments. A model first restores the message, operational intent, and destination; the same underlying model then acts as a VLM-driven web agent that investigates the correctly associated website and produces a frozen, evidence-cited risk report without message-side semantics or domain-reputation cues. We score restoration and correct-routing web investigation separately and compose them offline by applying the frozen primary-entry prediction as a gate to the same Task 2 result. Human labels determine task correctness, while a fixed multimodal evidence judge assesses faithfulness, sufficiency, completeness, and consistency. Across ten models, Entry Top-1 ranges from 35.2% to 95.2% and web decision accuracy from 26.3% to 62.8%; the leading systems differ across entry recovery, full reconstruction, website decisions, and fine-grained typing. Execution failures account for 31.9% of web runs, whereas post-decision type errors account for only 0.9%, identifying stable exploration and risk judgment as the principal bottlenecks. We release the benchmark, protocol, and resettable local sandbox.

AI.tldr: 提出RiskChainBench，将混淆文本恢复与关联网页调查分解评测，揭示入口恢复是下游证据获取主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 平台滥用活动通过表情符号、谐音、拆字与冗余符号隐藏跳转指令，经伪装链接导向涉黄、诈骗、赌博或非法交易服务。现有基准将混淆文本评测与风险网页评测分离，掩盖了目标恢复对下游证据获取的影响。
AI.method: 构建RiskChainBench，将600个源会话生成的3,600条合成token-文本恢复输入与600个人工标注的本地网页环境配对。模型先恢复消息、操作意图与目的地；同一模型再作为VLM驱动的网页代理，在无消息侧语义与域名声誉线索条件下调查正确关联网站，产出冻结的、带证据引用的风险报告。恢复任务与正确路由的网页调查分别评分，离线以冻结的入口预测作为门控组合至同一Task 2结果；任务正确性由人工标签判定，忠实性、充分性、完整性与一致性由固定多模态证据评判器评估。
AI.result: 十个模型中，Entry Top-1为35.2%–95.2%，网页决策准确率为26.3%–62.8%；领先系统在入口恢复、完整重构、网站决策与细粒度类型判定上各不相同。执行失败占网页运行的31.9%，而决策后类型错误仅占0.9%。
AI.conclusion: 稳定的探索能力与风险判断是主要瓶颈，而非决策后分类。发布基准、协议与可重置本地沙箱。

title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech
summary: Counterspeech (CS) - direct responses that counter online Hate Speech (HS) using reasoning and alternative viewpoints - has emerged as an alternative to content removal. Current automatic CS generation methods, however, frequently produce generic, ineffective replies that fail to target the implicit stereotypes behind HS. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel scope-conditioned generation framework that explicitly integrates structured stereotype characteristics into Large Language Models prompts. We validate our approach on a novel, human-curated dataset annotated in English, Italian, and Spanish. Extensive evaluations show that stereotype-conditioned prompting substantially outperforms generic baselines across all three languages, obtaining significant gains in factuality, specificity, cogency, and effectiveness for both explicit and implicit implied stereotypes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于刻板印象特征条件的反仇恨言论生成框架，通过将结构化刻板印象特征融入大语言模型提示，在多语言数据集上优于通用基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自动反仇恨言论（CS）生成方法常产生泛化、无效的回复，无法针对仇恨言论背后的隐性刻板印象，因而难以有效替代内容删除策略。
AI.method: 提出“范围条件化”生成框架（scope-conditioned generation），将结构化的刻板印象特征显式整合进大语言模型提示中；并在一个新构建的人工标注数据集上进行验证，该数据集涵盖英语、意大利语和西班牙语三种语言。
AI.result: 刻板印象条件化提示在全部三种语言上均显著优于通用基线，在事实性（factuality）、具体性（specificity）、说服力（cogency）和有效性（effectiveness）方面取得显著提升，对显性与隐性刻板印象均有效。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入刻板印象特征的结构化条件化生成，是提升反仇恨言论自动生成质量的有效途径，且具备跨语言适用性。

title: Disrupted Companionship: A Risk Assessment Framework and Cross-Platform Quantitative Analysis of Psychosocial Responses to AI Companion Disruptions
summary: AI companions can provide meaningful relationships, yet these relationships remain vulnerable to platform-initiated changes. We study AI companion disruptions: platform changes that alter or terminate users' ongoing companionship with an AI. We compile 30 disruption events across major platforms, develop a taxonomy of six disruption types, identify three broad reasons for disruption, and propose a risk-assessment framework comprising four dimensions: relational discontinuity, population vulnerability, communication deficit, and transition-support deficit. Using longitudinal Reddit data, we estimate community-level psychosocial responses with a hierarchical Bayesian interrupted time-series model incorporating predictive controls. Across events, disruption onset was associated with immediate increases in anxiety, stress, suicidal expression, and grief activation, with relational discontinuity and transition-support deficit being associated with more adverse immediate responses across several outcomes. Our findings provide a cross-platform characterization of AI companion disruptions, quantitative evidence of their psychosocial impacts, and a prospective framework for assessing their potential risks before implementation.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统刻画了"AI伴侣中断"现象，构建了30起事件数据库与六类中断分类法，提出四维风险评估框架，并用分层贝叶斯中断时间序列模型证明中断发生与焦虑、压力、自杀表达及悲伤激活的即时上升相关。
AI.motivation: AI伴侣能提供有意义的关系，但这类关系易受平台主动变更的冲击；现有研究缺乏对中断事件的跨平台系统刻画及其心理社会影响的量化证据。
AI.method: 汇编主流平台30起中断事件，建立六类中断分类法与三类成因，提出含关系中断性、人群脆弱性、沟通缺失、过渡支持缺失四维度的风险评估框架；基于Reddit纵向数据，采用纳入预测性控制变量的分层贝叶斯中断时间序列模型，估计社区层面的心理社会反应。
AI.result: 中断发生与焦虑、压力、自杀表达和悲伤激活的即时上升相关；其中关系中断性与过渡支持缺失在多个结局上与更不利的即时反应相关联。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了AI伴侣中断的跨平台特征描述、其心理社会影响的量化证据，以及可在实施前评估潜在风险的前瞻性框架。

title: PiPS: Post-Hoc Prototypical Explanations for Interpretable Semantic Segmentation
summary: With the increasing deployment of deep neural networks in critical systems, such as medical diagnostics and autonomous vehicles, ensuring their interpretability is crucial to building trust in decision-making systems. In the field of explainable artificial intelligence, prototype-based reasoning has gained particular popularity, as it mimics human cognitive processes by explaining model decisions based on visual similarity under the looks like this paradigm. While this paradigm has been thoroughly investigated in the context of global image classification, the interpretability of dense predictions, particularly semantic segmentation, remains largely unexplored despite its immense importance in tasks requiring precise object localization. Existing prototype-based interpretable segmentation models rely on ante-hoc architectures, which entails significant limitations because they require costly training from scratch and modifications to the network structure, ultimately leading to a noticeable drop in predictive performance compared to standard black-box models. To address this issue, we propose PiPS (Post-hoc interpretable Prototypical Segmentation), the first fully post-hoc solution for generating prototypical explanations for semantic segmentation models. Our method enables the extraction of intuitive, spatially localized explanations from any pre-trained network without modification or fine-tuning, thereby preserving 100% of the model's original predictive performance. This approach opens a new avenue for the safe and cost-effective deployment of transparent systems in advanced computer vision tasks. Codebase available at https://github.com/gmum/PIPS.

AI.tldr: 提出PiPS，首个面向语义分割模型的事后原型解释方法，无需修改或微调预训练网络即可生成空间局部化的原型解释，完整保留原模型预测性能。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络广泛应用于医疗诊断、自动驾驶等关键系统，可解释性对建立信任至关重要。基于原型的推理因符合人类"看起来像"的认知过程而流行，但现有工作主要局限于全局图像分类；稠密预测尤其是语义分割的可解释性仍少有探索。已有的原型可解释分割模型依赖事前（ante-hoc）架构，需从零训练并改动网络结构，成本高且相对黑箱模型有明显性能损失。
AI.method: PiPS（Post-hoc interpretable Prototypical Segmentation）为完全事后（post-hoc）方案，从任意预训练分割网络中提取直观、空间局部化的原型解释，无需修改网络结构，也无需微调。
AI.result: 能够为语义分割模型生成局部化、可理解的原型解释，同时100%保留模型原始预测性能；代码开源于 https://github.com/gmum/PIPS。
AI.conclusion: PiPS为透明系统在高级计算机视觉任务中的安全、低成本部署开辟了新途径。

title: Lit3R: Retrieve-Relate-Read for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Scientific Literature
comment: Accepted at GroundLM 2026, an EMNLP 2026 Workshop LittraceQA
summary: We describe tus-nlp's Lit3R (Retrieve-Relate-Read) system for LitTraceQA, a shared task for literature-grounded question answering that requires systems to retrieve relevant papers, identify supporting evidence, and generate answers. Lit3R combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) components without task-specific training. The retriever iteratively combines BM25-based sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based verification, and complements retrieval based on the question with paper-to-paper expansion. The reader first identifies supporting evidence within individual papers and then synthesizes evidence across papers to produce the final answer and evidence trace. On the official test set, our system ranked 4th on the leaderboard. Our code is available at https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 tus-nlp 团队针对 LitTraceQA 任务构建的 Lit3R（Retrieve-Relate-Read）系统，通过组合检索、重排与大模型组件，在无需任务特定训练的情况下实现文献检索、证据识别与答案生成，官方测试集排名第4。
AI.motivation: LitTraceQA 是一个需要系统检索相关论文、识别支撑证据并生成答案的文献溯源问答共享任务。该任务要求系统不仅找到文献，还要给出可追溯的证据链，这对传统的单一检索或生成方法构成挑战。作者希望构建一个无需任务特定训练、可复用现成组件的通用系统来应对这一复杂任务。
AI.method: Lit3R 系统由检索与阅读两部分组成，全部使用现成组件、不做任务特定训练。检索端迭代结合 BM25 稀疏检索与稠密检索，并加入交叉编码器重排和基于大模型的验证；同时，在基于问题的检索之外，补充了论文到论文的扩展检索。阅读端先识别单篇论文内的支撑证据，再跨论文综合证据，生成最终答案与证据溯源。
AI.result: 在官方测试集排行榜上，该系统获得第4名。
AI.conclusion: 通过组合现成的稀疏/稠密检索、交叉编码器重排、大模型验证以及两阶段的证据识别与跨论文综合，Lit3R 在无需任务特定训练的情况下在 LitTraceQA 上取得了有竞争力的成绩（官方测试集第4名），证明该模块化、免训练框架对文献溯源问答任务的有效性。代码已开源。

title: TTTIR: Unlocking Instance-Specific State Evolution via Test-Time Training for Image Restoration
comment: TL;DR: TTTIR improves image restoration by framing it as an instance-specific state evolution process. Powered by Test-Time Training (TTT), it dynamically adapts operators to handle real-world degradations, outperforming state-of-the-art models with scalable efficiency. 11 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
summary: Image restoration is inherently challenging due to the diverse and highly input-dependent nature of real-world degradations. While recent architectures like Transformers and state-space models have advanced the field, they predominantly rely on static, globally shared parameters, which struggle to fully accommodate instance-specific degradation patterns. Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a promising paradigm for generating data-dependent operators, yet its standard self-supervised inner loop lacks the explicit guidance required to transition degraded features toward clean structures. To address this, we propose TTTIR, a novel framework that reformulates image restoration as an instance-specific state evolution process. Specifically, we design Progressive State Sequence Generation (PSSG) to construct complementary spatial-frequency target states (defining what to recover), and State Transition Evolution (STE) to adapt lightweight transition operators via a restoration-oriented TTT inner loop (determining how the features should evolve). Extensive experiments demonstrate that TTTIR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple image restoration benchmarks, achieving dynamic instance-specific recovery with favorable computational scalability. The code is available at https://github.com/Elysiaaaaaaaa/TTTIR.git.

AI.tldr: 提出TTTIR框架，将图像复原重构为实例特定的状态演化过程。
AI.motivation: 真实世界退化具有多样性且高度依赖输入，而现有Transformer与状态空间模型依赖静态、全局共享的参数，难以适配实例特定的退化模式；标准基于自监督内循环的测试时训练（TTT）缺乏显式引导，无法将退化特征转向干净结构。
AI.method: 设计渐进状态序列生成（PSSG）构建互补的空域-频域目标状态（定义"恢复什么"）；设计状态转移演化（STE），通过面向复原的TTT内循环自适应轻量转移算子（确定"特征如何演化"）。
AI.result: 在多个图像复原基准上持续超越现有最先进模型，实现动态的实例特定恢复，并具备良好的计算可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: TTTIR表明将图像复原建模为实例特定的状态演化过程可有效提升复原性能，代码已开源。

title: NeuroSymbEAD: A Large Scale Neuro-Symbolic Caption Dataset for Omni-Directional Embodied Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper introduces NeuroSymbEAD, a large-scale neuro-symbolic caption dataset featuring an ego-centric knowledge graph (KG) of static and dynamic objects annotated with classes, categories, heading directions, orientations, and distances from the ego-vehicle. These annotations are used on the KITTI-360 dataset to generate multilevel textual captions representing a lightweight version of an ego-centric scene map. Outdoor scene-map reconstruction, visual recognition, and object grounding establish baselines for driving common sense and traffic/scene understanding. For these purposes, natural language-based grounded captioning of objects and their complex relationships is a widely adopted contextual representation for indoor scene tasks. Neuro-symbolic representations have proven effective in handling structured information for various computer vision and language applications. Our data annotation pipeline allows the generation of varied map segments, populating simulated or real objects within the bounding boxes predicted by any 3D object detection network, and building hierarchical text captions. We benchmark our neuro-symbolic and ontological caption generation using pre-trained grounding and learned auto-regressive captioning networks. By converting 3D driving scenes into structured ego-centric language, NeuroSymbEAD provides a benchmark for vision-language and foundation models for traffic-scene explanation, 3D reasoning, and interpretable autonomous-driving perception.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NeuroSymbEAD，一个基于KITTI-360的大规模神经符号描述数据集，通过自我中心知识图谱对静态和动态物体进行类、类别、朝向、方位和距离标注，生成多层级文本描述，为自动驾驶感知的场景理解、3D推理与可解释性提供基准。
AI.motivation: 室内场景任务中，基于自然语言的物体及其复杂关系的接地描述已成为常用的上下文表征，神经符号表示在处理结构化信息方面也已被证明有效。但自动驾驶领域缺乏能够将3D驾驶场景转化为结构化自我中心语言的大规模基准，难以支撑交通场景解释、3D推理和可解释感知的研究。
AI.method: 在KITTI-360数据集上进行标注，构建包含静态与动态物体的自我中心知识图谱，标注物体的类、类别、朝向方向、方位和与自车的距离；利用数据标注流水线生成多样化的地图片段，可在任意3D目标检测网络预测的边界框内填充模拟或真实物体，并构建分层文本描述，形成轻量级自我中心场景图的神经符号与本体论描述。
AI.result: 使用预训练的接地模型和学习的自回归描述网络对神经符号与本体论描述生成进行了基准测试，并建立了户外场景图重建、视觉识别和目标接地等基线，用于驾驶常识与交通/场景理解。
AI.conclusion: 通过将3D驾驶场景转换为结构化的自我中心语言，NeuroSymbEAD为视觉-语言模型和基础模型在交通场景解释、3D推理以及可解释自动驾驶感知方面提供了基准。

title: Evaluating Mesh Reconstruction Methods for Crop Phenotyping
summary: Phenotyping an agricultural crop is crucial for studying its entire life cycle, as it provides vital insights to improve yield and, ultimately, food production. Doing the same for crops grown on remote sites is a challenge for the specialists who cannot be available on-site. 3D reconstruction techniques offer a promising solution to this problem by enabling crop digitization, allowing specialists to access the resulting 3D crop models from anywhere at any time. In this work, we evaluate recent 3D reconstruction pipelines for crop phenotyping. We focus on 7 mesh reconstruction pipelines and measure the fidelity and consistency of their outputs qualitatively and quantitatively. Our results suggest that the meshes produced by the GGGS, PGSR, and 2DGS are preferable to the other pipelines, owing to their quantitative metrics and visually pleasing outputs. The GGGS pipeline is better than the second-best pipeline (2DGS) by about 27\% on the radar chart with 5 dimensions, namely, User ratings, Chamfer distance, LPIPS, PSNR, and SSIM.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了7种网格重建流程在作物表型分析中的表现，结果表明GGGS、PGSR和2DGS在定量指标与视觉效果上更优，其中GGGS综合表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 作物表型分析对研究其全生命周期、提高产量和粮食生产至关重要，但偏远地区的作物难以由专家现场观测。3D重建技术可实现作物数字化，使专家随时随地访问3D作物模型，因此需要评估现有3D重建流程在作物表型分析中的适用性。
AI.method: 聚焦7种网格重建流程，对作物表型重建结果进行定性与定量评估，衡量其保真度与一致性。定量维度包括用户评分、Chamfer距离、LPIPS、PSNR和SSIM共5个维度。
AI.result: GGGS、PGSR和2DGS生成的网格在定量指标和视觉效果上优于其他流程。GGGS在5维雷达图上比第二名2DGS高出约27%。
AI.conclusion: GGGS、PGSR和2DGS更适合作物表型分析中的网格重建，其中GGGS表现最佳；3D重建流程为偏远地区作物表型分析提供了可行方案。

title: Verbalizing Subliminal Learning Effects Using Text Optimization
summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in which a distillation dataset transmits traits from the teacher model that are not legibly encoded in the dataset itself. This introduces a new challenge for model development and creates new risks from data poisoning. In this work, we use text optimization to detect subliminal learning effects and describe them as legible prompts. Subliminal learning from a prompted teacher motivates our approach. We observe that this is a special case of context distillation and leverage this observation to show that, in theory, the prompted subliminal learning dataset identifies the teacher's prompt. We reduce recovering this prompt to a text optimization problem and present a method to approximately solve it. Our method, SALVE (Search-Aided Latent Verbalization), optimizes a soft prompt, queries the same model to verbalize it as text, and uses beam search to make the verbalization reliable. In the standard subliminal learning setting, SALVE reliably recovers legible prompts that name the teacher's trait, while common text optimization methods fail to do so. In addition, we find that there are settings in which SALVE recovers the teacher's trait from a dataset even when subliminal learning fails, but that modifying student training to improve context distillation can create subliminal learning effects. We lastly show that SALVE detects subliminal learning effects in three additional settings: (1) mixtures of subliminal learning data and unrelated data, (2) data generated when the teacher is biased via activation steering, and (3) subsets of real preference data selected via Logit-Linear Selection. Overall, our results deepen our understanding of subliminal learning and present SALVE as a method to proactively detect subliminal learning effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALVE方法，将潜隐学习（subliminal learning）效应转化为可读提示以进行检测，理论上证明提示教师的数据集可识别教师提示，并通过软提示优化、模型自释义与束搜索实现可靠恢复。
AI.motivation: 潜隐学习会让蒸馏数据集在不显式编码的情况下传递教师模型的特质，给模型开发带来新挑战并产生数据投毒风险；因此需要一种主动检测潜隐学习效应的方法。
AI.method: 作者将来自提示教师的潜隐学习视为上下文蒸馏的特例，理论证明该数据集可识别教师提示，并把提示恢复问题归约为文本优化问题；据此提出SALVE（Search-Aided Latent Verbalization），优化软提示、查询同一模型将其释义为文本，并用束搜索提升释义可靠性。
AI.result: 在标准潜隐学习设定下，SALVE能可靠恢复指明教师特质的可读提示，而常见文本优化方法失败；此外，在某些设定下即使潜隐学习失败，SALVE也能从数据集中恢复教师特质，但修改学生训练以改进上下文蒸馏可产生潜隐学习效应；SALVE还在三种额外设定中检测到潜隐学习效应：潜隐学习数据与无关数据的混合、教师经激活引导产生偏差时的数据、以及通过Logit-Linear Selection选取的真实偏好数据子集。
AI.conclusion: 研究加深了对潜隐学习的理解，并将SALVE确立为一种可用于主动检测潜隐学习效应的方法。

title: MedPCFM-TED: One-Step Point Cloud Flow Matching for Implant Generation via Teacher-Guided Endpoint Distillation
summary: Cranial implant generation is an important task in medical imaging. Recent point cloud based generative methods, particularly flow matching, offer strong reconstruction quality and efficient sampling, but still require multiple neural function evaluations during inference. This limits rapid generation of multiple plausible implant candidates. We propose Teacher-guided Endpoint Distillation (TED), a simple one-step distillation framework for conditional cranial implant generation on point clouds. TED trains a one-step student using teacher-guided endpoint supervision and geometric matching losses, while avoiding explicit path straightening. We evaluate TED on the SkullFix and SkullBreak benchmarks. TED achieves the best overall performance on the SkullBreak dataset, remains competitive on SkullFix, and provides the strongest Chamfer distance performance among the compared one-step methods. In addition, TED generates implants in approximately 0.04s per sample. These results show that one-step distillation can substantially accelerate conditional point cloud implant generation without sacrificing reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出TED（教师引导端点蒸馏），一种针对点云条件颅骨植入物生成的一步蒸馏框架，避免显式路径拉直，在SkullBreak上取得最佳整体性能，单样本生成约0.04秒。
AI.motivation: 基于点云的流匹配生成方法重建质量高、采样高效，但推理时需多次神经函数评估，限制了快速生成多个合理植入物候选。
AI.method: TED使用教师引导的端点监督与几何匹配损失训练一步学生模型，避免显式路径拉直（path straightening），实现条件点云植入物生成。
AI.result: 在SkullFix和SkullBreak基准上评估：SkullBreak整体性能最佳，SkullFix上保持竞争力，在对比的一步方法中Chamfer距离表现最优，单样本生成约0.04秒。
AI.conclusion: 一步蒸馏可在不牺牲重建质量的前提下显著加速条件点云植入物生成。

title: High-Fidelity Video Quality Assessment with VQA-Specific Saliency
summary: No-reference video quality assessment (NR VQA) has recently seen promising progress with deep learning. However, video data is inherently large, and processing them with deep models incurs high computational cost. This challenge is particularly acute in VQA, where preserving original-resolution cues and dense temporal information is critical for accuracy. Existing efficiency-driven preprocessing strategies, such as fragmenting, reduce computation but alter the input data distribution, limiting effective reuse of pretrained video foundation models (ViFMs). To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{H}igh-\textbf{F}idelity \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{Q}uality \textbf{A}ssessment (\textbf{HFVQA}), a framework built on fixed-size spatio-temporal (ST) patches that is fully compatible with pretrained ViFMs. HFVQA samples ST patches across multiple scales, including the original resolution, with minimal temporal subsampling to preserve low-level quality cues and semantic context. To limit computation, HFVQA introduces a lightweight auxiliary network trained end-to-end with the ViFM encoder to learn \textit{VQA-specific saliency}. Distilled directly from quality supervision, this saliency captures task-specific importance patterns, reflecting that video quality perception is dominated by a small subset of spatio-temporal regions. By combining high-fidelity spatio-temporal cues with learned, task-specific saliency, HFVQA achieves SOTA performance on standard NR VQA benchmarks while processing as little as 12\% of candidate ST patches, making high-fidelity ViFM-based VQA computationally tractable.

AI.tldr: 提出HFVQA框架，基于固定尺寸时空patch、兼容预训练视频基础模型，通过轻量辅助网络学习VQA特定显著性，仅处理约12%候选patch即达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 无参考视频质量评估（NR VQA）虽在深度学习下取得进展，但视频数据量庞大、深度模型计算成本高。保留原始分辨率线索和密集时间信息对精度至关重要，而现有以效率为导向的预处理（如分片）会改变输入分布，限制预训练视频基础模型（ViFM）的有效复用。
AI.method: HFVQA基于固定尺寸时空（ST）patch构建，与预训练ViFM完全兼容。它跨多个尺度（含原始分辨率）采样ST patch，并以最小时间下采样保留低层质量线索与语义上下文。为控制计算量，引入轻量辅助网络，与ViFM编码器端到端训练以学习VQA特定显著性；该显著性直接由质量监督蒸馏得到，捕捉任务特定重要性模式，反映视频质量感知由少数时空区域主导。
AI.result: 结合高保真时空线索与学习到的任务特定显著性，HFVQA在标准NR VQA基准上达到SOTA性能，同时仅处理约12%的候选ST patch，使基于ViFM的高保真VQA在计算上可行。
AI.conclusion: HFVQA通过固定尺寸patch采样与任务特定显著性学习的结合，在保持高保真时空信息与兼容预训练ViFM的同时大幅降低计算量，实现了精度与效率的兼顾。

title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment. This limits their ability to adapt how they gather evidence, invoke tools, verify signals, and manage risk under changing market regimes. We introduce EvolveTrade, a self-evolving framework that treats the system prompt of a tool-using trading agent as a text-parameterized policy. After each update interval, a Policy Agent revises this policy using accumulated decision traces and realized portfolio feedback, while keeping the backbone LLM fixed. The updated policy is then used for the next batch of trading decisions, enabling the agent to refine its information-acquisition and portfolio-construction procedure over time. Experiments across multiple market regimes and two LLM backbones show that EvolveTrade often improves Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return over fixed-policy LLM baselines, achieving the improved SR and CR in most evaluated settings. Behavioral analyses further show that self-evolved policies increase code-mediated analysis and activate regime-relevant computations; case-level policy-to-return attributions trace how policy-induced allocation changes contribute to realized return differences. These results suggest that adapting the reusable procedure governing tool use is a key direction for building more robust LLM trading agents.

AI.tldr: EvolveTrade 将工具调用型交易代理的系统提示视为可文本参数化策略，利用决策轨迹与组合反馈周期性自我修订，在固定骨干 LLM 下提升夏普比率与累计收益。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 交易代理使用部署前写定的静态工具调用策略，难以随市场状态变化调整证据获取、工具调用、信号验证与风险管理方式。
AI.method: 提出 EvolveTrade 自演化框架：把工具使用型交易代理的系统提示作为文本参数化策略；每个更新周期后，由 Policy Agent 基于累积决策轨迹与已实现组合反馈修订策略，骨干 LLM 保持不变；更新后的策略用于下一批交易决策。
AI.result: 在多种市场状态与两种 LLM 骨干上，EvolveTrade 在多数评估设置中相较固定策略 LLM 基线提升了夏普比率与累计收益。行为分析显示自演化策略增加代码中介分析并激活与市场状态相关的计算；案例级“策略—收益”归因表明策略诱导的配置变化贡献了实际收益差异。
AI.conclusion: 适应并演化支配工具使用的可复用流程，是构建更稳健 LLM 交易代理的关键方向。

title: HUMAID-NER: A Disaster Tweet Dataset for Joint Named Entity Recognition and Event Classification via Uncertainty-Weighted Multitask Learning
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Published in The Asian Bulletin of Big Data Management, Vol. 6, No. 1, pp. 138-152, 2026
summary: Rapid extraction of structured information from social media is important for humanitarian response, yet existing disaster tweet resources mainly provide document-level category labels without span-level entity annotations. We introduce HUMAID-NER, the first named entity recognition dataset built on the HumAID benchmark, containing 60,000 English disaster tweets annotated in BIO format across ten operationally motivated entity types and yielding approximately 175,000 labelled entity spans. Annotations are generated through a reproducible three-stage hybrid pipeline combining a spaCy transformer model, disaster-domain EntityRuler patterns, and structured regular expressions with priority-based overlap resolution. We also propose a joint multitask learning framework that performs disaster-specific named entity recognition and humanitarian event classification using a shared RoBERTa-large encoder. To reduce task conflict during joint training, the model uses homoscedastic uncertainty weighting with learnable task parameters and a two-stage training schedule that freezes the lower 18 of 24 encoder layers in the second stage. On the HUMAID-NER validation set, the proposed system achieves NER span micro-F1 of 0.841 and classification macro-F1 of 0.761 simultaneously. A real-time web dashboard demonstrates end-to-end deployment. The dataset, models, and pipeline code are released to support reproducibility and future crisis informatics research.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个基于HumAID的灾害推文命名实体识别数据集HUMAID-NER（6万条英文推文、10类实体、约17.5万实体跨度，BIO标注），并提出共享RoBERTa-large编码器的多任务联合框架，同时完成灾害NER与人道主义事件分类，验证集上NER跨度micro-F1达0.841、分类macro-F1达0.761。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体结构化信息对灾害人道主义响应具有重要价值，但现有灾害推文资源多只提供文档级类别标签，缺少跨度级实体标注，难以支撑细粒度信息抽取。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：基于HumAID基准，构建HUMAID-NER，包含6万条英文灾害推文，按BIO格式标注10类面向救援操作的实体类型，产出约17.5万个实体跨度；标注采用可复现的三阶段混合流水线（spaCy transformer模型+灾害领域EntityRuler模式+结构化正则表达式），并通过基于优先级的重叠消解策略融合。2) 模型：提出多任务联合学习框架，使用共享RoBERTa-large编码器同时进行灾害NER与人道主义事件分类；采用同方差不确定性加权（带可学习任务参数）缓解任务冲突，并设计两阶段训练策略，第二阶段冻结24层编码器中的低18层。
AI.result: 在HUMAID-NER验证集上，系统同时取得NER实体跨度micro-F1=0.841、分类macro-F1=0.761；并实现了实时Web仪表盘用于端到端部署。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了灾害推文跨度级实体标注资源的空白，验证了多任务联合建模在灾害信息抽取中的有效性；数据集、模型与流水线代码均已开源，以支持可复现性与危机信息学研究。

title: Target-Language Generation in Multilingual Models: Activation Steering and Optimal Control
summary: Ensuring that multilingual language models generate coherent text in a specific target language is a major issue in multilingual language modeling. We develop an optimal control method for target-language text generation as well as a framework for evaluating the quality of generated text in terms of language adherence, linguistic coherence, and semantic coherence. We find that the proposed method performs at least as well as the prominent difference-in-means activation steering method for the majority of models tested, with substantially less hyperparameter tuning required.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向目标语言文本生成的最优控制方法，并构建了从语言依从性、语言连贯性与语义连贯性三方面评估生成质量的框架；该方法在多数被测模型上至少与主流的均值差激活引导方法相当，且超参数调优需求显著更低。
AI.motivation: 多语言语言模型需确保在指定目标语言下生成连贯文本，这是多语言建模的核心难题；现有方法（如均值差激活引导）往往需要大量超参数调优。
AI.method: 为目标语言文本生成设计一种最优控制方法，并配套建立评估框架，从语言依从性、语言连贯性和语义连贯性三个维度衡量生成文本质量。
AI.result: 在多数被测模型上，所提方法的表现至少与主流的均值差激活引导方法持平，同时所需的超参数调优显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 最优控制方法为目标语言生成提供了一种有效且更易部署的替代方案，兼顾生成质量与调参效率。

title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs
summary: Open-weight language models publish the strings their chat templates use to mark turns, roles and tool results, which the tokenizer maps back to the reserved identifiers the model obeys. Anyone who controls text in a prompt can therefore write a turn boundary indistinguishable from one the serving stack wrote. We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems rely on. We propose nameless tokenization, which leaves the control entries with a reserved identifier and no surface string, so the content encoder cannot emit one and message content reaches the model unaltered. Across five tokenizer families it reproduces the standard token stream exactly on attack-free data and lifts accuracy on a probe of delimiter-bearing text from 8.5% to 59.9%, where sanitizers lose it. Separating a delimiter's appearance from its identifier shows the identifier matters little against a bare task instruction, but carries most of a forged tool result and most of any forged turn once the system message tells the model to treat user content as data.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了256个已部署的聊天分词器，发现全部可被"伪造"对话边界；提出的nameless tokenization通过让控制符仅保留保留标识符、不保留表面字符串，从而阻止内容编码器生成可伪造的边界标记，在无攻击数据上完全复现标准token流，并将含分隔符文本的探针准确率从8.5%提升至59.9%。
AI.motivation: 开放权重语言模型公开其聊天模板用于标记轮次、角色和工具结果的字符串，分词器会将其映射回模型所遵循的保留标识符。因此，任何控制提示中文本的人都能写出与服务栈所写边界无法区分的轮次边界，构成注入/伪造风险。现有推荐修复方案（如某类标志）仍遗漏工具与推理标记，导致56.6%仍可伪造，需要更根本的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 对256个已部署聊天分词器进行可伪造性审计；2) 提出nameless tokenization：控制条目仅保留保留标识符而无表面字符串，使内容编码器无法吐出该字符串，消息内容原样到达模型；3) 在五个分词器家族上验证，并与清洗器（sanitizers）对比，进行含分隔符文本的探针评测；4) 通过分离分隔符的"出现"与"标识符"来剖析标识符本身的作用。
AI.result: 所有256个聊天分词器均可伪造；常规推荐的标志修复仍留56.6%可伪造，因其遗漏了工具和推理标记。Nameless tokenization在五个分词器家族的无攻击数据上精确复现标准token流；在含分隔符文本探针上准确率由8.5%提升至59.9%，而清洗器在此场景下失效。分离实验显示：标识符对照普通任务指令作用不大，但在系统消息要求模型将用户内容视为数据时，标识符承担了大部分伪造工具结果和大部分伪造轮次的效果。
AI.conclusion: 聊天模板中的可伪造边界是普遍且被现有修复遗漏的安全问题，尤其在依赖工具与推理标记的智能体系统中。Nameless tokenization通过彻底移除控制符的表面字符串，在不影响正常（无攻击）输入的前提下消除内容端伪造能力，是一种比清洗或简单标志更有效的防护方案。

title: Autoformalizing Argumentative Material Inferences
summary: Natural language arguments are compelling before they are formally explicit. A premise supports a claim through defeasible warrants, background commitments, and exception conditions that the text leaves implicit. However, formal verification requires the opposite. Making such arguments machine-checkable requires constructing the missing commitments, not only translating given sentences into logic. Construction, however, carries a risk that translation does not: a system free to add premises can make any claim provable, and a formally valid proof may assert the claim outright, prove it without the original premise, or establish more than the claim itself. We address this problem by formulating autoformalization for argumentative material inference as guard completion, in which non-monotonic material support is turned into monotonic formal inference relative to an explicitly constructed guard set. A completion is accepted only when its proof both passes the theorem prover and survives contrastive tests of premise dependence and claim selectivity. We implement this formulation in GUARD, a neuro-symbolic framework in which LLMs construct and formalize candidate guards, Isabelle/HOL verifies the resulting theories and returns step-level feedback for iterative refinement, and the system abstains when no faithful completion can be reached. Our empirical results on Debatepedia and ARCT using different LLMs demonstrate that GUARD yields significant improvements in verified-faithful (+35.3, +32.9 points) and substantial reductions in leakage (-25.9, -21.9 points) over the state-of-the-art LLM-driven theorem proving approach. Moreover, we show that the symbolic soft critique and the explicit assumption layer account for most of these gains, with the soft critique also improving the initial validity of the elicited context and reducing the number of iterations required for successful verification.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将论辩性物质推理的自动形式化建模为"守卫补全"(guard completion)，通过显式构造守卫集把非单调支持转化为单调形式推理，并在GUARD神经符号框架中实现，利用LLM构造守卫、Isabelle/HOL验证并经对比测试筛选，在Debatepedia与ARCT上显著提升验证忠实度并降低命题泄漏。
AI.motivation: 自然语言论辩依赖隐含的可废止担保、背景承诺与例外条件，而形式验证要求显式完备的前提，因此机器可检验论辩的难点不只是翻译句子，而是补全缺失承诺；但自由添加前提会带来风险：系统可能使任意主张可证，导致形式有效的证明直接断言主张、脱离原始前提或将结论过度泛化。
AI.method: 将论辩性物质推理的自动形式化形式化为"守卫补全"：在显式构造的守卫集下把非单调物质支持转为单调形式推理；补全被接受需同时通过定理证明器验证并经受住前提依赖与主张选择性的对比测试。实现为GUARD神经符号框架：LLM构造并形式化候选守卫，Isabelle/HOL验证生成的理论并返回步骤级反馈用于迭代精化，无法达成忠实补全时系统弃权。
AI.result: 在Debatepedia和ARCT上使用不同LLM的实验中，GUARD相较于最先进的LLM驱动定理证明方法，验证忠实度显著提升(+35.3、+32.9分)，命题泄漏大幅降低(-25.9、-21.9分)；消融显示符号软批判与显式假设层贡献了大部分增益，软批判还提升了所抽取上下文的初始有效性并减少成功验证所需迭代次数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明自动形式化论辩论证应以守卫补全而非单纯翻译为核心，并通过证明器验证与对比测试的双重约束抑制无根据前提的任意添加；GUARD在验证忠实度与泄漏控制上优于现有LLM驱动定理证明方法，其中符号反馈与显式假设层是关键增益来源，并在无忠实补全时可弃权以保证可靠性。

title: The Role of Implicit and Explicit Demographic Signals in Large Language Model-based Student Assessment
summary: Large Language Models are now common in student assessment, but we know little about how student demographics affect their use. Sometimes, considering student demographics may be necessary -- for example, to improve readability for users with lower educational levels. However, it also risks being a cause of discrimination, e.g., when assigning lower scores to students from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. We set up controlled prompts to test 1) explicit demographic effects, where we mention demographic details directly, and 2) implicit effects, where we use conversation history as a demographic signal. We test these settings in three tasks: Automated Essay Scoring, Formative Feedback, and Metalinguistic Question Answering. We test six state-of-the-art LLMs on these tasks. In both explicit and implicit cases, the models pick up on demographic cues and can change their scoring, feedback, and answers accordingly. We find that LLMs frequently adjust the readability of feedback to education levels when these are explicitly mentioned. On the other hand, implicit conditions produce unpredictable biases, such as in question answering, where responses from lower-education levels receive lower sentiment scores. Our results provide clear evidence of demographic sensitivity in LLMs for educational assessment tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控提示测试大语言模型在教育评估任务中对学生人口统计特征的显性及隐性敏感性，发现模型会因人口统计线索而改变评分、反馈与答案，且隐性条件会产生不可预测的偏见。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已广泛用于学生评估，但学生人口统计特征如何影响其使用尚不清楚。考虑人口统计信息有时是必要的（如为低教育水平用户提升可读性），但也存在歧视风险（如给低社会经济背景学生更低分数）。因此有必要系统检验LLM的人口统计敏感性。
AI.method: 设计受控提示，区分两类效应：1）显性人口统计效应，直接提及人口统计细节；2）隐性效应，以对话历史作为人口统计信号。在三个任务（自动作文评分、形成性反馈、元语言问答）中，测试六个最先进LLM。
AI.result: 在显性和隐性两种情况下，模型均能捕捉人口统计线索并相应改变评分、反馈和答案。显性提及教育水平时，LLM频繁调整反馈的可读性以匹配教育水平；隐性条件下则产生不可预测的偏见，例如在问答中，来自较低教育水平的回答获得更低的情感分数。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了LLM在教育评估任务中存在人口统计敏感性的明确证据，提示需关注其潜在的歧视风险。

title: PaperDoctor: Evidence-Grounded and Actionable Feedback for Scientific Papers in Progress
summary: Autoresearch agents are reshaping the research ecosystem, but they can also let flawed claims enter the literature at scale. Human advisors catch such issues in drafts through careful, traceable feedback, yet advisor-style assessment requires extensive manual effort and does not scale. To shift automated paper assessment from a judge to a diagnostician, we introduce PaperDoctor, an agent framework for pre-submission feedback with three key innovations. First, a holistic hierarchical framework evaluates writing, layout, references, code, theory, prior work, and experiments through three layers: L1 surface screening, L2 typed verifiers that route each claim to the appropriate evidence, and L3 reproducers that rerun experiments by priority. Second, each finding contains an observation, a pointer to specific evidence such as a sentence, equation, or code line, and a revision suggestion, making critiques auditable and actionable. Third, PaperDoctor selectively rebuilds and reruns experiments based on claim importance and compute budget, surfacing reproducibility gaps and quantitative limitations that are invisible from the manuscript alone. We evaluate PaperDoctor on 30 in-progress papers, yielding 70.6% agreement and all positive holistic scores, and on 40 manuscripts across machine learning, natural science, and social science, covering human- and AI-authored papers with code. Overall, PaperDoctor produces more auditable feedback than human and other agentic reviewers, pairs critiques with concrete suggestions by design, and complements dimensions often overlooked by human reviewers. We also develop an interactive interface that lets authors browse findings grounded in their paper. PaperDoctor reframes automated paper assessment as diagnosis rather than verdict, taking a concrete step toward AI advisors for more rigorous AI-assisted scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PaperDoctor，一个可审计、可操作的投稿前论文诊断智能体框架，将自动论文评估从"裁判"转变为"诊断者"。
AI.motivation: 自动研究智能体扩大了科研产出规模，但可能让有缺陷的结论大规模进入文献。人类导师能通过细致、可追溯的反馈发现问题，但此类"导师式"评估需大量人工且难以规模化。因此需要把自动化论文评估从给出结论的评判者转变为能诊断问题的诊断者。
AI.method: PaperDoctor 包含三项核心设计：1）分层整体框架，通过 L1 表层筛查、L2 类型化验证器（将每条论断路由至相应证据）、L3 复现器（按优先级重跑实验）评估写作、排版、参考文献、代码、理论、前人工作和实验；2）每条发现均包含观察、指向具体证据（句子、公式或代码行）的指针及修订建议，使批评可审计、可操作；3）依据论断重要性与算力预算，选择性重建并重跑实验，暴露仅凭稿件无法察觉的可复现性缺口与量化局限。
AI.result: 在 30 篇进行中的论文上评估，取得 70.6% 一致率且整体评分均为正面；在涵盖机器学习、自然科学与社会科学、包含人类与 AI 撰写且有代码的 40 篇稿件上进行测试。总体而言，PaperDoctor 产出的反馈比人类及其他智能体审稿人更可审计，其批评在设计上即与具体建议配对，并补充了人类审稿人常忽视的维度；同时开发了供作者浏览基于其论文的发现的交互界面。
AI.conclusion: PaperDoctor 将自动化论文评估重构为"诊断"而非"裁决"，是迈向 AI 导师、促进更严谨 AI 辅助科学发现的具体一步。

title: Can LLMs Follow the Pulse of a Crisis? Evaluating Crisis Sentiment in Bangladesh's July Uprising
summary: Crisis sentiment analysis is especially challenging for low-resource languages such as Bangla, where language, context, and public reaction shift rapidly. We introduce UNRESTSENT200K, a Bangla crisis sentiment dataset with approximately 200K Facebook and YouTube comments from the July-August 2024 Bangladesh uprising. The dataset covers five event-aligned phases, from early escalation and internet blackout to regime transition and a later flood crisis. Each comment is linked to its parent post, enabling evaluation with and without discourse context. All comments are annotated through a fully human process involving 14 native Bangla-speaking annotators and senior validation, achieving substantial agreement (kappa = 0.73, alpha = 0.71) and 94.2% blind-audit agreement. We benchmark fine-tuned encoders, prompted LLMs, and LoRA-tuned LLMs. Results show that parent-post context consistently improves performance, while temporal shift across phases causes large performance drops. Strong LLMs perform well, but still struggle with sarcasm, implicit political references, and phase-dependent meaning. UNRESTSENT200K provides a benchmark for studying context-aware and temporally robust sentiment analysis in low-resource crisis discourse. UNRESTSENT200K is available at https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT200K/

AI.tldr: 本文提出UNRESTSENT200K——一个约20万条孟加拉语Facebook和YouTube评论的危机情感分析数据集，覆盖2024年7-8月孟加拉国事件的五个阶段，采用全人工标注，并基于此基准评测了微调编码器、提示LLM与LoRA微调LLM。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如孟加拉语）的危机情感分析极具挑战：语言、语境与公众情绪在危机中快速演变，而现有资源稀缺，缺乏带语境、跨时间阶段的数据集与基准。
AI.method: 构建UNRESTSENT200K数据集：约20万条孟加拉语Facebook与YouTube评论，覆盖五个事件对齐阶段；每条评论关联其父帖文，以支持有/无话语语境的评测。标注由14名孟加拉语母语标注者完成并经理级校验，标注一致性kappa=0.73、alpha=0.71，盲审一致性94.2%。在此基准上评测微调编码器、提示式LLM与LoRA微调LLM三类方法。
AI.result: 父帖语境一致提升性能；跨阶段的时间漂移导致性能大幅下降；强LLM整体表现良好，但在讽刺、隐性政治指涉及阶段依赖语义上仍有困难。
AI.conclusion: UNRESTSENT200K为低资源危机话语中的语境感知与时间鲁棒情感分析提供了基准，数据集已公开。

title: Symmetry-Aware Likelihood-Orbit Aggregation for Selective Left-Right Claim Verification
summary: Frozen vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on fine-grained left-right claims, and raw claim likelihoods need not reliably rank verification errors. After a horizontal-reflection intervention is fixed, how should its induced likelihood measurements be combined into a selective verification signal? We introduce Relation-Orbit, a closed-form contrast with no learned fusion parameters that assigns eight normalized likelihoods to query-supporting and counterfactual roles determined by reflection, inverse relation, and entity exchange. A claim is asserted only when the signed contrast exceeds a threshold selected on held-out data using pointwise Clopper-Pearson upper confidence bounds. On VSR and GQA across four frozen VLMs, Relation-Orbit yields higher mean test coverage at a 10% selective-risk calibration target than an all-eight Orbit-Max baseline in all eight dataset-backbone settings; gains over a nearly abstain-all one-sided intervention score are reported separately. A separate LLaVA-1.5/COCO evaluation, reduced-orbit controls, and a two-sided partition diagnostic further characterize the structural advantage.

AI.tldr: 提出 Relation-Orbit，一种无需学习融合参数的闭式对比方法，将水平反射诱导的八个归一化似然组合为选择性验证信号，在 VSR 与 GQA 上提升测试覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 冻结的视觉语言模型在细粒度左右关系判断上不可靠，且原始声明似然无法稳定地对验证错误排序；在固定水平反射干预后，如何将其诱导的似然测量组合成有效的选择性验证信号尚待解决。
AI.method: Relation-Orbit 通过反射、逆关系与实体交换确定查询支持角色与反事实角色，为每个声明分配八个归一化似然；以带符号对比作为信号，仅当其超过在留出数据上通过逐点 Clopper-Pearson 上置信界选定的阈值时才断言该声明；方法为闭式、无学习融合参数。
AI.result: 在 VSR 与 GQA 上、跨四个冻结 VLM，于 10% 选择性风险校准目标下，Relation-Orbit 在全部八个“数据集-骨干”设置中的平均测试覆盖率均高于 all-eight Orbit-Max 基线；相对近乎全弃权的单侧干预得分的增益另行列报；LLaVA-1.5/COCO 评估、缩减轨道对照与双侧划分诊断进一步刻画其结构优势。
AI.conclusion: 将水平反射诱导的多角色似然以闭式带符号对比方式组合，可在无需训练融合参数的情况下提供更可靠的选择性验证信号，在覆盖率上稳定优于基线，并具备可解释的结构性优势。

title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents
summary: Lifelong conversational agents rely on memory systems to maintain deep, context-aware interactions with users. However, existing explicit textual memory pipelines suffer from a severe information bottleneck, often losing subtle behavioral patterns and emotional shifts. Furthermore, being typically static post-deployment, they cannot autonomously adapt to personal habits and preferences without manual feedback. Cognitive science, however, suggests that humans maintain mental models purely in a latent space and continuously refine them through predictive coding. Inspired by this, we propose \textbf{ThinkFlow}, a novel end-to-end latent memory framework for lifelong conversational agents. ThinkFlow bypasses the text bottleneck by dynamically compressing conversational flows into probabilistic latent memory skills, autonomously consolidating complex user states into disentangled, continuous vectors without semantic interference. To break this barrier, we introduce a test-time evolution paradigm. By coupling teacher-guided latent alignment to bootstrap the initial state with a self-supervised next-user-utterance prediction task for continuous refinement, the framework successfully overcomes cold-start challenges and achieves label-free lifelong personalization. Extensive experiments on long-term conversation benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkFlow significantly outperforms prevailing memory systems, providing highly personalized and contextually accurate responses over extended multi-session interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ThinkFlow，一种端到端潜在记忆框架，通过将对话流压缩为概率潜在记忆技能，并结合测试时演化范式，突破文本记忆瓶颈，实现免标注的终身个性化对话。
AI.motivation: 终身对话代理依赖记忆系统维持深度、上下文感知的交互，但现有显式文本记忆管线存在严重信息瓶颈，易丢失细微行为模式与情绪变化；且部署后静态不变，无法在没有人工反馈的情况下自主适应用户习惯与偏好。认知科学表明人类在潜在空间中维护心智模型并通过预测编码持续精炼，受此启发提出潜在记忆方案。
AI.method: ThinkFlow绕过文本瓶颈，将对话流动态压缩为概率潜在记忆技能，把复杂用户状态自主整合为解耦的连续向量，避免语义干扰。为突破冷启动与终身适应难题，引入测试时演化范式：以教师引导的潜在对齐引导初始状态，并结合自监督的下一用户话语预测任务进行持续精炼，实现免标签的终身个性化。
AI.result: 在长期对话基准上的大量实验表明，ThinkFlow显著优于主流记忆系统，在跨多轮会话的长期交互中能提供高度个性化且上下文准确的回复。
AI.conclusion: ThinkFlow验证了以潜在空间记忆替代显式文本记忆的可行性，通过测试时演化实现了无人工反馈的终身个性化，为终身对话代理的记忆机制提供了新范式。

title: sensVLA: Spatially-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Model for Autonomous Wheel Loader
comment: Accepted at ICRA 2026: From Data to Decisions: VLA Pipelines for Real Robots
summary: Autonomous wheel-loader control requires joint reasoning over task semantics, egocentric vision, proprioception, and 3D scene geometry. We present sensVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architecture that combines a Qwen3-2B Vision-Language Model (VLM) with a fully trainable transformer action expert trained by flow-matching velocity regression. sensVLA routes Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features, extracted from fused front and rear lidar, directly to the action expert through a dedicated cross-attention pathway, while the VLM consumes front and rear RGB views to provide task-conditioned semantic context. This design decouples spatial grounding from linguistic reasoning while preserving interaction between both streams at decision time. The expert predicts six action dimensions: longitudinal velocity, steering, body-frame displacement, arm rate, and bucket rate. On a real-world dataset from a wheel loader, sensVLA reaches aggregate per-step parity with a strong camera-only baseline and reduces longitudinal velocity RMSE by 28% and displacement error by 9% on loading centric scenarios. It also degrades 29% less when the camera stream is corrupted or removed, evidencing that explicit spatial grounding improves accuracy and fault-tolerance for heavy equipment autonomy.

AI.tldr: sensVLA将Qwen3-2B VLM与流匹配动作专家结合，把融合激光雷达的BEV特征经专用交叉注意力路径直接送入动作专家，VLM仅用前后RGB提供语义上下文，实现空间定位与语言推理解耦。在真实轮式装载机数据上达到与强相机基线相当的逐步精度，装载场景下纵向速度RMSE降低28%、位移误差降低9%，相机受损时性能衰减少29%。
AI.motivation: 自主轮式装载机控制需联合推理任务语义、第一视角视觉、本体感知与三维场景几何。现有方法多依赖相机，空间定位与语义推理耦合，导致精度与鲁棒性受限，尤其在相机流受损时性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出sensVLA视觉-语言-动作架构：以Qwen3-2B VLM承担任务条件化语义上下文（输入前后RGB视图），动作专家为全可训练Transformer并用流匹配速度回归训练；将前后激光雷达融合得到的BEV特征经专用交叉注意力路径直接路由至动作专家，实现空间定位与语言推理解耦并在决策时刻保持两流交互。专家输出六维动作：纵向速度、转向、机体坐标系位移、臂速率与铲斗速率。
AI.result: 在真实轮式装载机数据集上，sensVLA总体逐步精度与强纯相机基线持平；装载相关场景中纵向速度RMSE降低28%，位移误差降低9%；当相机流被损坏或移除时，性能退化比基线少29%。
AI.conclusion: 显式空间定位（BEV+激光雷达路径）可同时提升重型装备自主作业的精度与容错性，且解耦式双流设计在保持决策交互的同时优于纯相机方案。

title: CLARE: Scalable Class-Incremental Continual Learning via a Sparsity-Based Framework
summary: Continual learning must balance the learning of new knowledge with the retention of previously learned knowledge to incrementally learn tasks from a data stream without catastrophic forgetting. While leveraging pretrained models has significantly advanced continual learning, existing methods exhibit a scalability bottleneck when trained sequentially on many tasks, suffering from performance degradation due to inter-task interference and loss of plasticity. Inspired by evidence that sparse fine-tuning achieves performance comparable to full fine-tuning, this paper presents a novel sparsity-driven continual learning framework. Our continual learning method, termed CLARE, operates in two stages: it first identifies a sparse, task-critical parameter mask via a sparsity-inducing objective, then performs mask-constrained fine-tuning by only optimizing parameters selected by the mask. This two-stage sparse adapter mechanism enables all tasks to be accumulated within a shared adapter space while reducing destructive interference across tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the scalability of CLARE. On the long task-sequence benchmark Omnibenchmark-1k, CLARE outperforms strong baselines in final accuracy by a large margin, e.g, improving EASE by 4.64% and 13.34% after learning 100 tasks, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CLARE，一种基于稀疏驱动的持续学习框架，通过两阶段稀疏适配器机制缓解多任务序列训练中的任务间干扰与可塑性丧失，在 Omnibenchmark-1k 上显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 持续学习需在增量学习新任务的同时保留旧知识，避免灾难性遗忘。虽预训练模型推动了该领域发展，但现有方法在长任务序列上顺序训练时存在可扩展性瓶颈，因任务间干扰与可塑性丧失导致性能退化。受稀疏微调可媲美全量微调的启发，作者希望借助稀疏性缓解上述问题。
AI.method: 提出 CLARE 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过稀疏诱导目标识别任务关键的稀疏参数掩码；第二阶段执行掩码约束微调，仅优化被掩码选中的参数。该两阶段稀疏适配器机制使所有任务可累积于共享适配器空间，同时减少跨任务的破坏性干扰。
AI.result: 在长任务序列基准 Omnibenchmark-1k 上，CLARE 在最终准确率上大幅超越强基线。例如在学习 100 个任务后，分别比 EASE 提升 4.64% 和 13.34%。
AI.conclusion: CLARE 通过稀疏掩码与掩码约束微调的两阶段机制，有效提升了持续学习在长任务序列上的可扩展性，缓解了任务间干扰与可塑性丧失，实验验证了其优越性。

title: Bi-FlowGS: Bridging Generative View Completion and Gaussian Geometry through Bidirectional Flow Co-Refinement
summary: Sparse-view 3D scene reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is inherently underconstrained. Plausible renderings can also coexist with erroneous Gaussian geometry, as errors in positions or depths may be concealed by opacity, scale, and appearance; we term this failure mode Geometry Cheating. Existing regularization methods constrain geometry but remain limited to observed views, while video-diffusion-based methods complete unseen views yet mainly use them as RGB pseudo-supervision, underusing motion and temporal priors and lacking explicit geometry supervision. We present Bi-FlowGS, which uses optical flow to bridge generative view completion and Gaussian geometry regularization. Our plug-and-play Video-to-Geometry Flow Distillation (V2G) distills temporal correspondence priors from restored videos into Gaussian geometry to alleviate Geometry Cheating. Conversely, Geometry-to-Video Flow-Guided Restoration (G2V) uses the current 3DGS geometry to guide temporally consistent video restoration, providing more reliable generative supervision. Together, V2G and G2V form an implicit bidirectional co-refinement process, enabling restored videos and the optimized 3DGS scene to iteratively improve each other. Experiments demonstrate improved rendering quality and geometric consistency across wide-baseline and unbounded 360° benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Bi-FlowGS，利用光流作为桥梁，将视频扩散补全的时序对应先验蒸馏到 3DGS 几何中，并通过几何引导视频修复形成双向协同精化，缓解稀疏视角重建中的“几何欺骗”问题。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下 3DGS 重建本质欠约束，错误的高斯几何可被不透明度、尺度与外观掩盖而产生看似合理的渲染，作者称之为 Geometry Cheating。现有正则化局限于观测视角，视频扩散方法虽能补全未见视角，却仅将其作为 RGB 伪监督，未充分利用运动与时序先验，也缺乏显式几何监督。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的 Video-to-Geometry Flow Distillation（V2G），从修复视频中蒸馏时序对应先验到高斯几何；反向的 Geometry-to-Video Flow-Guided Restoration（G2V）利用当前 3DGS 几何引导时序一致的视频修复，提供更可靠的生成监督。二者构成隐式双向协同精化循环。
AI.result: 在宽基线与无界 360° 基准上，渲染质量与几何一致性均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 以光流为中介连接生成式视角补全与高斯几何正则化，使修复视频与优化中的 3DGS 场景迭代互惠，有效缓解几何欺骗，改善稀疏视角 3DGS 重建质量。

title: Diagnosing the Fact-Grounding Gap in Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires combining information from multiple documents to answer complex questions. These systems have grown increasingly capable, yet when they fail, the error is typically attributed to not finding the right documents. Whether this holds at the level of individual reasoning steps remains largely unexamined. We investigate this across three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks and find that failures decompose into two distinct modes: retrieval failures, where the needed passage was not retrieved, and extraction failures, where the passage was retrieved but the needed fact could not be extracted - a phenomenon we term the fact-grounding gap. Extraction failures account for nearly half of all per-hop deficiencies and are invisible to standard retrieval metrics. They remain unresolved by every retrieval intervention we test, establishing a ceiling for retrieval-only improvements. The gap's severity varies across benchmarks and question types, but extraction failures appear on every dataset we measure. Our findings reveal that retrieval failures and extraction failures are fundamentally different bottlenecks requiring different solutions - a distinction absent from current evaluation practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统考察多跳问答中单步推理失败的构成，发现失败可分为检索失败与抽取失败两类，并指出抽取失败（事实锚定缺口）被现有指标忽视。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答需跨多文档整合信息，系统能力虽提升，但失败常被笼统归因于"未检索到正确文档"。单步推理层面的失败结构缺乏考察，需澄清失败究竟发生在检索环节还是抽取环节。
AI.method: 在三个标准多跳问答基准上，对每一跳逐步骤分解失败模式，区分"所需段落未被检索"（检索失败）与"段落已检索但所需事实无法抽取"（抽取失败，即事实锚定缺口），并测试多种检索干预措施的效果。
AI.result: 抽取失败约占全部单跳缺陷的近一半，且对标准检索指标不可见；所有测试的检索干预手段均无法消除该缺口，构成仅靠检索改进的性能上限。缺口严重程度因基准与问题类型而异，但在每个数据集上均存在。
AI.conclusion: 检索失败与抽取失败是性质不同的瓶颈，需不同解决方案。当前评估实践未作此区分，应分别度量检索与事实抽取能力。

title: Audio-Visual Turn-taking Prediction in Cocktail Party Scenarios
comment: Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026. This version includes an appendix about manual verified labels for AVCocktail
summary: Current predictive turn-taking models (PTTMs) achieve strong performance on benchmarks with controlled acoustic conditions and clean audio signals. Their generalisation to conversations with overlapping speech and background interference remains underexplored. In this research, we evaluate audio-visual PTTMs trained with clean data on a challenging cocktail-party testbed derived from the AVCocktail dataset, and analyse their adaptation behaviour to this new domain. Experimental results show consistent performance degradation across audio and visual modalities under noisy conditions, with up to 38% relative drop in weighted F1. Fine-tuning on the new domain improves robustness, but gains vary across modalities and depend on the size of the available pre-training data. These findings provide insights into the different generalisation and adaptation capabilities of the audio and visual modalities, and indicate the need for robust modelling strategies to adapt to the complexities of human interactions in noise. All code and turn labels are made publicly available to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了在干净数据上训练的视听预测性轮换模型（PTTMs）在鸡尾酒会场景（重叠语音与背景干扰）下的泛化与适应行为。结果显示音视频模态性能一致下降，加权F1最多相对降低38%；新域微调可提升鲁棒性，但收益因模态和预训练数据规模而异。
AI.motivation: 现有PTTMs在受控声学条件和干净音频基准上表现优异，但其在重叠语音与背景干扰对话中的泛化能力仍缺乏研究。作者希望探究视听PTTMs在真实嘈杂交互场景下的鲁棒性与适应机制。
AI.method: 作者基于AVCocktail数据集构建了具有挑战性的鸡尾酒会测试平台，用以评估以干净数据训练的视听PTTMs，并分析其向新域的适应行为；同时在目标域进行微调实验，考察不同模态与预训练数据规模对适应效果的影响。
AI.result: 在噪声条件下，音频与视觉模态均出现一致的性能下降，加权F1相对降幅最高达38%。在新域微调可改善鲁棒性，但增益因模态而异，并取决于可用预训练数据规模。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了音频与视觉模态在泛化与适应能力上的差异，表明需要鲁棒的建模策略以应对噪声环境下人类交互的复杂性；作者公开全部代码与轮换标签以促进后续研究。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Hierarchical Intention Anticipation in Human Behavior
