Loss function choice also influenced the uncertainty profile, with some models showing clearer class separation and more localized uncertainty in ambiguous regions than others. These findings suggest that uncertainty mapping for Fazekas score predictions can support model interpretation and targeted dataset review when reference labels are affected by ambiguity/ inter-rater variability.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性映射框架，将模型不确定性映射到学习到的特征表示中，用于分析Fazekas评分预测模型的性能，超越传统指标。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类模型训练所用的参考标签并非总是如表面所示那样确定，这种不确定性会影响性能指标的解读。Fazekas评分存在评分者间变异，仅靠MCC等标量指标难以理解模型能力。
AI.method: 不将预测的认知不确定性视为孤立标量值，而是提出不确定性映射方法，将不确定性与其在学习到的特征表示中的位置相关联，从而揭示类别边界过渡区域和潜在的标签分歧。
AI.result: 最佳Fazekas评分预测模型MCC达0.70，但性能随数据划分和损失函数变化。不确定性映射突出了类别边界过渡的模糊区域和更易误分类的样本，识别出潜在标签分歧（包括低不确定性误分类案例，经专家复核与原参考Fazekas评分不一致）。损失函数选择影响不确定性分布，部分模型类别分离更清晰、模糊区域不确定性更局部化。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性映射可支持模型解释和有针对性的数据集审查，尤其在参考标签受歧义/评分者间变异影响时。

title: Evolution of US Oral Political Language
summary: The analysis of US political language is usually based on the written form (e.g. presidential addresses) or posts broadcasted on various social networks. Oral production, however, which is even more frequent, can better reveal the style and mode of thinking of the speaker. This study covers this mode of linguistic communication by considering 19 candidates from the presidential elections between 1960 to 2024. Our main research objectives are to disclose the main trends hidden in those presidential debates. Do we observe a clear simplification of the US political language over time? Does Trump have poor language compared to the other candidates? Do unusual stylistic features occur only with a single, specific president? Moreover, can we detect a pattern explaining the success or failure of some nominees? Over time, this study demonstrates a significant reduction in political language complexity, a decrease of the mean sentence length, and a noteworthy decline of complex terms. Moreover, the emotional tone increases over the decades, while logical and rational thinking tends to lessen.

AI.tldr: 该研究以1960—2024年间19位美国总统候选人辩论的口语语料为对象，揭示美国政治语言随时间的简化趋势、情绪化增强以及逻辑理性表达减弱。
AI.motivation: 现有美国政治语言研究多基于书面文本（如总统演讲）或社交媒体帖子，而更常见的口语表达更能反映说话者的风格与思维方式，因此有必要系统考察总统辩论这一口语交流模式中的语言演变。
AI.method: 选取1960年至2024年总统选举中的19位候选人，对其总统辩论的口语语料进行分析，围绕语言复杂度、平均句长、复杂词汇使用、情感语调以及逻辑与理性表达等维度进行跨时间比较。
AI.result: 研究发现美国政治语言复杂度显著下降，平均句长减少，复杂词汇明显减少；同时情感语调随数十年上升，而逻辑与理性思维呈减弱趋势。
AI.conclusion: 美国政治语言呈现持续简化与情绪化倾向，理性逻辑表达相对弱化，这一模式或有助于解释部分候选人的成败。

title: Is Luke the Author of a Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles?
summary: According to Christian tradition, Luke is credited with authoring a Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles, even if his name does not appear in either book, both originally written in Koine Greek. Several biblical scholars assume that both texts were written by a common author, while others deduce the presence of two authors. Different studies have been found to support either finding, some based on qualitative evaluation, while a few others consider the occurrence frequency differences between the two books. To propose an enhanced quantitative analysis, this study is grounded on two recent authorship attribution models. The Burrows' Delta, applied with eleven different feature sizes, demonstrates common authorship. An author verification model confirms this finding. The following experiments consider several stylistic representations, feature sizes, and distance functions to confirm that Luke is the true author of both books.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用作者归属与作者验证模型，通过对《路加福音》和《使徒行传》的文体特征进行量化分析，支持两书为同一作者（路加）所著。
AI.motivation: 关于《路加福音》与《使徒行传》是否为同一作者所著，学界存在分歧：部分学者认为两书出自同一作者，另一些则推断存在两位作者。既有研究多基于定性评估，仅少数考虑两书之间的词频差异。本文旨在提出一种增强的定量分析方法以厘清这一问题。
AI.method: 研究以两种近期的作者归属模型为基础：其一为Burrows' Delta，采用十一种不同的特征规模进行应用；其二为作者验证模型。后续实验进一步考察了多种文体表征、特征规模与距离函数，以验证结论的稳健性。
AI.result: Burrows' Delta在十一种特征规模下均显示两书具有共同作者；作者验证模型亦确认了这一发现。通过多种文体表征、特征规模与距离函数的实验，进一步证实路加是两书的真实作者。
AI.conclusion: 量化分析结果支持《路加福音》与《使徒行传》为同一作者所著，即传统上归于路加，为这一长期争议提供了增强的定量证据。

title: How Calibration Content Shapes Attention-Based Reranking
summary: Attention-based rerankers score documents by aggregating query-to-document attention and subtracting a null-query calibration pass to remove positional and structural bias. Although widely used, this calibration assumes that the null pass removes irrelevant signal from each document. We show that modern prompt content, e.g. constraints, instructions, personas, and demonstrations can violate this assumption when it enters the scoring readout, making the null pass relevance-aware rather than null. We find that calibration is especially harmful when applied to prompts containing longer, more detailed instructions as the null-pass step removes relevant signal. Based on these findings, we propose interpolated null calibration, a training-free modification that controls how much of the instruction content enters the null baseline. It recovers attention-based reranking performance on instruction-heavy tasks where standard calibration fails, while preserving calibration's benefits when the null pass remains relevance-agnostic. On instruction heavy tasks, the recovered rankings surpass generative rerankers. We also show that in-context demonstrations improve attention-based reranking with little calibration interference, since demonstrations act only through the query pass and leave the null pass unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文指出注意力重排器常用的"空查询校准"在提示词包含约束、指令、人格、示例等内容时会失效，并提出无需训练的"插值空校准"方法加以修复。
AI.motivation: 注意力重排器通过聚合查询到文档的注意力并减去一次空查询校准来消除位置与结构偏差。该做法的隐含假设是空查询能去除每个文档中的无关信号。作者发现，当约束、指令、人格、示例等现代提示内容进入打分读出时，这一假设被破坏，空查询变得"与相关性相关"而非"空"，从而在指令密集任务中尤其有害地移除了相关信号。
AI.method: 作者首先分析并验证空查询校准假设在提示内容进入评分读出时被违反（实验分析）。基于此提出"插值空校准"（interpolated null calibration）：一种无需训练的改动，用于控制指令内容进入空基线的比例/程度。并进一步分析上下文示例的影响路径（仅通过查询通道起作用，不改变空通道）。
AI.result: 在指令密集任务上，标准校准失效，而插值空校准能够恢复注意力重排的性能，且在空过程保持与相关性无关时仍保留校准的收益；在指令密集任务上，恢复后的排序甚至超过生成式重排器。在上下文示例方面，示例能提升注意力重排且几乎不产生校准干扰，因为示例只通过查询通道起作用，保持空通道不变。
AI.conclusion: 空查询校准并非普遍有效，其前提（空过程与相关性无关）在指令密集提示下会被破坏。插值空校准作为一种免训练方案，可在必要时抑制指令对空基线的影响，从而在保持校准收益的同时恢复并超越现有重排性能；同时揭示了示例与指令对重排器作用通道的差异。

title: One-Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows are Noise2Noise Denoisers, and Multi-Step Integration Provably Hurts---A Benchmark and Task-Based Detectability Study on Low-Dose CT
summary: Iterative and generative denoisers are increasingly used under the assumption that multi-step refinement outperforms a single regression pass. We show the opposite for \emph{label-free} denoising. An \emph{unconditional} rectified flow trained on two noisy observations of the same signal, as in Noise2Noise, has a minimiser whose one-step readout is exactly the MMSE denoiser without requiring clean targets. In contrast, multi-step integration provably departs from the MMSE solution because the flow terminates at the noisy data distribution rather than the clean-signal distribution. This departure is exact in a tractable Gaussian model and is confirmed experimentally: one-step flow matches a direct regressor, whereas multi-step Euler integration progressively reduces fidelity. Counterintuitively, the degradation increases with training quality, as a better velocity field more faithfully transports samples toward the noisy terminal law. The key ingredient is therefore the decorrelated \emph{pairing}, not the flow machinery: a one-step regressor trained on matched noisy pairs gives our best label-free result ($+1.99$,dB). We evaluate these findings on \textbf{CTDenoiser}, a controlled low-dose CT benchmark spanning five architectures and supervised, similarity-based, blind-spot, and per-image methods. Among label-free approaches, only correlated-noise-aware Noise2Sim improves over the noisy baseline, while Noise2Void is flat-to-negative because CT noise violates its pixel-independence assumption. Finally, although supervised denoisers gain approximately $4$,dB PSNR, a channelized Hotelling observer shows reduced low-contrast lesion detectability, revealing clinically relevant degradation missed by PSNR and SSIM.

AI.tldr: 在无标签（label-free）去噪任务中，多步迭代/生成式精化并不优于单步回归；基于配对噪声观测训练的单步回归器（rectified flow 的一步读出或直接回归）即可逼近 MMSE 去噪器，而多步积分反而因流终止于含噪分布而降低保真度。
AI.motivation: 当前迭代式与生成式去噪器被广泛采用，其隐含假设是"多步精化优于单步回归"。作者针对无标签去噪场景质疑并检验这一假设，同时指出多数工作忽略了从含噪数据分布与干净信号分布之间的差异所带来的理论后果，并试图澄清究竟哪个组件（流机制还是噪声配对）才是无标签去噪成功的关键。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：对基于同一信号的两个含噪观测（如 Noise2Noise 式配对）训练的无条件 rectified flow，证明其一步读出的极小值恰为无需干净目标的 MMSE 去噪器；而多步积分因流终止于含噪数据分布而非干净信号分布，可证明偏离 MMSE 解。2) 可解的高斯模型给出精确刻画，并配合实验验证。3) 方法对比：单步流读出、直接回归器、多步 Euler 积分，以及不同配对（去相关配对 vs. 其他）。4) 提出并构建 CTDenoiser 基准——受控低剂量 CT，涵盖五种架构与监督、基于相似性、blind-spot、逐图像等方法。5) 引入通道化 Hotelling 观察者（CHO）评估低对比度病灶可检测性，与 PSNR/SSIM 对照。
AI.result: 一步流读出与直接回归器表现一致，而多步 Euler 积分逐步降低保真度；且退化随训练质量提高而加剧，因为更优的速度场更忠实地将样本输运至含噪终态分布。关键因素是去相关配对而非流机制：在匹配噪声对上训练的一步回归器取得最佳无标签结果（+1.99 dB）。在 CTDenoiser 上，无标签方法中仅相关噪声感知的 Noise2Sim 优于含噪基线，Noise2Void 因 CT 噪声违反像素独立假设而持平至负向。监督去噪器 PSNR 约提升 4 dB，但 CHO 显示低对比度病灶可检测性下降，暴露了 PSNR 与 SSIM 未能反映的临床相关退化。
AI.conclusion: 在无标签去噪中，单步回归优于多步迭代/生成式精化；这一优势源于去相关噪声配对而非流式机制本身，理论（MMSE 等价性与多步偏离）与实验一致。CTDenoiser 表明无标签方法整体收益有限，而监督方法虽提升 PSNR 却可能损害低对比度病灶可检测性，提示应以任务相关指标（如 CHO）评估并谨慎采用多步精化范式。

title: QiT: Quantum-Inspired Transformer for Visual Recognition Task
summary: Quantum machine learning offers a compelling representational perspective: angle-encoded states inhabit Hilbert spaces in which periodic similarities and interactions can be expressed naturally. Realizing this perspective for visual recognition remains difficult, however, because present quantum neural networks are constrained by limited qubit counts, costly circuit simulation and measurement, noise, and unstable optimization on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. We investigate whether useful structural ideas from quantum models can instead be realized as scalable classical Transformer operations. We introduce QiT, a Quantum-inspired Transformer for vision tasks with three components: (i) angle-inspired encoding that maps image tokens to learned trigonometric Hilbert-space features analogous to quantum rotation-based state encoding; (ii) self-attention over these periodic features, inducing a classical cosine kernel approximated to quantum fidelity kernels; and (iii) gated multiplicative emulation, a trainable classical surrogate for interaction terms found in variational circuits. All components are differentiable tensor operations, so QiT claims neither quantum computation nor quantum speedup and retains the $\mathcal{O}(N^2D)$ attention complexity of a standard Vision Transformer. Across image-classification benchmarks, QiT is competitive with a matched classical Transformer while avoiding the severe runtime cost observed for a small simulated quantum Transformer. QiT-B reaches 78.3\% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with 45.7M parameters and 11.5 GFLOPs. These results position QiT as a scalable baseline for isolating and evaluating quantum-motivated inductive biases in visual recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QiT（Quantum-inspired Transformer），一种将量子模型的结构性思想（角度编码、周期性特征注意力、门控乘性交互）实现为经典 Transformer 操作的视觉模型，在避免量子计算开销的同时保留 O(N²D) 注意力复杂度，ImageNet-1K 上达到 78.3% top-1 精度。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习在表示层面具有吸引力：角度编码态所处希尔伯特空间可自然表达周期性相似度与交互。然而现有量子神经网络受限于比特数、高昂的线路模拟与测量成本、噪声以及 NISQ 设备上的优化不稳定，难以用于视觉识别。因此作者希望探究：能否将量子模型中有用的结构思想转化为可扩展的经典 Transformer 操作。
AI.method: QiT 包含三个组件：(i) 角度启发的编码，将图像 token 映射为学习到的三角函数希尔伯特空间特征，类似量子旋转态编码；(ii) 在这些周期性特征上做自注意力，诱导出逼近量子保真度核的经典余弦核；(iii) 门控乘性模拟，作为变分线路中交互项的可训练经典替代。全部为可微张量操作，不主张量子计算或量子加速，注意力复杂度保持标准 ViT 的 O(N²D)。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准上，QiT 与规模匹配的经典 Transformer 表现相当，同时避免了小型模拟量子 Transformer 出现的严重运行时间开销。QiT-B 以 45.7M 参数、11.5 GFLOPs 达到 78.3% 的 ImageNet-1K top-1 精度。
AI.conclusion: QiT 可作为隔离与评估视觉识别中量子启发式归纳偏置的可扩展基线。

title: Not All Patches Are Equally Forgettable: Spatially Localized Domain Unlearning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong cross-domain recognition performance even without additional training. However, this robustness can also preserve undesirable domain-specific behavior, as domain-related and semantic information often remain entangled within the learned representation space, making selective domain unlearning challenging. Existing approaches typically address this problem through latent-space disentanglement and prompt- or feature-level interventions, without directly attributing and attenuating individual patch-token contributions. However, here we suggest that rather than uniformly suppressing the full representation, it may be more effective to exploit the spatial structure of vision transformers to localize and suppress patch regions that contribute disproportionately to forget-domain prediction. Patches that strongly influence forget-domain prediction may not be equally important for semantic recognition, suggesting that forgetting should be guided according to the domain contribution of different visual regions. Specifically, we propose a two-stage patch-selective framework that first estimates patch-level domain sensitivity and then selectively attenuates patches whose contribution to forget-domain prediction is stronger than their semantic utility. We evaluate our framework on Office-Home, Mini DomainNet, and DomainNet. Experimental results demonstrate improved forgetting-retention tradeoffs compared to prior methods while improving retained-domain recognition by up to 3.8\%. Additional evaluations under visually overlapping and unseen-domain settings further demonstrate improved robustness under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段patch选择性框架，利用ViT空间结构定位并抑制对遗忘域预测贡献过大的patch区域，在域遗忘任务中取得更优的遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型即便无需额外训练也具备强跨域识别能力，但域相关与语义信息在学习到的表示空间中纠缠，导致对特定域的选择性遗忘困难。现有方法多通过潜空间解耦及prompt或特征层面的干预处理该问题，未能直接归因并衰减单个patch token的贡献。作者认为，与其均匀抑制整个表示，不如利用ViT的空间结构，定位并抑制对遗忘域预测贡献过大的patch区域。
AI.method: 提出两阶段patch选择性框架：第一阶段估计patch级域敏感度；第二阶段选择性衰减那些对遗忘域预测贡献强于其语义效用（semantic utility）的patch。核心思路是依据不同视觉区域的域贡献来引导遗忘，而非均匀抑制完整表示。
AI.result: 在Office-Home、Mini DomainNet与DomainNet上评估。相比先前方法改善了遗忘-保留权衡，保留域识别率最高提升3.8%。在视觉重叠与未见域设置下的额外评估进一步表明其在分布偏移下具有更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用ViT的空间结构进行patch级域归因与选择性抑制，可有效实现选择性域遗忘，并在遗忘-保留权衡和分布偏移鲁棒性上优于现有潜空间解耦与特征干预方法。

title: Unsupervised spiking feature learning for event-based pedestrian crossing detection: approaching supervised accuracy without labelled training data
summary: Event cameras are well suited to pedestrian crossing detection, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process their output natively, but current SNN detectors are trained with supervised backpropagation and therefore require costly frame-level crossing labels. We investigate crossing detection with no labels in feature learning and report the first unsupervised results on the recent DVS-PedX pedestrian-crossing benchmark. A single spiking layer trained with winner-take-all spike-timing-dependent plasticity learns a dictionary from unlabelled event-frame patches; frames are encoded by cosine similarity to the learned filters with spatial pooling and read out by a linear classifier, the only supervised component. On the 24,454-frame test split the method attains 90.3% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.936, compared with 92.0% and 0.943 for a supervised spiking network trained end-to-end on the same frames; under adverse weather the AUROC is 0.913. The result is insensitive to the choice of plasticity rule but depends strongly on the readout protocol: with the classical neuron-assignment readout the same network attains only 0.70 AUROC. On the benchmark's real converted portion, a readout refit lifts performance from chance (0.53) to 0.67 AUROC, within the published supervised range. These findings indicate that the accuracy cost of removing labels from feature learning is small on this benchmark, and that reported weaknesses of unsupervised spiking networks may be attributable to the readout protocol rather than to the learning rule.

AI.tldr: 首个在DVS-PedX行人过街基准上的无监督脉冲神经网络检测方法：单层WTA-STDP学习滤波器字典，仅用线性分类器做读出，测试集达90.3%准确率与0.936 AUROC，接近有监督端到端训练的92.0%/0.943。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合行人过街检测，SNN可原生处理其输出，但现有SNN检测器依赖监督反向传播，需要昂贵的帧级过街标注。作者希望验证特征学习阶段去除标签的代价有多大。
AI.method: 用WTA-STDP（赢者通吃-脉冲时序依赖可塑性）训练单层脉冲层，从无标签事件帧patch学习滤波器字典；帧通过余弦相似度编码并做空间池化，读出仅用一个线性分类器（唯一的监督组件）。
AI.result: 24,454帧测试集上达90.3%准确率、0.936 AUROC；同帧有监督端到端SNN为92.0%、0.943；恶劣天气下AUROC为0.913。结果对可塑性规则选择不敏感，但强烈依赖读出协议：经典neuron-assignment读出仅0.70 AUROC。在真实转换子集上，读出重拟合将性能从随机水平0.53提升至0.67 AUROC，落入已发表的有监督区间。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准上，特征学习去标签带来的精度损失很小；无监督SNN被报道的弱点可能源于读出协议而非学习规则本身。

title: AgenTeeth: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Suppressing Hallucination in Frozen Vision-Language Models on Dental X-Rays via Tool Evidence Injection
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) remain largely unreliable on panoramic dental radiographs and can rely on learned anatomical priors rather than evidence in the image. This is particularly problematic for tooth localization and spatial reasoning, and fine-tuned dental VLMs can retain the same spatial biases. We present AgenTeeth, a model-agnostic, tool-augmented framework that grounds frozen VLMs using seven specialized dental vision experts. A question-aware orchestrator selects the relevant tools, whose detections are mapped to FDI tooth numbers or anatomical regions and returned as structured findings together with annotated image overlays. A fresh synthesis call then answers the question using this evidence, without fine-tuning the underlying VLM. On MMOral-OPG-Bench, AgenTeeth improves four backbone VLMs by 12.9-23.0 percentage points over their baselines. Our strongest configuration reaches 65.66% on open-ended VQA, compared with 45.35% for OralGPT-Plus. The advantage also holds at matched scale: a frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with AgenTeeth reaches 48.11%, exceeding OralGPT-Plus built on the same backbone after supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for tool use. We release the framework, all seven expert models, and a dentist-annotated dataset for alveolar bone-loss detection in panoramic radiographs.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgenTeeth：一个模型无关、工具增强的框架，利用七个牙科视觉专家模型为冻结的 VLM 提供证据，从而提升全景牙科影像上的定位与空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在全景牙科放射影像上可靠性不足，往往依赖学到的解剖先验而非图像证据，在牙齿定位与空间推理上问题突出；且微调后的牙科 VLM 仍可能保留相同的空间偏见。
AI.method: AgenTeeth 采用工具增强的接地（grounding）策略，无需微调底层 VLM：由问题感知的编排器（orchestrator）选择相关专家工具；七个牙科视觉专家的检测结果被映射为 FDI 牙位编号或解剖区域，以结构化发现（structured findings）形式连同标注图像叠加层返回；随后通过一次新的合成调用（synthesis call）基于这些证据回答问题。
AI.result: 在 MMOral-OPG-Bench 上，AgenTeeth 使四个骨干 VLM 相比基线提升 12.9–23.0 个百分点；最强配置在开放式 VQA 上达 65.66%，高于 OralGPT-Plus 的 45.35%；在同等规模下，冻结的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 配合 AgenTeeth 达 48.11%，超过基于同一骨干经监督微调与强化学习工具使用的 OralGPT-Plus。此外发布了框架、全部七个专家模型以及一个由牙医标注的全景片牙槽骨丧失检测数据集。
AI.conclusion: 通过模型无关的工具增强与证据接地，可在不微调 VLM 的前提下显著提升全景牙科影像的问答与空间推理性能，并超越同规模经微调与强化学习的专用模型，同时公开框架、专家模型与标注数据集以促进研究。

title: Wind on Trees: Testing Physical Grounding in Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Monocular reconstruction of wind-driven vegetation is severely underconstrained: motion along the viewing direction is largely unobservable, a moving canopy offers few reliable correspondences, and nearly the entire scene is dynamic, providing little static reference. Directly-learned deformation fields in 4D Gaussian Splatting therefore optimize photometric consistency rather than recover the motion that produced it. We replace that field with a physically parameterized deformation prior: one damped harmonic oscillator per rigid part, driven by the observed wind and integrated by differentiable RK4, supervised photometrically alone. To test whether such a prior is physically grounded rather than merely well fit, we build a controlled synthetic testbed of three procedurally generated trees spanning an order of magnitude in skeleton complexity, whose per-part natural frequency follows from its own geometry and whose damping ratio is a fixed constant, both held out of training. On it, we measure held-out views, temporal extrapolation, zero-shot transfer to unseen wind speeds, and recovery of the physical parameters themselves. The prior costs appearance fidelity on in-distribution views and extrapolates markedly better outside the training window and the training wind, while parameter recovery is far weaker than it first appears: frequency recovery survives an untrained null control on only the sparsest of the three trees, and damping is not recovered at all.

AI.tldr: 用"每个刚性部件一个阻尼谐振子+可微RK4"的物理参数化形变先验替代4DGS中直接学习的形变场，在程序化生成的树合成测试台上验证其物理基础，发现外推与零样本风速迁移更好，但物理参数恢复能力远弱于表面表现。
AI.motivation: 单目风驱植被重建严重欠约束：沿视线方向的运动基本不可观测，运动的树冠缺乏可靠对应点，且几乎整个场景都是动态的、缺少静态参照。因此4D Gaussian Splatting中直接学习的形变场只是在优化光度一致性，而非恢复产生该运动的真实动力学。作者希望用物理先验替代该场，并检验这种先验是否真的物理成立，而不只是拟合得好。
AI.method: 将直接学习的形变场替换为物理参数化形变先验：每个刚性部件建模为一个阻尼谐振子，由观测到的风驱动，用可微RK4积分，仅以光度监督训练。构建受控合成测试台：三棵程序化生成的树，骨架复杂度跨越一个数量级，各部件的自然频率由其自身几何决定，阻尼比为固定常数，两者均不参与训练。评估指标包括留出视角、时间外推、对未见风速的零样本迁移，以及物理参数本身的恢复。
AI.result: 该先验在分布内视角上损失了外观保真度，但在训练时间窗之外和训练风速之外的外推明显更好。物理参数恢复远弱于表面观感：频率恢复仅在三棵树中骨架最稀疏的一棵上通过未训练空对照，阻尼则完全无法恢复。
AI.conclusion: 物理参数化先验能改善风驱植被的动态外推与零样本风速迁移，说明其具备一定归纳偏置优势；但参数恢复的严格检验表明，这种"物理可解释性"在很大程度上是表观的，阻尼不可辨识、频率恢复也高度依赖骨架复杂度。因此在欠约束单目设定下，不能仅凭外推性能或拟合质量断言恢复了真实物理动力学。

title: GazeDiT: Gaze-Accurate Diffusion Image Generation for Eye Tracking via Spatial Conditioning
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used to generate synthetic training data, but precise label control remains difficult when the conditioning signal is low-dimensional and coarse. Text-conditioned images are judged by broad prompt consistency, whereas supervised training requires precise correspondence between each image and its numerical label. This is challenging in eye tracking, where a 4D binocular gaze is expressed through subtle, spatially localized pupil and iris geometry. We introduce GazeDiT, a diffusion model that generates images for a requested 4D gaze through an internally constructed spatial condition that grounds the global gaze label in this local geometry. During training, a frozen SegFormer extracts pupil/iris geometry from diverse real images, allowing the model to learn realistic appearance conditioned on that geometry. At inference, a physical eye renderer samples gaze-consistent geometries by varying anatomy and camera state, enabling diverse synthesis without a source image. GazeDiT achieves substantially lower tail gaze-label error than other diffusion baselines, approaching the error of the same frozen gaze estimator on real images. Its generated data also improves the downstream eye tracker, reducing gaze error on difficult cases from 3.05° to 2.80° in the smallest cohort.

AI.tldr: GazeDiT 是一种扩散模型，通过内部构建的空间条件（瞳孔/虹膜几何）将全局 4D 注视标签落地到局部几何中，实现精确标签控制，用于生成眼动追踪训练数据。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型常用于生成合成训练数据，但当条件信号低维且粗糙时，精确的标签控制十分困难。文本条件图像只需粗略的提示一致性，而监督训练要求每张图像与其数值标签精确对应。在眼动追踪中，4D 双眼注视通过微妙、空间局部化的瞳孔和虹膜几何表达，这一挑战尤为突出。
AI.method: GazeDiT 通过内部构建的空间条件生成图像，将全局注视标签落地到局部瞳孔/虹膜几何。训练时，冻结的 SegFormer 从多样真实图像中提取瞳孔/虹膜几何，使模型学习以该几何为条件的真实外观。推理时，物理眼睛渲染器通过变化解剖结构和相机状态采样与注视一致的几何，无需源图像即可实现多样合成。
AI.result: GazeDiT 的尾部注视标签误差显著低于其他扩散基线，接近同一冻结注视估计器在真实图像上的误差。其生成数据还改善了下游眼动追踪器，在最小队列中将困难案例的注视误差从 3.05° 降至 2.80°。
AI.conclusion: 通过将低维全局标签落地为局部几何的空间条件，GazeDiT 实现了精确的注视标签控制，生成数据可有效提升下游眼动追踪性能。

title: CALIPER: Metric-Grounded Model-Free Recognition of Visually Similar Industrial Parts
summary: Fine-grained recognition of visually similar industrial parts is challenging when classes differ primarily in physical dimensions. Normalizing detected object crops to a fixed input size suppresses absolute scale, while CAD models and large class-specific datasets may be unavailable in evolving industrial inventories. We present CALIPER, a model-free RGB-D framework that couples support-based appearance matching with metric size evidence. Each training class is onboarded from a single turntable RGB-D video and one to two labeled real images; 3D reconstruction provides novel-view appearance support, while aligned depth yields a class-specific metric size profile. At inference, a coarse YOLOv8n-seg model localizes parts, and a frozen DINOv2 backbone with an episodically trained embedding head performs fine-grained support matching. Margin-conditioned metric fusion activates probabilistic size evidence only for appearance-ambiguous decisions. New classes are enrolled from a small RGB-D support set without updating network parameters. We evaluate CALIPER on 18 visually similar industrial parts: 16 classes are used for training, while two screws are reserved for training-free enrollment. CALIPER achieves 88.2% closed-set accuracy with 99.8% localization recall and 85.7% overall accuracy after 10-shot enrollment of the two unseen screws. Metric fusion improves unseen-class accuracy by up to 37.4 percentage points without statistically significant degradation of the original inventory. Robot-arm deployment identifies 17/18 parts without deployment-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: CALIPER是一个免训练的RGB-D细粒度识别框架，结合支撑集外观匹配与度量尺寸证据，在18类相似工业零件上实现88.2%闭集准确率，并可在不更新网络参数的情况下完成新类注册。
AI.motivation: 工业零件视觉高度相似，类别差异主要体现实物尺寸上；将检测框归一化到固定尺寸会抑制绝对尺度信息，而CAD模型与大规模类专属数据集在动态演进的工业库存中往往不可得。
AI.method: 每类仅用一段转台RGB-D视频和1–2张有标注的真实图像完成注册：3D重建提供新视角外观支撑，对齐深度给出类别特定的度量尺寸轮廓。推理时用YOLOv8n-seg做粗定位，冻结的DINOv2骨干加情节式训练的嵌入头做细粒度支撑匹配；边缘条件度量融合仅在出现外观歧义时激活概率化尺寸证据。新类通过小型RGB-D支撑集注册，无需更新网络参数。
AI.result: 在18类相似工业零件上评估（16类训练，2类螺钉留作免训练注册）：闭集准确率88.2%，定位召回率99.8%；对两个未见螺钉进行10-shot注册后整体准确率85.7%。度量融合将未见类准确率最多提升37.4个百分点，且对原库存性能无统计显著下降。机械臂部署无需针对部署再训练即可识别18类中的17类。
AI.conclusion: CALIPER表明，将免训练支撑匹配与由RGB-D导出的度量尺寸证据相结合，可在不依赖CAD模型或大规模类专属数据的前提下，有效解决以尺寸差异为主的工业零件细粒度识别与新类快速注册问题，并具备实际机器人部署可行性。

title: RoboVAD: A Large Cross-Domain Evaluation Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Robotic Arm Manipulation Videos
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is an actively studied task, having wide applications in typical scenarios such as public surveillance and road traffic safety. The task is also relevant for robotic arm interactions, where it has several downstream applications, including learning better interaction and manipulation abilities, triggering recovery procedures when anomalies occur, etc. Despite its relevance, the exploration of anomaly detection in robotic arm manipulation videos is limited by the low number of available resources. To this end, we introduce RoboVAD, a large-scale benchmark for video anomaly detection that comprises challenging cross-domain evaluation scenarios, where certain actions (tasks executed by a robotic arm) and anomaly types (mistakes that occur while performing certain tasks) remain unseen during training. RoboVAD is designed to benchmark VAD methods in realistic scenarios, where robotic arms can perform unforeseen tasks, and thereby encounter new anomaly types. We train and evaluate several state-of-the-art VAD methods, including a novel method specifically adapted for robotic arm manipulation. While the proposed method outperforms many state-of-the-art competitors, all methods remain below a micro-averaged frame-level AUC threshold of 70% in the most challenging evaluation setup, confirming the difficulty of the proposed benchmark. We publicly release our dataset and code at https://zenodo.org/records/22754659.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboVAD，一个用于视频异常检测的大规模基准，聚焦机械臂操作场景中的跨域评估，涵盖未见任务与未见异常类型的挑战性设定，并对多种最先进 VAD 方法进行了训练与评测。
AI.motivation: 机械臂操作中的异常检测对交互学习、操作能力提升及异常发生时的恢复流程等下游应用具有重要意义，但相关资源匮乏，导致该场景下的探索受限。现有 VAD 基准也多缺乏面向真实机械臂场景（需应对未见任务与新异常类型）的跨域评测设定。
AI.method: 构建 RoboVAD 大规模基准，包含跨域评估场景：训练阶段未出现的某些动作（机械臂执行的任务）与异常类型（执行任务时发生的错误）；在该基准上训练并评测多种最先进 VAD 方法，并提出一种专门适配机械臂操作的 VAD 新方法。
AI.result: 所提方法在多数对比中优于多种最先进竞争者，但在最具挑战性的评测设定下，所有方法的 micro-averaged 帧级 AUC 均低于 70%，验证了该基准的难度。数据集与代码已公开于 https://zenodo.org/records/22754659。
AI.conclusion: RoboVAD 为机械臂操作视频异常检测提供了具有挑战性的跨域基准，表明现有 VAD 方法在应对未见任务与新异常类型时仍有显著不足，为后续研究提供了评测平台与改进方向。

title: PrimeScientist: Strategic Allocation of Research Effort in Autonomous Research
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Henri-XYu02/PrimeScientist
summary: Autonomous research agents aim to automate scientific workflows, from proposing ideas to conducting experiments and analyzing results. Yet current AI and research agents can propose more directions than available resources allow them to pursue. Moreover, each attempt could consume substantial resources, requiring agents to reconsider how to invest in subsequent research. Thus, deciding how to invest research effort strategically should be a defining capability of autonomous research agents. Accordingly, we introduce PrimeScientist, which jointly determines research direction and resource investment across successive research attempts. Specifically, we formulate this challenge of strategic research effort allocation as a sequential decision problem where remaining resources should explicitly guide the research policy. We first introduce an executable plan tree that preserves competing plans and their outcomes across attempts. Building on this representation, we propose an adaptive MCTS-based allocation policy that balances exploration and exploitation using experimental feedback and remaining resources. Comprehensive evaluations across AI research, systems and code optimization, and machine learning engineering show that strategic allocation improves research quality and sample efficiency together. Across 12 AI research tasks, PrimeScientist improves average reward by 10.3% with 50.6% fewer research attempts than AutoResearch under the same resource budget. We believe making research effort allocation an explicit optimization target establishes effective resource use as a core research capability for autonomous agents to drive scientific breakthroughs at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PrimeScientist，将自主研究智能体的研究方向选择与资源投入统一建模为序贯决策问题，通过可执行计划树与自适应 MCTS 分配策略，在有限资源下兼顾探索与利用，提升研究质量与样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 与研究智能体能提出的研究方向远超可用资源，且单次尝试消耗巨大，需在后续研究中重新权衡投入方式。因此，如何战略性分配研究努力应成为自主研究智能体的核心能力，但当前工作未将资源分配作为显式优化目标。
AI.method: 将战略性研究努力分配形式化为序贯决策问题，使剩余资源显式引导研究策略。引入可执行计划树（executable plan tree）保存各次尝试中的竞争性方案及其结果；在此基础上提出基于自适应 MCTS 的分配策略，利用实验反馈与剩余资源平衡探索与利用。
AI.result: 在 AI 研究、系统与代码优化、机器学习工程等场景的综合评估表明，战略性分配可同时提升研究质量与样本效率。在 12 项 AI 研究任务中，相同资源预算下 PrimeScientist 相比 AutoResearch 平均奖励提升 10.3%，研究尝试次数减少 50.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将研究努力分配作为显式优化目标，可确立高效资源利用为自主智能体的核心研究能力，从而推动大规模科学突破。

title: SFT or RL for Tool-Calling Agents? A Controlled Study Across Data, Method, and Scale
comment: Accepted to the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Limited controlled evidence exists on how training data, adaptation method, and model scale jointly affect tool-calling performance in language-model agents. We evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with LoRA, reinforcement learning (RL) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and SFT followed by GRPO across six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, covering both in-distribution performance and cross-dataset transfer. SFT with LoRA is the strongest in-distribution method throughout the 0.6B-32B range and best in 15 out of 18 experimental settings. On cross-dataset transfer, the methods are closer: GRPO wins 29 out of 54 settings where training and test datasets differ, but its margin over SFT averages under one point, and SFT->GRPO is rarely strongest in either comparison. Dataset mixing gives consistently strong transfer while staying close to specialized in-distribution training, regardless of method. Additional analysis further confirms that LoRA outperforms full-parameter fine-tuning, demonstrating that LoRA better preserves pretrained agentic behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究在0.6B–32B的Qwen3模型上对比LoRA-SFT、GRPO强化学习及SFT→GRPO，发现LoRA-SFT在分布内最优（18项中胜15项），跨数据集迁移各方法差距小，数据混合稳健提升迁移效果，LoRA优于全参数微调。
AI.motivation: 关于训练数据、适配方法与模型规模如何共同影响语言模型智能体工具调用性能，现有受控证据有限。
AI.method: 在6个Qwen3模型（0.6B至32B）上评估三种适配方法：LoRA监督微调（SFT）、基于GRPO的强化学习（RL）、以及SFT后接GRPO；考察分布内表现与跨数据集迁移，并开展数据集混合实验，另对比LoRA与全参数微调。
AI.result: LoRA-SFT在0.6B–32B全范围内分布内表现最强，18项设置中15项最优。跨数据集迁移上各方法更接近：训练与测试数据集不同时GRPO在54项中胜29项，但对SFT的平均优势不足1分，SFT→GRPO在两类比较中均很少最强。数据混合无论采用何种方法均能稳定提升迁移，同时接近专用分布内训练。LoRA优于全参数微调。
AI.conclusion: LoRA-SFT是稳健的分布内方法，且能更好保留预训练的智能体行为；跨数据集迁移中方法差异有限，数据混合是提升迁移的有效策略。

title: AfriSyCo: Measuring Assertive Framing, Verification, and Wording Sensitivity Around African-Language Content
summary: AfriSyCo studies answer switching around African-language factual content with two complementary layers: native-language follow-ups and a controlled cross-language factorial whose question, options, and target remain in the African language while the follow-up framing is English. We analyze 1,415 turn-1-correct model-language-item observations derived from 100 source questions across seven open-weight checkpoints and six languages; turn-1-correct denotes observed first-response accuracy, not demonstrated knowledge. Under native prompts, assertive endorsement produces 29.3 percentage points more any-turn false-target selection than mention-plus-verification (M+V), with a 19.0-point immediate T2 contrast. In the precommitted 2 x 2 factorial, averaged over three tested prompt families, assertive framing increases target selection by 30.4 points (95% CI [28.4, 32.3]); verification decreases it by 17.4 points, while the assertive effect rises from 20.5 points without verification to 40.2 with it (interaction +19.7). The effect remains 34.8 points among 611 observations correct after option reordering. Magnitude varies sharply by wording and checkpoint: prompt-family effects span 20.1-42.5 points, a Twi/Qwen3 paraphrase shifts target selection from 70.8% to 4.2%, and checkpoint effects span 9.2-47.0 points. Prompt realization is therefore part of the measurement problem.

AI.tldr: AfriSyCo研究非洲语言事实内容中的答案切换现象，发现断言式追问框架显著提高错误目标选项选择率，而验证式框架可降低该效应，且效应量受措辞与模型检查点强烈影响。
AI.motivation: 探究多轮对话中追问框架（尤其是断言与验证）如何影响非洲语言事实内容的答案稳定性，揭示提示词实现本身构成测量问题的一部分。
AI.method: 采用两个互补层次：母语追问层，及受控跨语言2×2因子设计（问题、选项、目标保持非洲语言，追问框架为英语）。基于7个开放权重检查点、6种语言、100个源问题，构建1,415条首轮正确观测，检验断言式与提及加验证（M+V）框架的效果，并进行选项重排序稳健性检验。
AI.result: 母语提示下，断言式比M+V多产生29.3个百分点的任意轮次错误目标选择，第二轮即时差异为19.0个百分点。2×2因子中，断言框架使目标选择增加30.4个百分点（95% CI [28.4, 32.3]），验证降低17.4个百分点，断言效应从无验证的20.5升至有验证的40.2（交互+19.7）。选项重排序后611条正确观测中效应仍达34.8个百分点。效应随措辞与检查点剧烈变化：提示家族效应为20.1–42.5个百分点，Twi/Qwen3释义使目标选择从70.8%降至4.2%，检查点效应为9.2–47.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 追问框架显著且稳健地影响非洲语言事实内容的答案切换，断言放大、验证抑制该效应，且效应量高度依赖具体措辞与模型，提示词实现应被视为测量问题的一部分。

title: Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception
summary: Heterogeneous cooperative perception (CP) enables connected vehicles with diverse sensor setups to share spatial awareness via compact feature maps, where receivers reconcile these maps using learned translation modules for fusion and inference. Prior attacks against CP in a homogeneous setting reveal that the data exchange introduces a critical attack surface: a single malicious agent can transmit crafted features that erase real objects from a neighbor's fused scene. Yet, it is widely hypothesized that heterogeneity naturally defends against these attacks, as the attacker lacks knowledge of the victim's detector and the translation module scrambles adversarial gradients. We demonstrate that this protection is largely an illusion. Using a matched-objective harness to standardize the perturbation budget, objective, and forward path, we show that properly tuned iterative attacks close or reverse the apparent robustness gap. However, these optimization-based attacks require ground-truth labels and iterative backpropagation, meaning they do not represent a practical field threat running in real-time. To bridge this gap, we introduce HetPoison, a learned generator that crafts a removal perturbation in a single, label-free forward pass. HetPoison transfers across major heterogeneous designs without requiring access to the victim's detector, matching or exceeding the effectiveness of expensive optimizer-based attacks. Since heterogeneity itself is not a defense, we propose HetShield, a lightweight trust layer that validates the spatiotemporal consistency across features, recovering 83--95% of the accuracy degraded by attacks, outperforming prior art.

AI.tldr: 异构协同感知中"异质性天然防御攻击"的假设被证伪：经调优的迭代攻击可消除鲁棒性差距，进一步提出单次前向、免标签的生成器攻击 HetPoison，并提出轻量信任层 HetShield 恢复 83–95% 被攻击损失精度。
AI.motivation: 异构协同感知（CP）通过紧凑特征图共享空间感知，接收方用学习到的翻译模块对齐融合，这引入了攻击面：单个恶意代理可发送精心构造的特征以抹除邻居融合场景中的真实目标。普遍假说认为异质性可天然防御此类攻击，理由包括攻击者不了解受害者检测器、翻译模块会扰乱对抗梯度。本文旨在检验该假说是否成立，并弥补现有攻击缺乏实用性的问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建"匹配目标"（matched-objective）评测框架，统一扰动预算、优化目标与前向路径，以公平比较同质/异构场景下的攻击效果，并揭示文献中攻击表现差异源于攻击强度而非异质性带来的固有鲁棒性；2) 提出 HetPoison：一个学习式生成器，单次免标签前向即可生成目标移除扰动，无需受害者检测器与迭代反向传播；3) 提出 HetShield：轻量级信任层，通过校验特征间的时空一致性检测/抑制异常。
AI.result: 调优的迭代攻击可缩小甚至逆转同质与异构之间表面上的鲁棒性差距，表明异质性并非防御。HetPoison 在主流异构设计间具备可迁移性，无需访问受害者检测器，效果达到或超过昂贵的基于优化的攻击。HetShield 可恢复被攻击导致精度损失的 83–95%，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 异质性本身不构成对协同感知特征投毒/移除攻击的防御；实用威胁可由单次前向的免标签生成器实现。因此需要显式的防御机制，轻量时空一致性校验信任层可在不显著增加开销的前提下大幅恢复精度。

title: Who Judges Matters: Measuring Family-Conditioned Preference in LLM-as-Judge Panels
summary: Who the judge is can affect an LLM-as-judge result, but measuring that effect without confusing it with candidate quality is difficult. We study four open-weight families (Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Yi 1.5) in a fully crossed pairwise design with 9,312 judgments. A common per-family statistic is strongly confounded with candidate quality and correlates with Bradley-Terry ability at r = 0.95. We derive a corrected estimator that holds the candidate family fixed and compares judges. All four families then show a positive same-family lift (3.4-8.4 percentage points), with global FPS 0.067 (95% CI [0.053, 0.084], permutation p = 0.0002). The effect remains under panel-based quality controls, an independent human-consensus anchor, and a float16 judging replication. Judge-side likelihood is closely related to the effect: adding likelihood advantage reduces the controlled coefficient by 61%, which we treat as descriptive attenuation rather than causal mediation. Position is a separate failure mode. Across the panel, 55.4% of AB/BA pairs reverse, and reversal above 50% is incompatible with a simple independent content-noise model. Relative to a family-balanced reference, panel composition changes 18.5% of pairwise outcomes. A complete reproducibility archive has been prepared for public release.

AI.tldr: 该论文在完全交叉的成对比较设计中（9,312次判定）研究了LLM-as-judge中的"同族偏好"效应，发现常用的按模型家族统计量严重混杂于候选质量，为此提出校正估计量，测得四个开源模型家族均存在3.4–8.4个百分点的正同族提升，并揭示位置偏差是独立的失效模式。
AI.motivation: LLM作为评判者（LLM-as-judge）时，评判者身份会影响结果，但直接测量这种效应难以与候选质量本身混淆。既有按家族统计的做法存在混杂，因此需要一个能将"评判者效应"与"候选质量"分离的严格实验设计与估计方法。
AI.method: 采用完全交叉（fully crossed）的成对比较设计，涵盖四个开源权重家族（Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5、Gemma 2、Yi 1.5），共9,312次判定。指出常见按家族统计量与Bradley-Terry能力值相关系数达r=0.95，属严重混杂；据此推导出固定候选家族、仅比较评判者的校正估计量。辅以基于评审团的质量控制、独立人类共识锚点以及float16评判复现实验，并分析评判方似然与效应的关系及位置偏差。
AI.result: 四个家族均呈现显著的正同族提升，达3.4–8.4个百分点，全局FPS为0.067（95% CI [0.053, 0.084]，置换检验p=0.0002）。该效应在评审团质量控制、独立人类共识锚点和float16复现下依然稳健。加入似然优势后受控系数降低61%（作者将其视为描述性衰减而非因果中介）。位置偏差为独立失效模式：评审团中55.4%的AB/BA对发生翻转，超过50%的翻转率与简单独立内容噪声模型不相容；相对家族均衡参照，评审团构成改变18.5%的成对结果。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-judge存在稳健且可量化的同族偏好，需用校正估计量并控制候选质量才能无偏测量；位置偏差与同族偏好是相互独立的失效模式，评审团成员构成会实质影响评测结论。作者已准备完整的可复现性归档以供公开释放。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Continual Learning for Open-World Intent Discovery Under an evolving Label Space
summary: Real-world intelligent systems increasingly operate under open-world conditions, where user intents are not fixed or exhaustively known a priori and may evolve as new interaction patterns emerge. This paper proposes a unified uncertainty-aware probabilistic framework for continual new intent discovery under an evolving label space. Each utterance is encoded through an adaptive $β$-VAE into a latent mean, used for classification and density modelling and a posterior uncertainty estimate acting as a global reliability signal. Classifier confidence, posterior uncertainty and DP-GMM likelihood are combined through a multi-signal decision mechanism to distinguish known intents from potentially novel samples. Candidate novel instances are clustered through a density-based discovery module and only reliable clusters are promoted to new labels, enabling controlled label-space expansion. Replay and Elastic Weight Consolidation mitigate catastrophic forgetting and preserve previously acquired knowledge. The paper formalises continual intent discovery as a structured multi-phase open-world problem, introduces adaptive label-space expansion under stability--plasticity constraints and uses posterior uncertainty to regulate trusted-sample selection, pseudo-labelling, novelty admission and replay. Experiments show high novelty precision, stable adaptation across sequential phases and limited forgetting. Near-zero NMI and ARI indicate limited reconstruction of the complete fine-grained intent taxonomy, consistent with the framework's conservative promotion strategy. Qualitative analyses nevertheless reveal dense and locally coherent semantic clusters, showing that reliable novel structures can be discovered without exhaustive recovery of the underlying taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的不确定性感知概率框架，用于演化标签空间下的持续新意图发现，通过自适应β-VAE编码、多信号决策、密度聚类与回放/EWC机制实现受控的标签扩展，实验显示高新颖性精度、稳定适应与有限遗忘，但细粒度意图体系重建的NMI/ARI接近零。
AI.motivation: 现实智能系统运行于开放世界，用户意图并非固定或先验穷尽可知，且会随新交互模式出现而演化；因此需要在标签空间不断扩张的条件下持续发现新意图，并兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
AI.method: 采用自适应β-VAE将每句话编码为潜在均值，用于分类与密度建模，并输出后验不确定性作为全局可靠性信号；将分类器置信度、后验不确定性与DP-GMM似然经多信号决策机制融合以区分已知意图与潜在新样本；候选新样本经密度聚类发现模块聚类，仅可靠簇被提升为新标签以实现受控标签空间扩张；用回放与弹性权重巩固缓解灾难性遗忘；并将持续意图发现形式化为结构化多阶段开放世界问题。
AI.result: 实验显示高新颖性精度、跨序列阶段的稳定适应和有限遗忘；但NMI与ARI接近零，表明未能重建完整细粒度意图体系，这与框架保守的提升策略一致；定性分析仍显示密集且局部连贯的语义簇，说明无需穷尽恢复底层分类体系也能发现可靠的新结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在演化标签空间下的持续新意图发现中实现了受控扩展与知识保持，并利用后验不确定性调节可信样本选择、伪标注、新颖性准入与回放；其价值在于可靠的新颖结构发现而非完整分类体系的恢复，未来可改进细粒度意图体系的完整重建与提升簇级语义一致性。

title: Lumen: Parameter-Efficient Alignment of Pretrained Vision and Language Encoders for Zero-Shot Computational Pathology
summary: Pathology vision-language models are commonly built by pretraining or fine-tuning large encoders on paired image-caption data. We asked whether a pathology vision-language model can instead be assembled by parameter-efficient alignment of frozen unimodal foundation models, leaving their pretrained representations untouched. Here we present Lumen, which aligns frozen Virchow2 and BioMedBERT backbones using rank-4 adapters and projection heads, training only 0.40% of the total parameters on the public QUILT-1M corpus. Across nine public zero-shot patch benchmarks, Lumen achieved the highest mean chance-corrected balanced accuracy, 0.546 versus 0.461 for the strongest baseline (paired difference 0.086, 95% CI 0.042-0.136). On lymph-node metastasis detection, Lumen reached an AUROC of 0.964 (95% CI 0.956-0.971) on 4,214 held-out internal slides and 0.955 (95% CI 0.942-0.966) on 2,368 slides across nine external cohorts and six organs. At the internally calibrated threshold, it outperformed all vision-language baselines, with a balanced accuracy of 0.909 (95% CI 0.896-0.923) internally and 0.915 (95% CI 0.902-0.929) externally. Lumen performed competitively across the evaluations, with the exception of cross-modal retrieval, where it ranked third behind CONCH and PathGen-L/14. Fully fine-tuning both encoders gave Lumen no consistent benefit over low-rank adaptation, although it improved retrieval. Aligning frozen unimodal foundation models therefore yields strong and transferable performance at patch and slide level while training only a small fraction of the parameters.

AI.tldr: Lumen通过秩4适配器与投影头对齐冻结的Virchow2与BioMedBERT，仅训练0.40%参数，在零样本补丁与全切片淋巴结转移检测上超越基线，但跨模态检索弱于CONCH与PathGen-L/14。
AI.motivation: 病理视觉-语言模型通常依赖大规模配对图文数据对编码器进行预训练或微调，成本高且可能破坏预训练表征。本文探究是否可通过参数高效对齐冻结的单模态基础模型来构建此类模型，从而保持预训练表征不变。
AI.method: Lumen冻结Virchow2（视觉）与BioMedBERT（文本）主干，仅训练秩4适配器与投影头，在公开QUILT-1M语料上对齐，可训练参数仅占总量的0.40%；并对比全量微调两种编码器的效果。
AI.result: 在九个公开零样本补丁基准上，Lumen平均机会校正平衡准确率最高，为0.546，对比最强基线0.461（配对差0.086，95% CI 0.042–0.136）。淋巴结转移检测：内部4,214张切片AUROC 0.964（95% CI 0.956–0.971），九个外部队列、六个器官共2,368张切片AUROC 0.955（95% CI 0.942–0.966）；内部校准阈值下平衡准确率内部0.909（95% CI 0.896–0.923）、外部0.915（95% CI 0.902–0.929），优于所有视觉-语言基线。仅在跨模态检索中排名第三，落后于CONCH和PathGen-L/14。全量微调未带来一致性收益，仅改善检索。
AI.conclusion: 对齐冻结的单模态基础模型可在仅训练极小比例参数的情况下，在补丁与切片层面取得强且可迁移的性能，是一种高效构建病理视觉-语言模型的可行路径。

title: Can VLMs Reliably Assess Sidewalk Accessibility Attributes from Pedestrian-Level Imagery?
summary: An important component of urban accessibility, particularly for wheelchair users and people with reduced mobility, is sidewalk compliance with measurable requirements. We test whether effective width, longitudinal slope, cross slope, and pavement condition can be assessed reliably from pedestrian-level imagery using vision-language models (VLMs). We present the first application of sampling-based conformal prediction (CP) for VLM-based accessibility assessment. We evaluate four VLMs on 514 sidewalk images from Seoul, South Korea, with field-measured ground truth. Conformal calibration attains the nominal 90% coverage for all models and attributes, but the calibrated regions differ in informativeness. Effective width yields the most informative estimates, with a mean interval half-width of about 1.0 m for the best model. Since every model overestimates width, asymmetric calibration shortens the intervals by up to 33% at unchanged coverage. Longitudinal slope is marginally informative, cross-slope intervals are too wide to resolve regulatory thresholds, and pavement-condition sets degenerate to all five grades (A-E) for three of the four models. Uncalibrated intervals from raw sampling dispersion cover only 17-47% of field-measured values at a nominal 90% level. Among the images with the most self-consistent responses, these intervals miss the field-measured value in up to 96% of cases. Response self-consistency is therefore not evidence of accuracy, and sampling dispersion cannot be interpreted as uncertainty until it has been calibrated against field-measured ground truth. No quantitative attribute reaches the precision required for general compliance assessment, but CP identifies from calibration data alone which attributes can support screening of segments far from the thresholds. We release the annotated pedestrian-level images and their corresponding field-measured attribute values.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将采样式共形预测（CP）应用于基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的人行道无障碍性评估，在首尔514张人行道图像上以实地测量值为真值评估四个VLM。共形校准可在名义90%水平上实现覆盖率，但各属性区间信息量差异显著：有效宽度最具信息性，纵坡仅边际可用，横坡无法分辨监管阈值，路面状况趋于退化。研究还发现采样离散度在未经校准时不能解释为不确定性。
AI.motivation: 人行道是否符合可量化要求是城市无障碍性的重要组成部分，尤其对轮椅使用者和行动不便者而言。作者希望检验有效宽度、纵坡、横坡与路面状况这四类属性能否借助行人视角图像和视觉语言模型可靠评估，并解决VLM输出缺乏可靠不确定性量化的问题。
AI.method: 使用首尔514张人行道行人视角图像及实地测量真值，评估四个VLM。首次采用采样式共形预测进行校准，并对比非对称校准与对称校准；同时考察原始采样离散度所形成的未校准区间，以及响应自洽性与准确性的关系。
AI.result: 共形校准在所有模型和属性上均达到名义90%覆盖率，但区间信息量不同。有效宽度估计最具信息性，最佳模型平均区间半宽约1.0米；由于所有模型均高估宽度，非对称校准在覆盖率不变下将区间缩短最多33%。纵坡仅具边际信息，横坡区间过宽以致无法分辨监管阈值，路面状况在四个模型中的三个上退化为全部五个等级（A-E）。未校准区间在名义90%水平下仅覆盖17%-47%的实测值；在响应最自洽的图像中，这些区间最多有96%的案例未覆盖实测值。
AI.conclusion: 响应自洽性并不代表准确性，采样离散度在被实地真值校准之前不能解释为不确定性。没有任何定量属性达到一般合规评估所需的精度，但共形预测仅凭校准数据即可识别哪些属性可用于筛查远离阈值的路段。作者发布了带标注的行人视角图像及其对应实地测量属性值。

title: ERPBench: A State-Grounded Evaluation Paradigm for Computer-Use Agents in Enterprise Software
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables, submitted for review to 2027 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
summary: Computer-use agents that operate through screenshots and simulated actions are advancing rapidly, yet their evaluation remains anchored to general desktop and web tasks. Enterprise Resource Planning systems run the finance, procurement, inventory, and customer operations of organizations worldwide, and pose distinct challenges for computer-use agents: dense interfaces, coordinated multi-step interactions, and errors that alter persistent business records rather than surfacing on screen. Existing enterprise computer-use benchmarks rely on proprietary platforms or on simulated approximations of such software. We introduce ERPBench, a benchmark that evaluates screenshot-only agents on a live and reproducible system and scores each task against ground-truth values in its database. Beyond the benchmark, we present a production-grade harness that gates agent actions behind human approval for safe deployment. Evaluating six closed and open-source agents, we demonstrate that strong general performance does not transfer to enterprise reliability. Even when an agent reaches the right form and saves it, the stored record is often wrong: some agents save in up to 85% of runs but write the correct value in as few as 3%. We further characterize failure modes specific to enterprise workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出ERPBench基准，在真实可复现的ERP系统上以数据库真值评测纯截图操作的计算机使用智能体，并给出带人工审批的生产级部署框架；结果表明通用能力无法迁移到企业级可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体的评测集中于通用桌面与网页任务，而ERP系统具有界面密集、跨步骤协同、错误会改写持久业务记录而非仅显示在屏幕上的特性，且已有企业级基准依赖专有平台或模拟近似软件，缺乏真实、可复现的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建ERPBench基准：在真实且可复现运行的ERP系统上评测仅依赖截图的智能体，并以数据库中的真值对每项任务打分；同时提出面向生产的执行框架，将智能体动作置于人工审批之下以保障安全部署。对六个闭源与开源智能体进行评测。
AI.result: 强通用性能并不能转化为企业级可靠性。即使智能体定位到正确表单并保存，存储记录仍常出错：部分智能体在高达85%的运行中完成保存，但写入正确数值的比例最低仅3%。研究进一步刻画了企业工作流特有的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 企业场景下计算机使用智能体的评测需以真实系统与数据库真值为依据；保存成功不等于正确执行，通用能力不足以支撑企业可靠性，因此需引入人工审批等安全部署机制并针对企业工作流特有问题进行优化。

title: Long-Context Demonstration Selection Using State Space Models
summary: We study the problem of demonstration selection, which involves selecting a subset of examples for prepending to a query to a language model. This problem is closely related to in-context learning and language model inference. Since the inference cost of a transformer model scales quadratically with sequence length, the selection problem becomes especially challenging in a long-context scenario. In this paper, we tackle this problem by building on state space models (SSMs), which require only linear inference time given the input. Our approach involves two algorithms. The first learns a small set of SSMs through distillation of a (trained) transformer model. We partition all the layers into consecutive groups. Then for each group, we estimate a separate state space model to replicate the input-output behavior within the adjacent layers. Second, we map the distilled model outputs to a small set of tokens, and apply these embeddings for demonstration selection in downstream applications. We perform extensive experiments in both synthetic and real-world datasets to validate our approach. We demonstrate that the distilled SSMs only incur an approximation error of less than $0.7\%$ relative to the true output. In downstream evaluation, we show that on several text classification and reasoning tasks, our approach reduces FLOPs by $14.2\times$ and improves accuracy by $6.48\%$ relative to baseline demonstration selection methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于状态空间模型（SSM）的演示选择方法，通过从Transformer蒸馏SSM并映射输出到少量token，实现长上下文场景下高效、准确的示例选择。
AI.motivation: 演示选择（为查询前置示例子集）与上下文学习、模型推理密切相关，但Transformer推理成本随序列长度呈二次增长，在长上下文场景下选择问题尤为困难，亟需降低推理开销的方法。
AI.method: 提出两个算法：第一，将训练好的Transformer所有层划分为连续的分组，对每组通过蒸馏估计一个独立的SSM，以复现相邻层间的输入-输出行为；第二，将蒸馏模型输出映射到一小部分token，并将这些嵌入用于下游任务的演示选择。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的大量实验表明，蒸馏得到的SSM相对真实输出的近似误差小于0.7%；在多个文本分类与推理任务中，相比基线演示选择方法，FLOPs降低14.2倍，准确率提升6.48%。
AI.conclusion: 借助SSM的线性推理特性，通过对Transformer的分组蒸馏和输出token映射，可在长上下文场景下实现高效的演示选择，兼顾计算效率与下游任务准确率。

title: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures. Authors listed alphabetically by surname. Project: https://zing.loopit.me/ ; Code: https://github.com/seedleap/zing-world-model ; Models: https://huggingface.co/seedleap/zing-0.5 ; Serving: https://github.com/seedleap/Zing-SGLang
summary: We introduce Zing-0.5, a 5B autoregressive world model designed for playability: users can explore generated worlds, influence unfolding events, and respond to the resulting feedback through joint keyboard and online text control. Our approach brings together three technical contributions: (1) Unified action and text conditioning, combining magnitude-aware keyboard inputs with temporally aligned text instructions and jointly annotated videos to learn navigation and event control within the same sequence; (2) Event-scale supervision for incremental generation, using a segment-level teacher trained on connected multi-prompt videos to supervise a block-level causal student through distribution-matching distillation; and (3) Low-cost real-time interaction, combining four-step generation with context-preserving streaming to support 832 x 480 inference at 24 FPS at an estimated server rental cost of approximately USD 0.009 per stream-minute. Zing-0.5 achieves an overall score of 81.0 and a consistency score of 88.5 across 158 WBench Navigation cases. A joint-control demonstration shows a text-directed event change during continued navigation without restarting generation. We release the model weights, inference code, and Zing-SGLang serving implementation to support further work on playable generated worlds.

AI.tldr: Zing-0.5 是一个 5B 自回归世界模型，支持键盘与在线文本联合控制，通过统一动作-文本条件、事件级监督蒸馏与低开销流式生成实现可玩性，在 24 FPS 下以约 0.009 美元/流分钟成本实现实时交互。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建"可玩"的生成式世界：用户能探索生成世界、影响事件进程并依据反馈作出响应，需同时满足动作与文本联合控制、增量生成一致性以及低成本实时交互三项要求。
AI.method: 三项技术贡献：(1) 统一动作与文本条件——将幅度感知键盘输入与时间对齐文本指令、联合标注视频相结合，在同一序列中学习导航与事件控制；(2) 事件级监督增量生成——以连接式多提示视频训练的段级教师模型，通过分布匹配蒸馏监督块级因果学生模型；(3) 低成本实时交互——四步生成结合保上下文流式机制，支持 832×480、24 FPS 推理，服务器租用成本约 0.009 美元/流分钟。
AI.result: 在 158 个 WBench Navigation 案例上取得总分 81.0、一致性得分 88.5；联合控制演示显示可在持续导航中实现文本引导的事件改变，而无需重启生成。
AI.conclusion: Zing-0.5 验证了动作-文本联合可控、事件级一致且低成本实时的可玩生成世界模型可行性，并开源模型权重、推理代码及 Zing-SGLang 服务实现以支持后续研究。

title: Face-voice Association across LAnguages and Gender (FLAG) 2027 Challenge Evaluation Plan
summary: Face--voice association models may rely on language or gender cues in the voice rather than on speaker-specific voice characteristics, which can lead to a performance deterioration when the model has to identify a multilingual speaker or distinguis same-gender speakers. To investigate these issues, we introduce the Face-voice Association across LAnguages and Gender (FLAG) 2027 Challenge. The challenge formulates face--voice association as a cross-modal verification task: given a voice, identify the speaker's face from a ``gallery'' of faces consisting of the speaker's face and a set of negative samples. Models are evaluated on identities not present in the training data (``unseen'') and both for languages present or absent from the training data (``heard'' and ``unheard''). Two evaluation settings are used to test models' reliance on gender: a standard, unconstrained and a gender-constrained one, where the latter uses a same-gender gallery. The performance of existing, baseline models in these settings reveals that models performance degrades under language shifts and in gender-constrained settings, highlighting the need to foster the development of models that capture identity-specific aspects beyond language and gender. The challenge provides a benchmark dataset, pretrained baseline models, and an evaluation framework to advance face--voice association.

AI.tldr: 提出 FLAG 2027 挑战，将跨语言与跨性别的面部—声音关联建模为跨模态验证任务，并揭示基线模型在语言迁移与同性别场景下的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 现有面部—声音关联模型可能依赖语音中的语言或性别线索，而非说话人特有的声音特征，导致在多语言说话人或同性别说话人识别时性能下降。为系统考察该问题，需要专门的评测基准与设定。
AI.method: 将面部—声音关联建模为跨模态验证：给定一段声音，从包含目标说话人面部及若干负样本的"gallery"中识别其面部。评测覆盖训练集中未出现的身份（unseen），并按语言是否出现在训练集分为 heard/unheard。设置两种评测条件：标准的无约束条件与性别约束条件（后者使用同性别 gallery）。
AI.result: 现有基线模型在语言迁移（语言偏移）和性别约束条件下性能均出现退化。
AI.conclusion: 基线结果凸显了开发能够捕捉超越语言与性别的身份特异性特征模型的必要性。该挑战提供基准数据集、预训练基线模型与评测框架，以推动面部—声音关联研究。

title: Audio for Sports Highlight Detection: A Comparative Empirical Study
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia Workshop on Multimedia Content Analysis in Sports (MMSports) 2026
summary: Sports highlight detection aims to identify the most exciting and meaningful moments from long sports videos. While existing methods often emphasize visual or visual-language representations, sports videos contain rich audio cues, including commentator speech, crowd reactions, whistles, ball impacts, and referee calls. In this work, we revisit the role of audio in sports highlight detection and ask a simple question: how far can audio alone go? We construct lightweight audio-only baselines using pretrained audio representations and compare them with visual-only and audio-visual methods on the SV-Highlights benchmark. Surprisingly, our audio-only GRU baseline achieves strong performance and outperforms several existing audio-visual methods under our supervised evaluation setting. Furthermore, a simple audio-visual fusion baseline achieves the best performance across all metrics, indicating that audio and visual cues provide complementary information. To better understand the contribution of audio, we conduct source-separated analysis and show that vocal/commentary audio is more informative than background-only audio, while their combination performs best. We also analyze interpretable audio cues and find that highlight clips exhibit higher RMS loudness, peak loudness, and mid-frequency energy than non-highlight clips, although substantial distribution overlap indicates that loudness alone is insufficient. Our findings suggest that audio is an underexplored but highly informative modality for sports highlight detection and should be treated as a primary signal rather than merely an auxiliary cue.

AI.tldr: 该工作重新审视音频在体育精彩片段检测中的作用，构建仅音频基线并与视觉、音视频方法在SV-Highlights基准上对比，发现音频是被低估的高信息量模态，应与视觉并重。
AI.motivation: 现有体育精彩片段检测方法多侧重视觉或视觉-语言表示，忽视体育视频中丰富的音频线索（解说语音、观众反应、哨声、击球声、裁判判罚等）。作者希望回答一个简单问题：仅靠音频能走多远，并重新评估音频这一模态的价值。
AI.method: 使用预训练音频表示构建轻量级仅音频基线（含音频-only GRU），在SV-Highlights基准上与仅视觉及音视频方法在监督评估设置下比较；进一步做源分离分析比较人声/解说与纯背景音频的贡献；并分析可解释音频线索（RMS响度、峰值响度、中频能量）。
AI.result: 仅音频GRU基线表现强劲，在监督评估下超过若干现有音视频方法；简单的音视频融合基线在所有指标上取得最佳，说明音频与视觉提供互补信息；源分离显示人声/解说音频比纯背景更informative，二者结合最佳；精彩片段在RMS响度、峰值响度和中频能量上高于非精彩片段，但分布重叠明显，说明单靠响度不足。
AI.conclusion: 音频在体育精彩片段检测中是尚未被充分探索但信息量极高的模态，应被视为主要信号而非仅辅助线索。

title: Rapid Loss of the Sierra Nevada's Largest Trees Driven by Fire
summary: Large trees disproportionately contribute to biomass storage, habitat structure, and ecosystem functioning. However, their distribution and health dynamics remain poorly quantified at a regional scale. Here, a deep learning model (U-Net-ID) and canopy height models derived from sub-meter aerial imagery from 2020 were used to delineate all individual trees with crown area $\geq$ 100 m$^2$ across the Sierra Nevada Floristic Province. The model was trained using more than 3.3 million synthetic tree crowns and achieved a median Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.602 when validated against an independent dataset of 20,273 crowns. A total of 6,515,705 large trees were mapped, occurring across approximately 78.7% of the Sierra Nevada Floristic Province. The spatial distribution of large trees showed associations with elevation, temperature, and precipitation. Using Sentinel-2 time series from 2020 to 2025, tree health dynamics were characterized by extracting spectral trajectories for each crown and applying BFAST breakpoint detection algorithm combined with a disturbance classification framework to identify mortality, disturbance, and recovery trajectories of individual trees. Wildfires, estimated from CAL FIRE fire perimeters, were identified as the dominant driver of large-tree mortality, killing 10% of all large trees in the Sierra Nevada, with mortality strongly concentrated during the extreme 2020-2021 fire seasons.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用深度学习模型（U-Net-ID）结合亚米级航空影像冠层高度模型，绘制了内华达山脉植物区面积≥100 m²的大树分布图，并借助Sentinel-2时序与BFAST算法追踪其健康动态，揭示野火是大树死亡的主导驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 大树对生物量储存、栖息地结构和生态系统功能贡献巨大，但其在区域尺度上的分布与健康动态仍缺乏量化研究。
AI.method: 采用深度学习模型（U-Net-ID）与2020年亚米级航空影像生成的冠层高度模型，识别冠面积≥100 m²的单株大树；模型使用超330万个合成树冠训练，并在20,273个独立树冠数据集上验证；随后提取各树冠的Sentinel-2（2020–2025）光谱轨迹，结合BFAST断点检测与干扰分类框架，识别单株树木的死亡、干扰与恢复轨迹，并以CAL FIRE火烧边界估算野火影响。
AI.result: 模型验证中位IoU为0.602；共绘制6,515,705株大树，覆盖约78.7%的区域内华达山脉植物区；大树空间分布与海拔、温度和降水相关；野火是大树死亡的主导驱动因素，导致区域内10%的大树死亡，死亡高度集中于2020–2021年极端火灾季。
AI.conclusion: 该研究实现了区域尺度单株大树的分布制图与健康动态监测，表明野火（尤其是极端火灾季）是内华达山脉大树死亡的主要驱动因子，为区域森林保护与生态管理提供了量化依据。
